If there is no rollback, check with your PC manufacturer for supported versions.
Windows 키+I로 설정을 여세요. 설정 → 앱 → 설치된 앱에서 증: Open Settings with Windows key+I. Go to Settings → Apps → Installed apps, find the tuning/device utilities added just before the symptom, and compare them one by one with official recovery/removal. Restart after each change and restore any changes that don't work.
시작 버튼을 우클릭하고 터미널(관리자)을 선택하세요. 해당 메뉴가 없으면: Right-click the Start button and select Terminal (Administrator). If the menu is not there, type cmd in Windows search, select Run as administrator in Command Prompt, and then authorize it with your own permissions.
DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHeal: Type DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth and press Enter. Wait for completion results and record the error number if failed. If there is a disk read failure or abnormal noise, backup takes priority over repeating the command.
DISM 결과를 확인한 뒤 sfc /scannow를 입력하고 Enter를: After checking the DISM results, enter sfc /scannow and press Enter. Do not close the window until the test is complete, write down the result text, then restart and compare your original symptoms.
사용 중인 튜닝 앱에서 변경한 CPU·GPU 설정을 기록하고 기본값으로: Record the CPU and GPU settings you changed in the tuning app you are using and return them to the default values. In BIOS, only disable XMP and EXPO that you turned on, and do not change storage mode, TPM, or secure boot.
Windows 키+R → msinfo32 → Enter에서 시스템 모델과: Windows Key + R → msinfo32 → Enter, enter the system model and BIOS version, and find information on the same model/revision on the manufacturer's support page. Check if there are any corrections or compatibility conditions related to the symptom.
업데이트가 필요하면 중요 파일·BitLocker 복구 키를 확보하고 안정: If an update is needed, secure your important files and BitLocker recovery key and follow the manufacturer's instructions on a stable power source. Do not turn off the power while recording and compare the same task after completion.
모니터 전원 버튼을 누르고 전원 LED와 화면의 메뉴 표시가 나오는지 확: Press the monitor power button and check that the power LED and menu display appear on the screen. If there is no LED, check the monitor power cable, adapter, and outlet.
모니터 옆·뒤 버튼이나 조이스틱을 눌러 OSD 메뉴를 열고 Input·S: Press the button or joystick on the side or back of the monitor to open the OSD menu and select HDMI 1·HDMI 2·DisplayPort where the actual cable is plugged in from Input·Source. Check your model manual for button locations and names.
If the menu itself is visible but there is no signal, compare the PC output/video cable. If you cannot even see the menu, check the monitor with another normal power source or device.
PC 뒤를 보고 영상 케이블이 메인보드 단자와 별도 그래픽카드 단자 중: Look at the back of the PC and check whether the video cable is connected to the motherboard terminal or the separate graphics card terminal. If the output is output through a separate GPU, connect it to the HDMI/DP terminal of the card.
전원을 켤 때 메인보드의 CPU·DRAM·VGA·BOOT LED 중 어느: When turning on the power, note which of the motherboard's CPU, DRAM, VGA, and BOOT LEDs stay on. Distinguish between turning on briefly and staying on forever.
Write down the number and length of beeps and compare them with the diagnostic table in the motherboard manual. Do not purchase parts based solely on the indication, but first check the installation and power of the device.
작업 관리자(Ctrl+Shift+Esc로 열기)가 열리면 Windows: Once Task Manager (open with Ctrl+Shift+Esc) opens, restart Windows Explorer and see if your desktop comes back. Even if it is restored, if it repeats when you re-login, check the startup apps and profiles. If Task Manager (open with Ctrl+Shift+Esc) does not open, separate it into Driver/System Freeze.
GPU 제조사 앱의 모니터링·성능 메뉴를 열어 게임 중 GPU 온도·사용: Open the monitoring/performance menu of the GPU manufacturer app to record GPU temperature, usage, and clock during gaming. Compare the same gaming scenes and idle conditions, and also check the allowable temperature for each model.
문제가 나는 조건을 게임·영상·유휴 상태로 나누고 모니터·케이블·포트 한: Divide the problematic conditions into game, video, and idle states and compare again by changing only one monitor, cable, or port. Changing several items at once makes it difficult to distinguish the cause.
현재 사용하는 GPU 튜닝 앱을 열어 코어·메모리 클럭과 전압 프로필을: Open your current GPU tuning app and record the core/memory clock and voltage profile. Revert only the tuning you applied directly using the Default/Reset/Default menu.
Windows와 함께 프로필을 자동 적용하는 설정이 있다면 비교 중 다시: If you have a setting that automatically applies profiles with Windows, make sure they aren't reapplied during the comparison. Compare the default values ​​to the same game scene/time and do not guess and enter unstable voltages.
Windows 키+R → msinfo32 → Enter에서 CPU·시스템: Windows Key + R → msinfo32 → Enter, enter the CPU/system model, and check whether built-in graphics are supported in the manufacturer specifications. Even if there is a motherboard video terminal, not all CPUs support built-in output.
내장 출력으로 비교하려면 전용 GPU 분리·비활성화가 필요한지 모델 설명: To compare with built-in output, check your model manual to see if you need to disconnect/disable the dedicated GPU. If you are not familiar with disconnecting power and installing parts, ask a repair shop to cross-check the GPU for normal operation.
같은 모니터·케이블·작업에서 GPU만 바꿨을 때 증상이 따라가는지 기록하: Record whether the symptoms follow when you change only the GPU on the same monitor, cable, and task. Do not confirm GPU failure as a result of changing other components as well.
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 디스플레이에서 여러 화면 중 문제 모: From Windows Key + I → System → Display, select the problematic monitor first among the various screens. Under Display resolution, select the value marked Recommended and press Keep changes only when the screen is normal.
고급 디스플레이에서 같은 모니터 이름을 선택하고 주사율을 지원 목록 안의: In Advanced Display, select the same monitor name and change the refresh rate to a value in the supported list. If you don't see the screen, don't press OK but wait to see if it returns to its original value.
Windows 키를 눌러 신뢰성 기록 보기를 검색하고 멈춘 날짜의 빨간: Press the Windows key, search for View reliability history and select the red X on the date the PC froze. Open View technical details and record the failed app, module and time.
Windows 키+R → eventvwr.msc → Enter → Win: Windows Key + R → eventvwr.msc → Enter → Windows Log → Double-click the error at the same time in the system. For app termination issues, check the application log and record the original, event ID, and general tab contents.
같은 드라이버·앱 이름이 반복되는지 비교하세요. 비정상 종료 뒤의 Ker: Compare whether the same driver/app name is repeated. Don't just look at the Kernel-Power records after the abnormal shutdown, but also check the device, disk, and app errors immediately before that.
Ctrl+Shift+Esc → 작업 관리자 → 프로세스에서 CPU·메모리: In Ctrl+Shift+Esc → Task Manager → Processes, click the CPU/Memory/Disk column headings to sort them in descending order. Keep track of which apps are consuming resources right before they stop.
성능 탭에서 해당 자원의 그래프를 확인하고 CPU·GPU 온도는 제조사: Check the graph of the corresponding resources in the Performance tab, and view the CPU and GPU temperatures separately in the sensor menu of the manufacturer's monitoring app. Do not judge a failure based on a momentary increase in usage rate.
같은 작업에서 사용률·온도 상승과 멈춤이 함께 반복되는지 비교하세요. 팬: Compare whether utilization/temperature rises and stops are repeated in the same task. If there is a fan stop, abnormal noise, or reading error, stop further load testing.
파일을 저장하고 시작 → 전원 → 다시 시작을 선택하세요. 절전 중 문제: Save the file and select Start → Power → Restart. Safely remove and disconnect any external storage devices that are causing problems during power saving, and remove any docked or unnecessary USB devices.
정상 부팅 뒤 작업을 저장하고 시작 → 전원 → 절전을 선택하세요. 이전: After booting normally, save your work and select Start → Power → Sleep. Wake it up with the same key/power button as before and see if the login screen returns.
Windows 키+R → msinfo32 → Enter로 시스템 모델을: Check the system model by pressing Windows key + R → msinfo32 → Enter and find the same model/chipset/graphics/network package for Windows on the PC manufacturer's support page.
장치 관리자(Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc 입력 → En: Device Manager (Windows key + R → type devmgmt.msc → Enter) → Device properties → Driver, write down the current version and date and apply only the required package. If the problem only started immediately after an update, compare supported rollbacks first.
Windows 키+I로 설정을 여세요. 설정 → Windows 업데이트에: Open Settings with Windows key+I. Complete the pending installation in Settings → Windows Update and then restart. Save your work, test sleep and wake up, and record any improvements you make.
Windows 키+R → msinfo32 → Enter에서 시스템 모델·: Windows Key + R → msinfo32 → Enter, enter the system model and BIOS version, and open the BIOS change history on the manufacturer's support page.
절전·복귀·Modern Standby와 관련된 수정인지, 현재 모델에 적: Please check whether the fix is related to sleep/wake-up/Modern Standby and applies to the current model. Do not change power settings or registry without the manufacturer's instructions.
업데이트가 필요하면 파일·BitLocker 복구 키를 확보하고 안정된 전: If an update is required, obtain your File/BitLocker recovery key and follow the model-specific procedures on a stable power source. After completion, compare under the same sleep/return conditions.
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 전원 및 배터리에서 전원 모드의 현재: In Windows Key+I → System → Power & Battery, write down the current value of the power mode and select Balanced if offered. Depending on your desktop/Windows version, the power menu name may be different.
PC 제조사 앱의 성능·냉각 메뉴에서 터보·성능을 표준으로 한 단계 낮추: In the Performance/Cooling menu of the PC manufacturer app, lower Turbo/Performance to standard and compare the temperature, fan sound, and completion time for the same task. If you don't have an entry, don't force yourself to create a profile you don't support.
Windows 키+R → msinfo32 → Enter에서 시스템 모델과: Windows Key + R → msinfo32 → Enter and write down the system model and BIOS version. Find the chipset, thermal management utility, and BIOS change details for the same model on the manufacturer's support page.
냉각·팬·전원 관련 수정 여부와 지원 OS를 확인하고 필요한 업데이트 하: Check whether there are any modifications related to cooling, fan, and power, as well as the supported OS, and apply only the necessary updates one by one. For BIOS, secure the file, BitLocker recovery key, and stable power source and then proceed with the manufacturer's procedures.
Windows 키를 눌러 PC 제조사 진단 앱을 열고 하드웨어 진단 →: Press the Windows key to open the PC manufacturer's diagnostic app and check whether the Hardware Diagnostics → Fan item is available. After running, record the fan rotation and error code.
If the fan does not run, grinding noises, or fan errors occur, stop high-load work. Only check for external blockage of the vent, and leave the internal cooler, heat sink, and thermal inspection to a service center according to the warranty conditions.
Steam·Epic 등 게임 런처의 라이브러리에서 해당 게임의 업데이트: Check the update waiting/download status of the game in the library of a game launcher such as Steam or Epic, and run the game after completion. Save the saved file/mode settings first.
GPU 드라이버는 장치 관리자(Windows 키+R → devmgmt.m: For GPU drivers, enter the version in Device Manager (Windows Key + R → Enter devmgmt.msc → Enter) → Display Adapter → GPU Properties → Driver, and check for stable packages for the same model from the PC/GPU manufacturer.
드라이버 변경 직후 시작됐다면 드라이버 롤백이 제공되는지 확인하세요. 게: If it started right after a driver change, check to see if driver rollback is available. Rather than changing game patches and drivers at the same time, compare each change one by one in the same scene.
Steam은 설정 → 게임 중의 Steam 오버레이 항목을, Discor: For Steam, check the Steam Overlay item in Settings → In-Game, and for Discord, check the Game Overlay item in User Settings. Record the current status of GPU app recording and in-game overlays. Menu names may vary depending on app version.
겹쳐 표시되는 오버레이 하나만 끄고 같은 게임 장면을 비교하세요. 효과가: Turn off just one overlapping overlay and compare scenes from the same game. If it doesn't work, restore and try a different overlay.
직접 적용한 CPU·GPU 튜닝은 해당 앱의 기본값으로, 메모리 XMP·: Compare directly applied CPU/GPU tuning with the app's default settings, and memory XMP/EXPO with the default settings in the BIOS memory menu. Do not input voltage arbitrarily if you do not know the original value.
제조사 모니터링 앱의 센서 화면에서 게임 중 CPU·GPU 온도·클럭·팬: Record CPU/GPU temperature, clock, and fan rotation during gaming on the sensor screen of the manufacturer's monitoring app. Compare gaming scenes such as idle and also check manufacturer limits.
노트북은 본체 사양에 맞는 정격 충전기를 연결하고 제조사 성능 모드를 기: For laptops, connect a charger rated for the body specifications and record the manufacturer's performance mode. Check the desktop power connection after shutting down and disconnecting the AC. If you are not familiar with disassembly, leave it to us.
If the GPU auxiliary power connector appears unconnected, discolored, or damaged, discontinue use. Do not open the power source or mix cables from different modular power sources.
작업을 저장하고 Windows 키를 눌러 Windows 메모리 진단을 검: Save your work and press the Windows key to search for Windows Memory Diagnostic. Restart now, select OK and the app will close. After rebooting, check Event Viewer (Windows key + R → type eventvwr.msc → Enter) → Windows Log → MemoryDiagnostics-Results in the system.
게임 런처에서 설치 폴더 위치를 확인한 뒤 파일 탐색기(Windows 키: Check the installation folder location in the game launcher, then open File Explorer (Windows key + E) → View the free space on the drive in My PC. Also record SMART warnings and status for the same drive model in the manufacturer's storage device diagnostic app.
메모리 오류면 기본 메모리 설정에서 모듈·슬롯 점검을 받으세요. 저장장치: If there is a memory error, check the module/slot in the basic memory settings. If there is a storage device read error or abnormal sound, stop the load test and back up important files first.
게임의 설정 → 그래픽·영상 메뉴를 열고 현재 해상도·텍스처·그림자·레이: Open the game's Settings → Graphics/Video menu and take a photo of the current resolution, texture, shadow, and ray tracing values. Compare at the same save point/scene.
우선 그림자나 레이 트레이싱 등 한 항목만 낮추고 적용하세요. 지원되는: First, turn down just one item, such as shadows or ray tracing, and apply it. If upscaling is supported, test the quality mode separately and record changes in FPS and quality.
확연히 개선되면 낮춘 항목의 GPU 부하를 원인 후보로 보세요. 그대로면: If there is a noticeable improvement, consider the GPU load of the lowered item as a likely cause. If it stays the same, restore the settings and check the CPU, memory, and storage usage.
Ctrl+Shift+Esc → 프로세스에서 CPU·메모리·디스크 열을 높: Ctrl+Shift+Esc → Sort the CPU, memory, and disk columns in the process from highest to lowest, and write down apps that use a lot of resources other than the current game.
저장할 파일을 저장한 뒤 브라우저·녹화 앱은 정상 종료하고 게임 런처의: After saving the file you want to save, close the browser and recording app normally and pause the download of the game launcher. Do not force-quit Windows·Security·Backup processes just by looking at their names.
같은 게임 장면에서 FPS·끊김을 비교한 뒤 필요한 앱과 다운로드를 다시: Compare FPS and stuttering in the same game scene, then turn on necessary apps and downloads again.
작업 표시줄 스피커 아이콘을 누르고 음소거 표시와 볼륨을 확인하세요. W: Press the taskbar speaker icon and check the mute indicator and volume. Windows key + I → System → Sound → Output, select the name of the speaker or headphone that is actually connected.
선택한 출력 장치의 테스트를 눌러 소리가 나는지 확인하세요. HDMI·모: Press Test on the selected output device to see if you can hear sound. Also check the device name to see if it was incorrectly selected as HDMI/monitor output.
소리 설정의 볼륨 믹서에서 문제 앱의 음소거·음량·출력 장치를 확인하세요: Check the mute, volume, and output device settings for the problematic app in the volume mixer in sound settings. If the Windows test is normal but the app is silent, first adjust the app settings.
유선 헤드폰의 플러그를 끝까지 꽂고 헤드폰 아이콘이 있는 단자인지 확인하: Plug your wired headphones all the way in and make sure the jack has the headphone icon on it. If there are front and rear terminals, compare them one by one, and connect the USB audio to another PC port without a hub.
Bluetooth는 설정 → Bluetooth 및 장치에서 해당 장치가: For Bluetooth, check that the device is connected in Settings → Bluetooth & devices. If you need to reconnect, remove the device, turn on pairing mode using the manufacturer's method, and select Add device → Bluetooth.
Windows 키+X → 장치 관리자(Windows 키+R → devmg: In Windows+X → Device Manager (Windows+R → Enter devmgmt.msc → Enter) → Sound, video and game controllers·Audio input and output, record the error code in the device name·General tab and the version·date in the driver tab.
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 소리 → 출력에서 연결된 정상 헤드폰: In Windows+I → System → Sound → Output, select the connected headphones/speakers and press Test. Compare the problem devices using the same sound source through the supported terminals of different PCs or mobile phones.
문제가 장치를 따라가면 케이블·장치 수리를, 이 PC에서만 발생하면 출력: If the problem is related to a device, repair the cable/device, or if it only occurs on this PC, check the output settings/port/driver.
충전 전용이 아닌 데이터 전송 케이블로 컨트롤러를 PC USB 포트에 직: Connect the controller directly to the PC USB port using a non-charging data transfer cable. Instead of going through the hub or docking device, check the connection sound and indicator light response.
Windows 키+R → joy.cpl → Enter로 게임 컨트롤러를: Open the game controller with Windows+R → joy.cpl → Enter. Check the reaction by pressing the button/stick in the device → Properties → Test. If it is not listed, compare other cables/ports.
Windows 키+I → Bluetooth 및 장치의 장치 목록에서 기존: From the device list under Windows+I → Bluetooth & Devices, select More → Remove device of the existing controller. Check the reconnection method and battery condition first.
컨트롤러의 제조사 설명서에 나온 페어링 버튼을 눌러 표시등이 검색 상태로: Press the pairing button listed in the controller's manufacturer's manual and see if the light blinks in search mode. Button combinations vary by model.
Windows의 장치 추가 → Bluetooth에서 정확한 컨트롤러 이름: In Windows, select the correct controller name under Add device → Bluetooth. After connecting, press Windows+R → joy.cpl → Enter → Test button in the device properties.
컨트롤러가 공식 지원하는 다른 PC·콘솔에 데이터 케이블 또는 제조사 페: Connect the controller to another officially supported PC or console using a data cable or manufacturer pairing procedure. Check if the same buttons/sticks work.
PC에서는 Windows 키+R → joy.cpl → Enter → 해당: On a PC, check the response with Windows+R → joy.cpl → Enter → Device properties → Test. If the same input fails on multiple devices, check firmware support/repair for each model.
Ctrl+Shift+Esc → 작업 관리자 → 프로세스에서 네트워크 열을: Ctrl+Shift+Esc → Task Manager → Processes, click the Network column to sort them in descending order. Check whether the download speed continues to increase on the download screen of the game launcher.
본인이 켠 런처 다운로드·클라우드 동기화·방송 송출을 각 앱의 일시 중지: Stop the launcher download, cloud synchronization, and broadcast transmission that you turned on by pausing each app and compare the delay and loss of the same server. Do not force stop security/Windows services, but resume the necessary tasks after comparison.
진행 중인 다운로드·원격 작업을 저장·종료하세요. 모뎀·공유기 뒷면 전원: Save/finish downloads/remote tasks in progress. Turn off the modem/router with the power cord or power switch on the back and wait 30 seconds. Do not press the RESET hole as it is a factory reset.
별도 모뎀이 있으면 먼저 켜고 인터넷·회선 표시등이 정상화될 때까지 기다: If you have a separate modem, turn it on first, wait until the Internet/line indicators normalize, and then turn on the router. For all-in-one type, restart only the device.
PC와 휴대폰에서 같은 사이트를 열어 비교하세요. 모든 기기가 여전히 안: Open the same site on your PC and mobile phone to compare. If all devices still do not work, write down the indicator light status and time of occurrence and contact your line provider.
게임의 네트워크 통계·지연 표시를 켜고 현재 서버 지역·핑·패킷 손실을: Turn on the game's network statistics/latency display and record the current server region, ping, and packet loss. Compare with other servers and games at the same time, but if the area is far away, the delay may be greater.
정상 LAN 케이블로 공유기에 직접 연결하고 다운로드가 없는 상태에서도: Connect directly to the router with a normal LAN cable and see if several games stutter in the same way even with no downloads. If it is also common on a wired line, request inspection of the router and line.
파일 저장 후 시작 → 전원 → 다시 시작을 선택하세요. Windows: After saving the file, select Start → Power → Restart. Check the free space on the drive where Windows is installed in Windows+I → System → Storage.
임시 파일 목록에서 필요한 다운로드·이전 설치 파일이 아닌지 검토한 뒤: Review the list of temporary files to see if they are necessary downloads or previous installation files, and then clean up only the selected items. To uninstall apps, use Settings → Apps → Installed apps and do not delete the Windows folder directly.
Windows 키+I → Windows 업데이트 → 업데이트 기록에서 증: In Windows+I → Windows Update → Update History, write down the KB number and date installed immediately before the symptom. Under Update Removal, check if the KB in question is removable and read the restore/restart implications.
부팅이 안 되면 접근 가능한 복구 화면의 문제 해결 → 고급 옵션 → 업: If it doesn't boot, check Troubleshooting → Advanced options → Uninstall updates on the accessible recovery screen. For system restore, go to Advanced Options → System Restore to check the restore point before the problem and the affected programs.
중요 파일과 BitLocker 복구 키를 확보한 뒤 적용하세요. 디스크: Secure your important files and BitLocker recovery key and apply them. Do not turn off the power while recording a disc or remove multiple KBs at once.
로그인 가능한 다른 관리자 계정이 있으면 시작 → 계정 메뉴에서 로그아웃: If there is another administrator account that can log in, log out from the Start → Account menu and compare the operation of the same app or explorer with that account.
본인 개인 PC에서 별도 계정 비교가 필요하면 설정 → 계정 → 다른 사: If you need to compare separate accounts on your personal PC, use the procedure to add a supported account in Settings → Accounts → Other users. For organization PCs, please ask your administrator and do not delete existing accounts.
새 계정에서만 정상이면 기존 프로필의 문서·바탕화면 등 중요 파일을 별도: If it is normal only in the new account, copy important files such as documents and desktops from the existing profile to a separate medium and consider recovery. Do not overwrite the entire existing user folder.
Ctrl+Shift+Esc로 작업 관리자를 열고 프로세스에서 Window: Open Task Manager with Ctrl+Shift+Esc and find Windows Explorer in Processes. After selecting, right-click → Restart. The taskbar may disappear briefly.
목록에 없으면 작업 관리자(Ctrl+Shift+Esc로 열기)의 새 작업: If it's not listed, under Run New Task in Task Manager (open as Ctrl+Shift+Esc), type explorer.exe and press Enter. In Windows 10, you may find Run New Task under the File menu.
작업 표시줄·시작 메뉴·폴더 창이 돌아오는지 확인하세요. 바로 다시 종료: Check whether the taskbar, start menu, and folder window return. If it shuts down again right away, check the Explorer error module in your reliability history.
Windows 키+I로 설정을 여세요. Windows 11은 Window: Open settings with Windows+I. For Windows 11, select Windows Update, and for Windows 10, select Update & Security → Check for updates under Windows Update.
다운로드·설치·다시 시작 필요 상태를 확인하고 파일을 저장한 뒤 다시 시: Check the download/installation/restart required status, save the file, and restart. If it fails, check the failure separately by writing down the KB number and error code in the update history on the same screen.
Windows 키+I → 앱 → 설치된 앱에서 해당 앱의 더보기 → 고급: In Windows+I → Apps → Installed apps, check More → Advanced options or modifications for the app. Windows 10 may be in Apps & Features and not all apps will have the same menu.
복구가 있으면 먼저 실행하고 같은 기능을 비교하세요. 초기화는 로그인·로: If there is a recovery, run it first and compare the same features. Reset may erase login and local app data, so do not press it until you have secured your account information and saved files.
고급 옵션이 없으면 제작사의 공식 설치 프로그램을 열어 복구·수정을 선택: If there are no advanced options, open the manufacturer's official installer and select Repair/Fix. Before reinstalling, keep your license, settings, and saved data and do not delete the app folder directly.
중요 파일을 다른 정상 드라이브에 복사해 열리는지 확인하세요. 파일 탐색: Copy important files to another healthy drive and see if they open. Open the check in File Explorer (open with Windows+E) → This PC → Right-click the target drive → Properties → Tools → Error check.
제조사 저장장치 진단 앱에서 같은 모델의 SMART 경고·미디어 오류를: Check SMART warnings and media errors for the same model in the manufacturer's storage device diagnostic app. If there are abnormal sounds or reading failures, stop repeating the test.
Windows 키+I로 설정을 여세요. 설정 → 앱 → 설치된 앱과 Wi: Open settings with Windows+I. Find the change just before the symptom in Settings → Apps → Installed apps and Windows Update → Update history. To restore the system, check the affected apps in the recovery options and review them after backing up.
First, check your Internet connection by accessing the regular website you normally open using your browser. If you have a VPN/proxy, compare only the connections allowed by your organization's policies and note that remote work may be interrupted.
Windows 키+I → 시간 및 언어 → 날짜 및 시간에서 자동 시간: Check the automatic time setting/time zone in Windows+I → Time & Language → Date & Time, and press Sync Now to see whether it is successful.
실패하면 Windows 키+R → services.msc → Enter: If it fails, double-click Windows+R → services.msc → Enter → Windows Time to check the status and errors. Compare only the start/restart supported on your personal PC and check with your administrator about your organization's time policy.
Windows가 열리면 설정 → 시스템 → 복구 → 고급 시작 → 지금: When Windows opens, open Settings → System → Recovery → Advanced startup → Restart now → Troubleshoot → Advanced options → UEFI firmware settings. Obtain your file/BitLocker recovery key first.
UEFI 항목이 없으면 모델 설명서의 전원 직후 Setup 키를 사용하세: If there is no UEFI entry, use the Setup key immediately after power on in your model's manual. Write down the date and time in the Main·Date/Time menu and compare it with the actual time. Do not change other storage or security settings.
시간을 수정했다면 변경을 저장하고 종료하세요. 전원을 껐다 켠 뒤 다시: If you have modified the time, save the changes and exit. Turn the power off and on again, compare whether the time is maintained, and check the RTC power on the repeated initial screen.
Windows 키+I → Windows 업데이트에서 설치·다시 시작 필요: Windows+I → Check the installation/restart required status in Windows Update and complete. Windows 10 is located under Updates & Security.
Windows 키+R → msinfo32 → Enter에서 시스템 모델·: Press Windows+R, type msinfo32 and press Enter. Note the system model and BIOS version shown in System Information. Compare the chipset and BIOS release notes for the same model and revision on the manufacturer support page.
Only apply updates that have been confirmed to fix current symptoms, following manufacturer procedures. Please ensure BIOS has a file/BitLocker recovery key and a stable power source, and do not turn off the power while recording.
Ctrl+Shift+Esc → 작업 관리자 → 프로세스에서 CPU 열을: Ctrl+Shift+Esc → Task Manager → Processes, click the CPU column to sort them in descending order. When symptoms occur, record the parent process name and usage rate.
If it is an ongoing task such as updating, encoding, or gaming, see if it goes down after completion. Performance → CPU allows you to compare overall and logical processor graphs and speeds.
본인이 켠 불필요한 앱만 저장 후 정상 종료해 비교하세요. Windows: Save only the unnecessary apps you turned on and then close them normally to compare. Do not force-quit Windows processes and security services just by looking at their names.
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 전원 및 배터리에서 전원 모드의 현재: Write down the current value of the power mode in Windows+I → System → Power and Battery. Check if the manufacturer’s management app also has separate power saving and performance modes.
Ctrl+Shift+Esc → 성능 → CPU에서 속도를 보고 같은 작업: Ctrl+Shift+Esc → Performance → Look at the speed on your CPU and compare it to the changes while running the same task. Low clocks at idle may be normal.
노트북은 정격 충전기를 연결해 같은 모드·작업에서 비교하세요. 부하 중에: For laptops, connect a rated charger and compare in the same mode/operation. If the speed is low even under load and the temperature is close to the limit, check cooling and power rather than forcing maximum performance.
Windows 키를 눌러 설치된 PC 제조사 모니터링·진단 앱을 열고 C: Press the Windows key to open the installed PC manufacturer monitoring and diagnostic app and find the CPU temperature, fan, and clock items. Task Manager (open with Ctrl+Shift+Esc) isn't the only way to check your CPU temperature.
유휴 상태와 원래 작업의 센서 값을 기록하고 해당 CPU·PC의 제조사: Record the sensor values during idle and original operation and compare them to the manufacturer's temperature limits for your CPU/PC. Check if the fan stops, temperature rises, and clock speed drops or turns off.
팬 정지·냄새·한계 온도면 부하를 중단하세요. 종료·전원 분리 후 외부: Stop the load if the fan stops, smells, or the temperature is limited. After shutting down and disconnecting the power, check the external ventilation holes, and leave the installation of the internal cooler and thermal inspection according to your disassembly experience and warranty conditions.
사용 중인 CPU·GPU 튜닝 앱을 열고 현재 프로필을 기록하세요. 기본: Open the CPU/GPU tuning app you are using and record the current profile. Revert only the overclock and undervolt that you applied directly with Default and Reset.
BIOS에서 바꾼 설정이면 모델 설명서의 CPU·전압 항목을 확인하고 변: If the settings have been changed in BIOS, check the CPU/voltage section in the model manual and restore only the changed values to default. If you don't know the original value, don't guess the voltage or do a full BIOS reset first.
한 변경씩 저장·재시작하고 같은 작업을 비교하세요. 기본 상태에서만 정상: Save and restart one change at a time and compare the same tasks. If only the default state is ok, don't auto-apply existing tuning again.
작업과 BitLocker 복구 키를 보관하고 BIOS로 들어가세요. Wi: Save your work and BitLocker recovery key and enter BIOS. In Windows, you can use Settings → System → Recovery → Advanced Startup → Restart Now → Troubleshoot → Advanced Options → UEFI Firmware Settings.
모델 설명서의 Memory·DRAM 메뉴에서 현재 XMP·EXPO 프로필: Take a picture of your current XMP·EXPO profile in the Memory·DRAM menu in the model manual. Turn off that profile and leave the memory speed at Auto/default, but do not change any other voltage/boot mode.
바꾼 항목을 저장해 재시작하고 오류가 나던 작업과 메모리 진단을 비교하세: Save your changes, restart, and compare memory diagnostics with the task that caused the error. If an error occurs even at the default value, do not increase the voltage but have the module/slot inspected.
시작 → 전원 → 종료 후 전원 케이블·충전기를 분리하세요. 내장 배터리: Start → Power → Shut down, then disconnect the power cable and charger. For models that require removal of the built-in battery, check the manufacturer's procedures and do not disassemble on your own.
정전기·보증 조건과 분해 경험을 확인한 뒤 RAM 홈 방향을 맞추고 설명: After checking the static electricity/warranty conditions and disassembly experience, orient the RAM groove and install it in the slot recommended in the manual. Check the model manual to see if the latch type is one-sided or both-sided, and do not press it forcibly.
양 끝이 완전히 들어갔는지 확인하고 부팅 후 작업 관리자(Ctrl+Shi: Make sure both ends are fully inserted, and after booting, look at the recognized capacity in Task Manager (open with Ctrl+Shift+Esc) → Performance → Memory. Disconnect the power supply before performing cross-checking of slots and modules.
종료·전원 분리 후 RAM 한 개만 설명서의 단일 모듈 권장 슬롯에 장착: After shutting down and disconnecting the power, install only one RAM into the single module slot recommended in the manual. If you are not familiar with disassembly or have a soldered memory model, do not attempt to replace it yourself.
한 모듈씩 같은 슬롯에서 부팅·메모리 진단 결과를 비교하고, 정상 모듈로: Compare the boot and memory diagnosis results in the same slot, one module at a time, and compare other supported slots with normal modules. Disconnect the power completely each time and write down the module/slot/fault results.
같은 슬롯에서 특정 모듈만 실패하면 모듈을, 같은 모듈이 특정 슬롯에서만: If only a specific module fails in the same slot, check the module, and if the same module fails only in a specific slot, check the slot/board as a candidate cause.
Windows 키+R → msinfo32 → Enter에서 메인보드·시스: Enter the motherboard/system model and BIOS version at Windows+R → msinfo32 → Enter. Also check the RAM product label for the exact part number.
메인보드·노트북 제조사 지원 페이지의 Memory QVL과 CPU 지원: Check whether the same model, revision, and module configuration is verified in the Memory QVL and CPU support list on the motherboard/laptop manufacturer's support page. Do not confirm a defect just because it is not on the list.
메모리 호환성 수정 BIOS가 필요하면 파일·BitLocker 복구 키·: If you need to modify memory compatibility BIOS, obtain a file, BitLocker recovery key, and stable power source and apply it using the manufacturer's procedures. Do not turn off the power during the update.
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 저장소에서 시스템 드라이브의 여유 공: Check the free space on the system drive in Windows+I → System → Storage. You can also view the space for each drive in File Explorer (open with Windows+E) → My PC.
임시 파일·휴지통·다운로드는 목록을 열어 필요한 파일이 없는지 검토한 뒤: Open the list of temporary files, recycle bin, and downloads to check if necessary files are missing, then delete only the selected items. Uninstall the app from Settings → Apps → Installed apps, and back up and move personal files.
파일 저장 후 시작 → 전원 → 다시 시작을 선택하고 같은 앱·파일을 열: After saving the file, select Start → Power → Restart and open the same app or file to compare response times.
외장 드라이브는 데이터 전송을 지원하는 정상 케이블로 USB 3.x 포트: Connect the external drive directly to the USB 3.x port using a normal cable that supports data transfer. Don't just judge the specifications based on the color blue, but also look at the specifications of the corresponding port in the PC manual.
내장 SATA 케이블 비교는 종료·전원 분리 후 진행하세요. M.2는 메: Compare the built-in SATA cable after shutting it down and disconnecting the power source. For M.2, check the motherboard manual for the slot's SATA/NVMe support and PCIe generation/lane sharing conditions.
같은 파일을 같은 방향으로 복사할 때 속도를 비교하세요. 모델·어댑터 연: Compare the speed when copying the same file in the same direction. Do not conclude that the drive is defective based on figures showing different model/adapter connection specifications.
Windows 키+R → msinfo32 → Enter에서 PC·메인보드: Enter the PC/motherboard model in Windows+R → msinfo32 → Enter and check the SSD model in Device Manager (Windows+R → Enter devmgmt.msc → Enter) → Disk Drive.
정확한 SSD 제조사 지원 앱에서 대상 모델·펌웨어 버전과 업데이트 설명: Check the target model/firmware version and update description in the correct SSD manufacturer support app. Find chipset and storage drivers for the same model on your PC manufacturer's support page.
중요 파일을 다른 정상 드라이브에 백업하고 안정된 전원에서 필요한 항목: Back up your important files to another healthy drive and apply only the items you need on a stable power source. Do not disconnect or power off during recording, or arbitrarily remove a storage controller that is booting normally.
장치 관리자(Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc 입력 → En: Device Manager (Windows+R → Enter devmgmt.msc → Enter) → Check the model name in the disk drive and select the same model and capacity in the manufacturer's diagnostic app. See the Status, SMART, Temperature, and Media Error items.
현재 값과 제조사 경고·교체 권고를 기록하세요. SMART 항목 이름과: Record current values and manufacturer warnings/replacement recommendations. SMART item names and thresholds differ for each device, so do not determine normality or failure based on numbers alone.
온도 상승·프리징·읽기 실패·SMART 경고가 함께 있으면 부하 검사를: If there is a combination of temperature rise, freezing, read failure, and SMART warning, stop the load test and back up important readable files first. Check if the file opens in another medium.
Windows 키+X → 디스크 관리를 선택하세요. 하단 디스크 번호·전: Select Windows+X → Disk Management. Look at the bottom disk number, total capacity, and partition and compare them with File Explorer (open with Windows+E) to find the target disk. You can check the model name by right-clicking → Properties.
온라인·RAW·미할당·정상 등 상태와 드라이브 문자를 적으세요. 데이터가: Write down the status and drive letter, such as online, RAW, unassigned, or normal. If the initialization/format window for the drive containing the data appears, cancel it and leave a record first.
기존 정상 데이터 볼륨에 문자만 없으면 그 볼륨 우클릭 → 드라이브 문자: If the existing normal data volume does not have a letter, right-click on the volume → Change drive letter and path. Do not touch the EFI/Recovery partition and do not create a volume if you are not sure whether it is a new blank disk.
외장 드라이브를 안전하게 꺼낸 뒤 다른 PC에 정상 데이터 케이블로 직접: Safely eject the external drive and connect it directly to another PC using a normal data cable. If a request for initialization or formatting appears, cancel it and only check the capacity and status in Disk Management (Windows+X → Open Disk Management).
내장 드라이브의 슬롯·케이블 비교는 종료·전원 분리와 지원 규격 확인 후: When comparing the slots and cables of the internal drive, proceed after shutting down/disconnecting the power source and checking the supported specifications. If the same drive has a 0GB/read error in a different environment, prioritize data recovery/device inspection over additional writing.
외장 저장장치는 진행 중인 복사를 마치고 작업 표시줄의 안전하게 꺼내기로: After finishing copying the external storage device, use Safe Eject on the taskbar to disconnect it. Remove the USB hub/docking device and connect the same device directly to the PC port.
다른 포트와 데이터 전송을 지원하는 정상 케이블을 하나씩 비교하세요. 충: Compare other ports and normal cables that support data transmission one by one. Do not judge that the data cable is normal based on the charging indicator alone. Check if the connection tone/indicator/device manager (Windows+R → devmgmt.msc input → Enter) error changes.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter로 장치 관리: Open Device Manager with Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter. Expand the Universal Serial Bus controller or its device category and double-click the device with a yellow warning.
일반 탭의 장치 상태·Code 번호를 적고 드라이버 탭의 공급자·버전·날: Write down the device status/code number in the general tab and check the provider/version/date in the driver tab. Compare whether the same code remains with other ports and data cables.
재설치 전에 제조사 지원 패키지와 대체 입력 수단을 확보하세요. 현재 키: Obtain the manufacturer's support package and alternative input method before reinstalling. Do not remove all USB parent controllers to which the keyboard, mouse, and storage device are currently connected.
Connect the device to the main USB port of another PC using a normal data cable. If it is a storage device, cancel the initialization/format request and check the capacity and status first in Disk Management (Windows+X → Open Disk Management).
입력·오디오 등 해당 기능을 같은 방식으로 시험하고 장치 관리자(Wind: Test the corresponding functions, such as input and audio, in the same way and write down the error code in the device manager (Windows+R → Enter devmgmt.msc → Enter). If the same failure repeats on multiple PCs, check for diagnostic, firmware, and repair support from the manufacturer of the exact model.
파일 탐색기(Windows 키+E로 열기)에서 문서·사진 등 대체할 수: In File Explorer (open with Windows+E), first select irreplaceable files such as documents and photos and copy them to a new folder on another normal storage device. Check a few copied files by opening them directly on the target device.
이상음·반복 연결 해제·읽기 실패가 있으면 같은 파일 복사를 무한 반복하: If there are abnormal sounds, repeated disconnections, or read failures, do not repeat copying the same file indefinitely. Do not write/benchmark/recover the original and receive consultation on recovering the data you need.
장치 관리자(Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc 입력 → En: Device Manager (Windows+R → type devmgmt.msc → Enter) → Write down the model in Disk Drive and open the manufacturer's supported diagnostic app. After checking the target model and capacity, record status, SMART, temperature, and media errors.
제조사가 제공하는 읽기 중심 진단의 설명을 확인하세요. 데이터가 필요하면: Check the description of reading-oriented diagnostics provided by the manufacturer. If you need data, do not select erase/secure erase/write test. If there is a warning, abnormal sound, or read failure, prioritize backup/replacement over testing.
경고가 반복되는 드라이브와 교체 대상의 모델·규격·용량을 확인하세요. 읽: Check the model, specifications, and capacity of the drive for which the warning is repeated and the replacement target. Copy important readable files to another healthy device first and see if they actually open.
소스 드라이브가 안정적으로 읽힐 때만 지원 도구의 복제 기능을 검토하세요: Review the support tool's cloning feature only when the source drive is reliably read. Contrast the source and target models and see the impact of deleting the target. If read errors repeat, recovery consultation is more important than unreasonable duplication.
새 장치에서 부팅·파일·앱 동작을 확인한 뒤 고장 의심 드라이브를 교체하: Check booting, files, and app operation on the new device, then replace the drive that is suspected to be malfunctioning. Don't leave an unstable drive as your only backup.
시작 버튼 우클릭 → 터미널(관리자)을 여세요. 메뉴가 없으면 cmd를: Right-click the Start button → Open Terminal (Administrator). If there is no menu, search for cmd and run it with administrator privileges. Enter ipconfig /all and press Enter to write down the DHCP usage, IPv4, default gateway, and DNS server of the adapter you are using.
본인 개인 PC의 DHCP 연결에서만 ipconfig /release 후: Execute ipconfig /release and then ipconfig /renew only on the DHCP connection of your personal PC to get the address again. As the connection will be lost, do not run it while remotely connected, using a static IP, or on an organizational network.
주소가 정상인데 도메인만 실패하면 ipconfig /flushdns를 입: If the address is normal but the domain fails, enter ipconfig /flushdns to check the results of deleting the DNS cache and open the same site again. For full Winsock/IP reset, save the VPN/static settings and review them at the end according to the support procedure.
Windows 키+I → 네트워크 및 인터넷에서 VPN·프록시 사용 상태: Windows+I → Write down the VPN/proxy usage status and original values on the network and Internet. After you're done working remotely, compare just the connections allowed in your personal environment.
보안 앱의 기록·웹 차단 메뉴에서 실패한 주소·발생 시각과 맞는 차단이: Check if there is a block that matches the failed address and time of occurrence in the security app's History/Web Blocking menu. Please check with your administrator for organizational policies and do not turn off firewall or anti-virus protection entirely.
네트워크 초기화는 Wi-Fi 암호·고정 IP·VPN·가상 스위치·드라이버: Consider resetting the network only after obtaining the Wi-Fi password, static IP, VPN, virtual switch, and driver files. Read the delete/restart warning in Settings → Network & Internet → Advanced network settings → Network reset.
Windows 키+A로 빠른 설정을 열고 비행기 모드가 꺼져 있는지 확인: Open Quick Settings with Windows+A and make sure Airplane Mode is turned off. Turn on the Wi-Fi button and see if it searches for a network to connect to. If there is no menu, check in Settings → Network & Internet.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → 네트워크: Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → Expand Network Adapters. Check if there is a wireless·Wireless·Wi-Fi device name and a down arrow/yellow warning.
장치가 있으면 속성 → 일반의 오류 코드를 기록하세요. Wi-Fi 토글과: If the device exists, record the error code in Properties → General. If both the Wi-Fi toggle and the device are missing, check the wireless switch/manufacturer drivers for your model and do not remove any other controllers.
현재 Wi-Fi 암호와 자동 연결 설정을 확보하세요. 조직 Wi-Fi는: Obtain your current Wi-Fi password and auto-connect settings. Organizational Wi-Fi may require certificate/account reset, so check with your administrator first.
Windows 키+I → 네트워크 및 인터넷 → Wi-Fi → 알려진 네: In Windows+I → Network and Internet → Wi-Fi → Manage known networks, select the correct network name and press Remove/Delete.
작업 표시줄 네트워크 아이콘에서 같은 Wi-Fi를 선택하고 암호를 입력해: Select the same Wi-Fi from the taskbar network icon and enter the password to connect. Check whether it's connected and access regular sites, and compare results from other devices.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → 네트워크: Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → Double-click the wireless device in Network Adapter. Record the version/date in the Driver tab and the device status in the General tab.
PC 제조사 지원 페이지에서 정확한 모델·Windows용 Wi-Fi 패키: Secure the exact model/Windows Wi-Fi package in advance from the PC manufacturer's support page. If the problem occurs only immediately after an update, make sure driver rollback is enabled.
전원 관리 탭이 제공되면 절전을 위해 끌 수 있음의 원래 상태를 적고 하: When the Power Management tab is provided, write down the original state of Can be turned off to save power and compare the return to sleep by changing just one. Don't force registry changes on models that don't have entries, and restore them if they don't work.
Wi-Fi 암호·고정 IP·VPN·가상 스위치·어댑터 드라이버 파일을 확: Secure the Wi-Fi password, static IP, VPN, virtual switch, and adapter driver files. The remote connection will be lost and may require a restart and reconfiguration. Please ask your administrator for an organization PC.
Windows 키+I → 네트워크 및 인터넷 → 고급 네트워크 설정 →: Open Windows+I → Network and Internet → Advanced network settings → Network reset. For Windows 10, check Reset Network under Status.
단순 DNS·케이블 점검으로 해결되지 않았고 재구성할 수 있을 때만 화면: Read the screen warning and do a factory reset only if a simple DNS/cable check did not resolve the issue and can be reconfigured. Save the file, restart, and restore and compare the Wi-Fi/VPN you need.
Chrome 메뉴의 새 시크릿 창·탭 또는 Edge 메뉴의 새 InPri: Open a new incognito window/tab from the Chrome menu or a new InPrivate window from the Edge menu and go to the same path starting from the site's starting address. On PC, you can also use Ctrl+Shift+N.
PC의 Chrome은 주소창에 chrome://extensions를 입력: For Chrome on your PC, enter chrome://extensions in the address bar. If it works only in Incognito, turn off the extensions in regular windows one by one, compare, and restore any ineffective changes.
다른 브라우저에서도 같은 주소가 실패하는지 비교하세요. 쿠키·캐시 삭제를: Compare whether the same address fails in other browsers. When considering deleting cookies and cache, target only the site in question and first check to see if logging in or losing content you were writing is possible.
시작 버튼 우클릭 → 터미널(관리자)을 여세요. 메뉴가 없으면 Windo: Right-click the Start button → Open Terminal (Administrator). If there is no menu, press the Windows key and select cmd → Run as administrator in the search bar. Organization PCs follow administrator policies.
ipconfig /flushdns를 입력하고 Enter를 누르세요. DN: Type ipconfig /flushdns and press Enter. Note the result or error statement that the DNS resolver cache has been emptied. This command is not a command to obtain a new IP address.
브라우저를 닫고 다시 열어 같은 주소를 입력하세요. 그대로면 다른 기기·: Close your browser and reopen it and enter the same address. If it remains the same, compare the results from other devices and networks and do not repeat the cache clear command.
Windows 키+I → 네트워크 및 인터넷에서 현재 VPN과 프록시 주: Windows+I → In Network and Internet, write down the current VPN and proxy address and automatic settings. After completing remote work/downloading, compare changes one by one only on connections permitted by policy.
보안 프로그램의 웹 보호·차단 기록에서 해당 사이트 주소와 같은 발생 시: Look at the event at the same time as the site address in the web protection/blocking record of your security program. Don't turn off protection entirely or install certificates from unknown sources.
회사·학교에서만 막히면 주소·오류 코드·시각을 관리자에게 전달하세요. 변: If it is blocked only at work or school, convey the address, error code, and time to the administrator. Restore any personal settings that have not changed to their original values.
Windows 키+A로 빠른 설정을 열어 비행기 모드가 꺼졌는지 확인하세: Open Quick Settings with Windows+A and make sure Airplane Mode is turned off. Windows+I → Turn off Bluetooth in Bluetooth and Devices and turn it back on after 10 seconds.
If there is no Bluetooth toggle, check the Bluetooth category and the error code of your wireless adapter in Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter. Rather than switching airplane mode repeatedly, check the wireless switch/driver for each model.
Windows 키+I → Bluetooth 및 장치에서 정확한 장치 이름: In Windows+I → Bluetooth & Devices, select More → Remove device with the exact device name. First secure the battery and pairing method for reconnection.
장치 설명서의 페어링 버튼·조합을 눌러 검색 표시등이 깜빡이는지 확인하세: Press the pairing button/combination in the device manual and check whether the search light blinks. If it is automatically connected to another device, such as a mobile phone, disconnect it properly.
Windows의 장치 추가 → Bluetooth에서 장치 이름을 선택하고: In Windows, select Add a device → Bluetooth, select the device name, and follow the confirmation steps displayed. Test the original functions, including actual sound and input, as well as the connected display.
Windows 키+R → services.msc → Enter로 서비스를: Open the service with Windows+R → services.msc → Enter. Double-click the Bluetooth enabled service and write down the service status, startup type, and errors. Manual (trigger start) may be normal, so do not change it to automatic.
개인 PC에서 연결 시 서비스 오류가 나는 경우에만 지원되는 시작·다시: Compare Start/Restart, which is supported only when a service error occurs when connecting from a personal PC. Check with your administrator if your organization's PC or Start button is blocked.
장치 관리자(Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc 입력 → En: Device Manager (Windows+R → Enter devmgmt.msc → Enter) → If there is power management in the Bluetooth adapter properties, change only one item related to power saving and compare reconnection after returning from power saving. Restore ineffective values.
Windows 키+Ctrl+O로 화상 키보드를 여세요. 키보드 입력이 불: Open the on-screen keyboard with Windows+Ctrl+O. If keyboard input is not possible, select Settings → Accessibility → Keyboard → On-Screen Keyboard with the mouse or use the accessibility button on the login screen.
메모장을 열고 화상 키보드와 실제 키보드로 같은 글자를 입력해 비교하세요: Open Notepad and compare the same letters by typing them using the on-screen keyboard and the physical keyboard. If possible, connect another working USB keyboard directly to the console port.
다른 키보드·화상 키보드는 정상인데 원래 키보드의 같은 키만 실패하면 물: If other keyboards/onscreen keyboards are normal but the same key on the original keyboard fails, check the physical keys/cables. If all inputs fail in one app, look at that app's input settings.
Windows 키+I → 시간 및 언어 → 언어 및 지역에서 실제 사용하: Check the actual language and keyboard layout in Windows+I → Time and language → Language and region. Change the input language to Windows+Space and enter the same letters in Notepad.
Windows 키+I로 설정을 여세요. 설정 → 접근성 → 키보드에서 필: Open settings with Windows+I. In Settings → Accessibility → Keyboard, write down the current status of filter keys and sticky keys, then turn off unintentionally turned on items one by one and compare. Windows 10 may have different accessibility menu names.
Windows 키를 누르고 검색창에서 제어판을 열고 키보드 → 속도의 반: Press the Windows key, open Control Panel in the search bar, and record the repeat delay/repeat speed in Keyboard → Speed. Distinguish between long presses and single presses in the test field and restore ineffective changes.
Windows 키+R → main.cpl → Enter로 마우스 속성을: Open the mouse properties with Windows+R → main.cpl → Enter and record the double-click speed on the button tab. Double-click the test folder icon to check whether it is open or closed.
한 번 눌렀는데 두 번 입력되는지도 파일 탐색기(Windows 키+E로: If you press it once but it is entered twice, compare it in File Explorer (open with Windows+E), another app, or another PC. A defective physical switch cannot be corrected just by setting the speed.
다른 PC에서도 같은 마우스의 한 번 입력이 두 번이면 수리·교체를 검토: If the same mouse inputs twice on different PCs, consider repair or replacement. If the problem is with only one app on this PC, check the click/open settings for that app.
노트북 키보드에서 터치패드 모양 아이콘이 있는 기능 키를 찾으세요. 제조: On your laptop keyboard, look for function keys with a touchpad icon. Press the corresponding key or combination with Fn once according to the manufacturer's instructions and check the screen display. Each model has different heights.
Windows 키+I → Bluetooth 및 장치 → 터치패드에서 켜짐: Check whether it is turned on in Windows+I → Bluetooth and devices → Touchpad. If it is difficult to operate with a mouse, connect a normal USB mouse and set it up. In Windows 10, check Devices → Touchpad.
연결된 USB 마우스·수신기를 빼거나 Bluetooth 설정에서 해당 마: Unplug the connected USB mouse/receiver or disconnect the mouse in Bluetooth settings. Check if the touchpad responds again.
Windows 키+I → Bluetooth 및 장치 → 터치패드에서 마우: In Windows+I → Bluetooth and Devices → Touchpad, see if the Maintain Touchpad item when connecting a mouse is provided. Check whether the manufacturer's input utility has a setting to turn off when connecting an external mouse.
원래 값을 기록하고 필요한 항목 하나만 바꿔 외장 마우스를 다시 연결해: Note the original values and compare by reconnecting the external mouse, changing only the necessary items. If there is no menu, check the driver/manual for your model.
파일과 BitLocker 복구 키를 확보하고 BIOS로 들어가세요. Wi: Obtain your files and BitLocker recovery key and enter BIOS. In Windows, you can use Settings → System → Recovery → Advanced Startup → Restart Now → Troubleshoot → Advanced Options → UEFI Firmware Settings.
제조사 설명서의 Internal Pointing Device·Touchp: Find the Internal Pointing Device·Touchpad section in the manufacturer's manual and record the current Enabled·Disabled values. Restore to Enabled only when you are clear that you disabled it yourself.
해당 항목이 없으면 다른 BIOS 항목을 바꾸지 말고 Windows의 터: If there is no such item, do not change other BIOS items but check the touchpad settings/support driver in Windows. Do not touch storage mode and security settings.
Windows 키+X → 디스크 관리를 여세요. 카드 삽입 전후에 추가되: Windows+X → Open Disk Management. Look at the disks added before and after inserting the card and write down the total capacity, partition, drive letter, RAW, and unallocated status.
동일한 용량의 디스크가 여러 개면 우클릭 → 속성의 모델과 카드리더기 연: If there are multiple disks with the same capacity, right-click → Check the model and card reader connection in Properties. Cancel requests to initialize or format cards with existing photos.
정상 파티션에 문자만 없을 때만 해당 볼륨의 드라이브 문자 및 경로 변경: Consider changing drive letters and paths for a volume only if the letter is not present on the healthy partition. If it is RAW, unallocated, or 0GB, do not create a new volume and first determine whether recovery is necessary.
화면 상단 카메라 렌즈 앞 물리 셔터가 닫혔는지 눈으로 확인하고 지원되는: Visually check whether the physical shutter in front of the camera lens at the top of the screen is closed and open it in a supported direction. Do not forcefully push the shutter/lens with a tool.
키보드의 카메라 아이콘 키와 본체 옆 프라이버시 스위치를 확인하세요. 모: Check the camera icon key on your keyboard and the privacy switch next to the console. Use the Fn combination/switch direction in your model's manual and see if the image changes in the Windows Camera app.
Windows 키+I → 개인정보 및 보안 → 카메라를 여세요. Wind: Open Windows+I → Privacy and Security → Camera. For Windows 10, check Privacy → Camera.
본인이 사용하려는 앱에 한해 카메라 액세스와 앱 액세스를 허용하세요. 목: Allow camera access and app access only to the apps you want to use. Also check the app-specific switches and Allow desktop apps in the list. If it's grayed out, check your organization's administrator policies.
문제 앱을 닫았다 열고 카메라 장치를 다시 선택하세요. 브라우저 회의라면: Close and open the problem app and select your camera device again. If it is a browser meeting, check whether the site's camera is allowed in the site permissions in the address bar.
Windows 키를 눌러 카메라를 검색해 Windows 카메라 앱을 여세: Press the Windows key, search for Camera, and open the Windows Camera app. If you have multiple cameras, use the switch button to select the problem device and check the video/error code.
회의·녹화·브라우저 앱 등 카메라를 사용할 수 있는 프로그램을 정상 종료: Normally close programs that use the camera, such as meetings, recording, or browser apps, and then test again. If you don't know the process name, don't just kill it in Task Manager (open with Ctrl+Shift+Esc).
Windows 카메라는 정상이고 한 앱만 실패하면 그 앱의 영상 설정에서: If the Windows camera is normal and only one app fails, check the device name and permissions in the video settings of that app. If all apps fail, check shutter, Windows permissions, connections, and drivers.
헤드셋 케이블·마이크 본체의 음소거 버튼과 표시등을 확인하세요. Wind: Check the mute button and indicator light on the headset cable and microphone body. Select the actual microphone name in Windows+I → System → Sound → Input.
마이크를 향해 말하면서 입력 볼륨·테스트 미터가 움직이는지 보세요. 지원: Speak into the microphone and see if the input volume/test meter moves. Listen to the results of supported microphone tests and recordings and adjust the input volume one by one.
미터가 움직이지 않으면 물리 음소거·잭·USB·권한을, Windows는: If the meter does not move, check the physical mute, jack, USB, and permissions. If Windows is normal but the app is unresponsive, check the app's input device and permissions.
Windows 키+I → 개인정보 및 보안 → 마이크를 여세요. Wind: Open Windows+I → Privacy and Security → Microphone. For Windows 10, check Privacy → Microphone.
본인이 사용할 앱에 필요한 마이크 액세스·앱별 허용과 데스크톱 앱 허용: Check the microphone access required for the app you want to use, the permission status for each app and the desktop app permission status. Ask your administrator for grayed-out organization policies.
브라우저 음성 서비스라면 주소창의 사이트 권한에서 그 사이트의 마이크 허: If it is a browser voice service, check the site permissions in the address bar to allow the microphone for that site. Close and open the app and compare the input meter in the sound settings with the app test.
PC의 헤드폰·마이크 아이콘을 보고 한 개의 콤보잭인지 초록·분홍 등 별: Look at the headphone and microphone icons on your PC and compare them with the manual to see if they are a single combo jack or separate terminals such as green or pink. Make sure it is not plugged into a terminal without a microphone.
4극 헤드셋을 분리 단자 PC에 연결할 때는 해당 규격의 헤드셋 분배기를: When connecting a 4-pole headset to a separate terminal PC, use a headset splitter of the corresponding standard. Do not confuse it with a regular earphone branch cable; connect your USB device to a different console port.
문제 마이크를 지원되는 다른 기기에 연결해 녹음하고 같은 말소리를 비교하: Connect the problem microphone to another supported device to record and compare the sound of the same speech. If the problem follows the device, check cable/microphone repair.
인쇄 중인 작업이 끝나거나 정상 취소됐는지 확인하고 프린터 전원 버튼으로: Check whether the printing job is finished or canceled properly and turn off the printer with the power button. Unplug the power plug for 30 seconds, then plug it in and turn it on.
Write down warnings such as paper jam, open cover, ink, and toner on the printer screen and indicators. To remove paper, follow the cover/proceeding directions in your model's manual and avoid touching hot internal parts.
USB 프린터는 케이블을 양쪽에서 다시 꽂고 허브 없이 다른 PC 본체: For USB printers, reconnect the cable from both ends and compare them to ports on another PC without a hub. Check whether it is a normal cable that supports data transmission.
무선 프린터는 프린터의 네트워크 정보·보고서 메뉴에서 Wi-Fi 이름·I: For wireless printers, look at the Wi-Fi name/IP in the printer's Network Information/Report menu and compare it to the current connection in Windows settings. Guest Wi-Fi or other networks may block communication between devices.
프린터가 지원하는 네트워크 테스트·연결 보고서를 출력해 연결 성공·오류를: Print a network test/connection report supported by the printer to check connection success/error. For shared printers and organizational networks, do not change the address arbitrarily and forward the results to the administrator.
Windows 키+I → Bluetooth 및 장치 → 프린터 및 스캐너: Select Windows+I → Bluetooth and devices → Printers and scanners → applicable printer → Open print queue. For Windows 10, check Devices → Printers and scanners.
Select and cancel only your own documents that have stopped, but do not delete other users' documents. If cancellation is not possible, compare Windows+R → services.msc → Enter → Right-click Print Spooler → Restart. Please ask your administrator for a shared printer.
프린터 속성의 테스트 페이지 인쇄를 한 번 실행해 목록에서 사라지고 실제: Try printing a test page in the printer properties once to see if it disappears from the list and actually prints. Do not arbitrarily delete the spool folder or registry.
Windows 키+I → Bluetooth 및 장치 → 프린터 및 스캐너: In Windows+I → Bluetooth and devices → Printers and scanners, write down the name, port, shared address, and basic settings of the problem printer. For organization-shared printers, check with your administrator for permission and method to reinstall them.
Obtain the manufacturer's installation package for the correct model and then uninstall only that printer. Do not delete all other shared printers and drivers.
프린터를 정상 재시작하고 프린터 및 스캐너 → 장치 추가 또는 제조사 설: Restart the printer normally and re-register using Printers & Scanners → Add Device or Manufacturer Installer. Make sure one test page actually appears.
Windows 키를 눌러 메모장을 열고 짧은 문장을 입력한 뒤 Ctrl+: Press the Windows key, search for Notepad and open it. Type a short sentence, then press Ctrl+P. Check the selected printer, paper size and page range, and print one page only.
프린터 속성의 테스트 페이지도 비교하세요. 다른 앱에서는 정상이라면 문제: Compare the test page from Printer Properties as well. If other apps print normally, record the printer, paper size and print area selected in the problem app, then restore one setting at a time.
BIOS 확인이 필요하면 파일·BitLocker 복구 키를 먼저 보관하세: Before checking BIOS, save your files and BitLocker recovery key. Immediately after powering on, press the Setup key specified in the model manual. Keys such as F2 and Delete vary by model. Photograph the original settings and change only the items described below.
위 조건에 해당해 메모리 검사를 진행할 때는 작업을 저장한 뒤 Windo: If the conditions above call for a memory test, save your work, press the Windows key, search for Windows Memory Diagnostic and open it. Select Restart now and check for problems. After restarting, press Windows+R, enter eventvwr.msc and press Enter. Open Windows Logs → System and check the MemoryDiagnostics-Results event.
본체 뒤 파워 모델·정격 라벨과 제조사·수리점의 전원부 진단: Power model/rating label on the back of the main body and power supply diagnosis by the manufacturer/repair shop

제조사 모니터링의 온도와 저장장치 진단 앱의 모델·SMART·미디어 오류: Temperature from manufacturer monitoring and model/SMART/media errors from storage device diagnostic app
블루스크린 화면의 중지 코드·What failed와 오류가 발생한 작업: Blue screen stop code/What failed and task with error
키보드의 Windows 키+Ctrl+Shift+B와 복구되는 화면: Windows+Ctrl+Shift+B on the keyboard and the screen being restored
Windows 키+P로 여는 출력 모드 선택 화면: Output mode selection screen opened with Windows+P
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc 입력 → Enter → 장: Enter Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → Device Manager → Display Adapter → GPU → Properties → Drivers and GPU manufacturer installer
모니터 영상 케이블·GPU 출력 포트와 전원을 분리한 본체의 GPU 보조: Monitor video cable/GPU output port and GPU auxiliary power/slot on the main unit separated from the power source
노트북 밑면과 데스크톱 주변의 흡기·배기 통풍구 및 설치 바닥: Intake/exhaust vents and installation floor on the bottom of the laptop and around the desktop
종료·전원 분리한 PC의 외부 통풍구와 제조사 청소 지침: Shutdown/unplugged PC's external vents and manufacturer's cleaning instructions
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 전원 및 배터리, 제조사 앱 → 성능: Windows+I → System → Power and Battery, Manufacturer App → Performance/Cooling Profile
게임 오류 창·게임 런처와 같은 저장 지점·장면: Save points/scenes such as game error windows/game launchers
Ctrl+Shift+Esc → 작업 관리자 → 프로세스와 게임 런처의 다: Ctrl+Shift+Esc → Task Manager → Download status of processes and game launcher
Windows 키 → 도움말 보기 검색·실행 → 소리 재생 문제 해결: Windows Key → View Help Search/Run → Solve sound playback problems
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc 입력 → Enter → 장: Enter Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → Device Manager → Sound, video and game controllers·audio input and output
컨트롤러 데이터 USB 케이블·PC 본체 포트, Windows 키+R →: Controller data USB cable/PC main port, Windows+R → joy.cpl → Enter → Test
컨트롤러가 지원하는 다른 PC·콘솔과 해당 장치의 버튼·스틱 테스트: Button/stick testing of other PCs/consoles and devices supported by the controller
PC의 유선 LAN·Wi-Fi 연결과 같은 게임 서버의 지연·손실 통계: Delay and loss statistics on game servers, such as PC wired LAN and Wi-Fi connections
Ctrl+Shift+Esc → 작업 관리자 → 프로세스 → 네트워크, 각: Ctrl+Shift+Esc → Task Manager → Process → Network, download/synchronization of each app
모뎀·공유기의 전원선·전원 스위치와 회선 상태등: Modem, router power line, power switch and line status, etc.
게임의 서버 지역·핑·패킷 손실 표시와 유선 연결: Indication of game server region, ping, packet loss and wired connection
Windows 키 → 도움말 보기 검색·실행 → Windows Updat: Windows Key → View Help Search/Run → Troubleshoot Windows Update
Windows 키+I → 계정 → 다른 사용자와 다른 계정의 로그인·동작: Windows+I → Account → Login/operation of other users and other accounts
Windows 키+R → msconfig → Enter → 서비스, Ct: Windows+R → msconfig → Enter → Service, Ctrl+Shift+Esc → Start App
파일 탐색기 → 드라이브 속성 → 도구 → 오류 검사, 제조사 SMART: File Explorer → Drive Properties → Tools → Error Check, manufacturer SMART and recently installed apps
Windows 키+I → 시간 및 언어 → 날짜 및 시간 → 지금 동기화: Windows+I → Time and language → Date and time → Sync now
현재 인터넷 연결, 날짜 및 시간의 동기화와 Windows 키+R → s: Current Internet connection, synchronization of date and time with Windows+R → services.msc → Enter → Windows Time
BIOS·UEFI → Main·Date/Time의 날짜와 시간: BIOS·UEFI → Date and time of Main·Date/Time
Ctrl+Shift+Esc → 작업 관리자 → 프로세스 → CPU, 성능: Ctrl+Shift+Esc → Task Manager → Processes → CPU, Performance → CPU
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 전원 및 배터리, Ctrl+Shift: Windows+I → System → Power and Battery, Ctrl+Shift+Esc → Performance → CPU Speed
Ctrl+Shift+Esc → 작업 관리자 → 디스크, Windows 키: Ctrl+Shift+Esc → Task Manager → Disk, Windows+R → resmon → Enter → Disk
SSD 제조사 앱 → 모델·펌웨어 버전과 PC 제조사 지원 페이지의 칩셋: SSD manufacturer app → Model/firmware version and chipset/storage package on PC manufacturer support page
해당 SSD·HDD 제조사 진단 앱 → 정확한 모델 → 상태·SMART·: Relevant SSD/HDD manufacturer diagnostic app → exact model → status/SMART/temperature
Windows 키+X → 디스크 관리 → 디스크 번호·용량·파티션·드라이: Windows+X → Disk Management → Disk number/capacity/partition/drive letter
다른 PC의 USB 포트·정상 데이터 케이블과 디스크 관리의 인식 상태: USB port of another PC, normal data cable and disk management recognition status
디스크 관리의 초기화·포맷 요청과 기존 파일의 복구 필요 여부: Disk management initialization/format request and recovery of existing files required
실제 USB 케이블·허브·PC 본체 포트와 안전하게 꺼내기: Safely remove the actual USB cable, hub, and PC port
시작 메뉴 → 전원 → 종료와 데스크톱 전원 케이블·노트북 주변기기: Start Menu → Power → Shutdown and desktop power cable/laptop peripherals
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → USB: Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → USB device properties → General/Driver
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → 해당 U: Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → corresponding USB hub properties → power management
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → 범용 직: Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → Universal serial bus controller and model-specific manufacturer package
다른 PC의 본체 포트와 해당 장치의 실제 입력·오디오·저장 기능: The main body port of another PC and the actual input, audio, and storage functions of the device
Windows 키+E → 파일 탐색기의 중요 파일과 별도 정상 저장장치의: Windows+E → Copy of important files in file explorer and a separate normal storage device
정확한 SSD·HDD 모델의 제조사 진단 앱 → 상태·SMART·읽기 중: Manufacturer diagnostic app for accurate SSD and HDD models → Status, SMART, and read-oriented inspection
저장장치의 SATA·USB 케이블·포트와 외장 장치의 정격 전원: Rated power of SATA/USB cable/port of storage device and external device
파일 탐색기 → 대상 드라이브 속성 → 도구 → 오류 검사와 관리자 터미: File Explorer → Target Drive Properties → Tools → Error Check and Administrator Terminal
원본·교체 드라이브의 모델·규격·용량과 다른 매체의 검증된 백업: Verified backup on media different from the model, specification, and capacity of the original/replacement drive
같은 네트워크에 연결한 휴대폰·다른 PC의 같은 사이트: Same site on a mobile phone or another PC connected to the same network
PC 시작 → 전원 → 다시 시작과 모뎀·공유기 전원: Start PC → Power → Restart and power on modem/router
시작 버튼 우클릭 → 터미널(관리자) → ipconfig의 DHCP·IP: Right-click the Start button → Terminal (Administrator) → DHCP/IP/Gateway/DNS results of ipconfig
Windows 키+A → 비행기 모드·Wi-Fi, 장치 관리자 → 네트워: Windows+A → Airplane Mode/Wi-Fi, Device Manager → Network Adapter
Windows 키+I → 네트워크 및 인터넷 → Wi-Fi → 알려진 네: Windows+I → Network and Internet → Wi-Fi → Manage known networks
같은 Wi-Fi의 다른 기기와 모뎀·공유기 전원·회선 표시등: Other devices and modem/router power/line indicators on the same Wi-Fi
Windows 키+I → 네트워크 및 인터넷 → 고급 네트워크 설정 →: Windows+I → Network and Internet → Advanced network settings → Network reset
같은 LAN 케이블·공유기 포트에 연결한 다른 PC·어댑터: Another PC/adapter connected to the same LAN cable/router port
시작 버튼 우클릭 → 터미널(관리자) → 유선 어댑터의 DHCP·IP·D: Right-click the Start button → Terminal (Administrator) → DHCP/IP/DNS results of the wired adapter
다른 사이트·브라우저와 같은 네트워크의 휴대폰: Cell phone on the same network as other sites/browsers

Windows 키+R → services.msc → Enter → Blu: Windows+R → services.msc → Enter → Bluetooth support service and adapter power management
키보드 USB 케이블·본체 포트와 무선 수신기·배터리: Keyboard USB cable, main body port, wireless receiver, battery
Windows 키+Ctrl+O → 화상 키보드, 메모장과 정상 USB 키: Windows+Ctrl+O → On-screen keyboard, notepad and normal USB keyboard
Windows 키+I → 시간 및 언어·접근성 → 키보드, 제어판 → 키: Windows+I → Time and Language/Accessibility → Keyboard, Control Panel → Keyboard → Speed
전원을 끈 키보드의 키 사이 이물질·액체 유입 흔적과 다른 PC의 입력: Traces of foreign matter or liquid entering the keys of the keyboard when the power is turned off and input from other PCs
터치패드 아이콘 기능 키와 Windows 키+I → Bluetooth 및: Touchpad icon function keys and Windows+I → Bluetooth and devices → Touchpad
외장 USB·Bluetooth 마우스 연결과 터치패드의 마우스 연결 시: Settings to use when connecting an external USB/Bluetooth mouse and a touchpad mouse
제조사 Setup 키로 여는 BIOS·UEFI → Touchpad·Int: BIOS·UEFI opened with manufacturer Setup key → Touchpad·Internal Pointing Device
Windows 키+X → 디스크 관리 → 삽입한 SD 카드의 용량·파티션: Windows+X → Disk Management → Capacity, partition, and text of the inserted SD card
사진·파일이 저장된 원본 카드·드라이브와 별도 정상 복구 대상: Subject to normal recovery separate from the original card/drive where photos/files are stored
렌즈 앞 물리 셔터·카메라 아이콘 기능 키·본체 프라이버시 스위치: Physical shutter/camera icon in front of lens Function key/body privacy switch
Windows 키+I → 개인정보 및 보안 → 카메라와 앱·사이트별 권한: Windows+I → Personal information and security → Camera, app, and site-specific permissions
Windows 키 → 카메라 검색·실행과 회의·녹화 앱의 장치 선택: Windows key → Search/launch camera and select device for meeting/recording app
외장 카메라 USB 케이블·본체 포트와 다른 PC의 카메라 앱: External camera USB cable/main port and camera app on a different PC
마이크 물리 음소거와 Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 소리 → 입력: Microphone physical mute and Windows+I → System → Sound → Input → Test
Windows 키+I → 개인정보 및 보안 → 마이크와 해당 앱·사이트: Windows+I → Personal information and security → Microphone and corresponding app/site permissions
문제 앱의 오디오 설정 → 마이크 이름·입력 볼륨·감도와 Windows: Audio settings of the problem app → Microphone name, input volume, sensitivity and Windows input meter
프린터 전원 버튼·전원선과 프린터 화면의 용지·커버·잉크·토너 경고: Paper, cover, ink, and toner warnings on the printer power button/power line and on the printer screen.
USB 케이블·PC 포트 또는 프린터의 Wi-Fi 이름·IP·네트워크 테: USB cable·PC port or printer's Wi-Fi name·IP·network test report
Windows 키+I → 프린터 및 스캐너 → 해당 프린터 → 인쇄 대기: Windows+I → Printers and scanners → Applicable printer → Print queue, services.msc → Print Spooler
Windows 키+I → Bluetooth 및 장치 → 프린터 및 스캐너: Windows+I → Bluetooth and devices → Printers and scanners → Remove/add device
제조사 모델별 설치 패키지, 프린터 속성의 드라이버·테스트 페이지와 스캐: Installation packages for each manufacturer and model, driver/test page of printer properties, and scanner preview
Windows 키 → 메모장 검색·실행 → Ctrl+P와 프린터 속성 →: Windows key → Search/run Notepad → Ctrl+P and printer properties → Test page
노트북 전원 버튼·충전기와 팽창한 배터리 주변의 안전한 보관 장소: Safe storage area around laptop power button/charger and swollen battery
정확한 노트북 모델의 제조사 서비스·배터리 회수 및 교체 절차: Manufacturer service/battery recovery and replacement procedures for the exact laptop model
호환 전원과 전원 초기화 절차 확인하기: Check compatible power sources and power reset procedures
노트북 충전 포트·정격 표시·제조사 모델별 전원 초기화 안내: Laptop charging port, rating indication, and power reset information by manufacturer and model
충전기를 분리해 케이블·포트 손상과 배터리 팽창을 확인하세요. 열·팽창·: Disconnect the charger and check for damage to cables/ports and battery swelling. If there is heat, expansion, or odor, do not charge and discontinue use.
정상 콘센트에서 제조사가 지원하는 전압·출력의 충전기를 지원 충전 포트에: Connect a charger with a voltage and output supported by the manufacturer to the supported charging port from a normal outlet. Just because USB-C looks the same doesn't mean it supports charging. Record the charging LED response.
반응이 없으면 제조사 모델별 전원 초기화 절차만 따르세요. 내장 배터리를: If there is no response, only follow the power reset procedure for each manufacturer and model. Do not disconnect the built-in battery or press the button repeatedly for an arbitrary period of time.
호환 충전기에서만 켜지면 기존 충전기·케이블을 점검하세요. 정상 전원에서: If it only turns on with a compatible charger, check the existing charger and cable. If both the LED and fan are unresponsive even with normal power, request a power circuit inspection instead of Windows recovery.
전원 차단 후 장착과 POST 반응 확인하기: Check installation and POST response after turning off the power
본체 전원 입력·CPU 보조전원·RAM 슬롯·메인보드 진단등: Main body power input, CPU auxiliary power, RAM slot, motherboard diagnostic light
꺼지거나 재시작되는 시간과 진단등을 한 번 기록한 뒤 전원을 끄고 콘센트: After recording the turn-off or restart time and the diagnostic light, turn off the power and disconnect it from the outlet. Don't keep turning it on again and again.
직접 조립 가능한 데스크톱만 설명서와 비교해 CPU 보조전원·CPU 냉각: For desktops that can be assembled yourself, check the CPU auxiliary power, CPU cooling fan connection, and RAM lock status by comparing them with the manual. Do not touch the inside of the power supply or the main body when it is turned on.
새 RAM을 추가한 직후라면 전원을 분리한 상태에서 원래 정상 구성으로: If you have just added new RAM, unplug and restore the original normal configuration. For DDR5 memory training latency, follow the model documentation and do not stop arbitrarily.
원래 구성에서 POST가 완료되면 추가 부품의 호환성과 장착을 확인하세요: Once POST completes in the original configuration, check compatibility and installation of additional parts. If it immediately turns off, smells, or stops the fan, stop retrying and have the power, cooling, and board checked.
경고음과 진단등을 모델 설명서와 대조하기: Compare warning sounds and diagnostic lights with your model's manual
메인보드 모델·리비전 설명서 → POST 경고음·CPU/DRAM/VGA/: Motherboard model/revision manual → POST warning sound/CPU/DRAM/VGA/BOOT indication
전원 직후 경고음의 길이·횟수와 최종적으로 계속 켜진 진단등을 기록하세요: Record the length and number of beeps immediately after power on and the final diagnostic light that stays on. Distinguish between indicators that turn on briefly during booting and indicators that stop.
Open the official documentation with the model/revision printed on your board to find the corresponding pattern. Do not apply beep tables from other manufacturers.
장착 점검은 전원을 끄고 플러그를 뽑은 뒤 해당 표시의 부품만 설명서대로: To check installation, turn off the power, unplug, and check only the parts with the corresponding mark according to the manual. If it shows BOOT and the BIOS screen opens, check the storage device model and Windows Boot Manager.
DRAM·VGA 표시가 바뀌거나 POST가 통과하는지 비교하세요. CPU: Compare whether the DRAM·VGA display changes or POST passes. If the CPU mark remains or the same pattern repeats, forward the record and model to the repair person before disassembling the socket or purchasing parts.
직접 설정한 안전 부팅 해제하기: Disabling the safe boot that you set yourself
복구 키와 계정 암호를 준비하세요. Windows 키+R → msconf: Have your recovery key and account password ready. Press Windows+R, enter msconfig and press Enter. On the Boot tab, check whether Safe boot is selected for the current Windows installation. Do not select it as part of this check.
직접 선택했던 안전 부팅만 해제하고 적용 → 확인 → 다시 시작을 누르세: Disable only the safe boot you selected and press Apply → OK → Restart. Do not tamper with organization management settings or other boot items.
선택이 없는데도 자동 복구로 되돌아가면 안전 모드 고정이 아닌 원래 부팅: If Automatic Repair returns even though Safe boot is not selected, investigate the original startup failure rather than a persistent Safe Mode setting. Record the on-screen code and recent changes.
정상 모드로 돌아오면 완료입니다. 정상 모드에서만 중단되면 안전 모드를: Once it returns to normal mode, you're done. If it only hangs in normal mode, investigate recent driver/app changes instead of keeping safe mode on.
부팅 복구와 실행 중인 Windows를 구분하기: Distinguish between boot recovery and running Windows
공식 Windows 설치 USB → 컴퓨터 복구 → 문제 해결 → 고급: Official Windows Installation USB → Repair Your Computer → Troubleshoot → Advanced Options
First prepare your BitLocker recovery key and a way to secure your important files. Immediately after powering on, open the BIOS with the Setup key to check if the system drive model is visible and do not switch the storage mode arbitrarily.
드라이브가 보이면 공식 설치 USB에서 컴퓨터 복구 → 문제 해결 → 고: If you see the drive, open Recover your computer from official installation USB → Troubleshoot → Advanced options. If it's a repeat immediately after an update, check to see if the most recent quality update item is available in Uninstall Update. For other boot failures, note the startup repair results.
정상 Windows로 돌아온 뒤에만 관리자 터미널의 DISM /Onlin: Only after returning to normal Windows can you use DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth and sfc /scannow in the administrator terminal. Do not guess the drive letter of the recovery environment as C: or delete the partition.
복구 후 정상 로그인과 다음 재부팅을 확인하세요. 드라이브가 BIOS에서: After recovery, check for normal login and next reboot. If the drive is missing from the BIOS or a read error remains, stop repeating the recovery and have a storage device/data recovery check.
탐색기 실행과 로그인 세션 비교하기: Comparing Explorer launch and login sessions
Ctrl+Alt+Delete → 작업 관리자, Ctrl+Shift+Esc: Ctrl+Alt+Delete → Task Manager, Ctrl+Shift+Esc → Run new task
로그인 뒤 검은 화면이면 Ctrl+Alt+Delete를 눌러 보안 화면이: If the screen is black after logging in, press Ctrl+Alt+Delete to see if the security screen opens. When it opens, select Task Manager, or press Ctrl+Shift+Esc.
프로세스에 Windows 탐색기가 있으면 우클릭 → 다시 시작을 선택하세: If the process includes Windows Explorer, right-click it → select Restart. If not, type explorer.exe in Run new task and press Enter. Selecting administrator privileges is not required.
바탕화면이 나타나면 파일을 저장하고 로그아웃 후 다시 로그인하세요. 기존: When the desktop appears, save the file, log out, and log in again. If you have an existing separate account, compare it to that account. Please do not delete your existing account/files to test your new account.
explorer.exe로만 복구되거나 다시 종료되면 셸·시작 앱 문제를: If it only recovers to explorer.exe or quits again, check for shell/startup app issues. If the security screen does not open or there is no video from the BIOS, check the output/booting status first, not the Explorer problem.
업데이트 직후 변경 하나만 되돌려 비교하기: Revert and compare just one change immediately after an update
장치 관리자 → 디스플레이 어댑터 → 드라이버, Windows 업데이트: Device Manager → Display Adapters → Drivers, Windows Update → Update History
Windows가 보일 때 Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc: When you see Windows, record the version and date in Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → Display adapter → applicable GPU properties → driver. If driver rollback is possible, only revert recent GPU changes.
롤백이 비활성이라면 PC·GPU 제조사의 해당 모델용 지원 패키지를 확인: If rollback is disabled, check the support package for your model from your PC/GPU manufacturer. If it was right after a Windows update, check Settings → Windows Update → Update History to check the KB at the time of failure and whether it can be removed. Don't delete unrelated updates.
로그인 화면도 없으면 다른 정상 출력이나 복구 화면으로 접근 가능한지 먼: If there is no login screen, first check if you can access another normal output or recovery screen. Enter Safe Mode when the startup settings are provided under Official Installation USB → Computer Recovery. If Windows won't turn on, don't run the online recovery command.
한 변경 뒤 같은 로그인·게임 장면을 비교하세요. 이전 지원 버전에서만: Compare the same login/game scene after making one change.
