If it works only on the previous supported version, please contact the manufacturer with the version and reproduction conditions. If there is no BIOS screen, output/POST checks take priority over driver rollback.
원래 값을 기록하세요. 시작 메뉴에서 NVIDIA 제어판의 G-SYNC: Record the original values. In the Start menu, check the Supported VRR menu of actual GPU apps, such as G-SYNC settings in NVIDIA Control Panel, Display → FreeSync in AMD Software, and corresponding display settings in Intel Graphics Software. The control command that opens the Windows Control Panel does not open GPU apps directly.
게임의 V-Sync, 지원되는 GPU 앱의 VRR, Windows 키+I: Change only one of V-Sync in the game, VRR in the supported GPU app, or HDR in Windows+I → System → Display and compare with the same scene, resolution, and refresh rate. The menu may not be available depending on GPU, driver, monitor, and output connections. Turn off the overlays one by one in the app's in-game settings.
게임 화면 설정, Windows 디스플레이 설정, NVIDIA·AMD·I: Game screen settings, Windows display settings, applicable GPU apps from NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel
확장 모드와 모니터 감지 확인하기: Check extended mode and monitor detection
두 모니터의 전원·입력 소스를 확인하고 Windows 키+P → 확장을: Check the power and input sources of both monitors and select Windows+P → Expand. Check the visible screen number by pressing Identification in Windows+I → System → Display.
여러 디스플레이의 감지를 실행하고 두 번째 화면이 있으면 선택해 연결·해: Run detection of multiple displays and select a second screen, if available, to check connectivity and resolution. If it is not displayed, compare each screen with the same normal cable/port.
독·변환기를 쓰면 GPU에 직접 연결해 비교하고 제조사의 동시 출력 수·: If you use a dock or adapter, connect the monitor directly to the GPU and compare. Check the supported number of simultaneous displays and resolutions. Multiple connectors do not guarantee that every output works simultaneously.
단독 연결은 둘 다 정상인데 동시 연결만 실패하면 독·대역폭·동시 출력: If both monitors work individually but fail together, check dock, bandwidth and simultaneous-output limits. If one monitor also fails on its own, check its cable, input and the monitor first.
사용자 깨우기와 화면 복귀 확인하기: Check manual wake-up and display recovery
시작 → 전원 → 절전, 키보드·전원 버튼, Windows 키+Ctrl+: Start → Power → Sleep, keyboard/power button, Windows+Ctrl+Shift+B
작업을 저장한 뒤 시작 → 전원 → 절전으로 진입하고 모델이 지원하는 전: After saving your work, go to Start → Power → Sleep and wake it up once with the power button or keyboard supported by your model. Distinguish between the power LED and the screen-off state.
본체가 깨어났는데 화면만 검으면 모니터 입력·직결 케이블을 확인하고 Wi: If the main body wakes up but the screen is black, check the monitor input/direct cable and try to restore the graphic display with Windows+Ctrl+Shift+B. Sounds and flashing may be heard during recovery.
For comparisons excluding specific docks and USB devices, please save and safely remove them. Do not disable wake-up permissions for the keyboard and mouse all at once if the problem cannot be restored.
본체는 살아 있고 영상만 실패하면 출력·GPU·독을, 전원 버튼으로도 못: If the main body is alive but video fails, check the output/GPU/dock, and if you cannot wake it up with the power button, check the power management/manufacturer-supported drivers. If a forced shutdown is necessary, consider losing unsaved data.
표시된 어댑터와 실제 연결 확인하기: Check the actual connection with the displayed adapter
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter로 장치 관리: Press Windows+R, enter devmgmt.msc and press Enter. In Device Manager, expand Display adapters and record each adapter name and error code. Distinguish Microsoft Basic Display Adapter from a device that is entirely absent.
기본 어댑터가 보이면 PC·GPU 제조사의 정확한 모델·Windows용: If you see the default adapter, install the correct model/Windows driver for your PC/GPU manufacturer. Also check whether the cable is connected to the external GPU port or the motherboard video port.
장치 자체가 없거나 POST의 VGA 표시가 남으면 데스크톱 전원을 분리: If the device itself is missing or the VGA mark remains on the POST, unplug the desktop and compare the auxiliary power and installation instructions with the manual. Check the manufacturer switching mode and supported drivers for your laptop's internal/external GPU.
정확한 GPU 이름·정상 장치 상태·영상 출력이 함께 돌아오는지 확인하세: Check whether the correct GPU name, normal device status, and video output are returned. Re-installing the driver alone may not solve the problem of hardware not being recognized.
GPU 모델과 설치 오류를 맞춰 확인하기: Match your GPU model with installation errors
설정 → 시스템 → 정보, 장치 관리자 → 디스플레이 어댑터, 설치 프로: Settings → System → About, Device Manager → Display Adapters, Installer Error Screen
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 정보에서 Windows 버전·시스템: Press Windows+I → System → About and note the Windows version and system type. Press Windows+R, enter devmgmt.msc and press Enter to check the GPU model.
PC 제조사 또는 GPU 제조사에서 그 모델·Windows·아키텍처를 지: Get a package that supports your model/Windows/architecture from your PC manufacturer or GPU manufacturer. Check if your laptop requires manufacturer-specified drivers.
다른 설치가 진행 중이면 완료 후 재시작하고 한 패키지만 실행하세요. 실: If another installation is in progress, restart after completion and run only one package. Record the failure code, unsupported hardware phrase, and log storage location and forward them to the manufacturer. Do not arbitrarily delete the registry/driver repository.
설치 완료 후 GPU 이름·버전과 같은 작업의 실행을 확인하세요. 지원: After installation is complete, check the execution of tasks such as GPU name and version. Unsupported packages will not be resolved with administrator privileges or repeated execution.
Compare temperature, fan noise and completion time or FPS before and after the change under the same workload. Lower heat and noise with acceptable performance is a mitigation. If the fan still stops or protective shutdowns continue, stop the workload and have the cooling system checked.
GPU 엔진과 프레임 제한·CPU 부하 비교하기: Comparing GPU engines with frame limits and CPU load
Ctrl+Shift+Esc → 프로세스에서 열 머리글을 우클릭해 GPU·: Ctrl+Shift+Esc → Right-click the column header in Process to display GPU/GPU Engine. Make sure the GPU 3D graph in the Performance tab matches the GPU the game is using.
같은 장면에서 V-Sync·프레임 제한의 현재 값을 기록하고 한 항목만: Record the current values of V-Sync/Frame Limit in the same scene and compare by changing just one item. If you've already reached your target FPS, low GPU utilization may not be an abnormality.
성능 → CPU 그래프를 우클릭해 논리 프로세서를 표시하고 일부 코어 포: Performance → Right-click the CPU graph to display logical processors and compare some core saturation, temperature, and clocks. For laptops, check the charging status and select GPU for each app in Settings → System → Display → Graphics.
CPU 코어 포화·FPS 제한·다른 GPU 사용 여부로 병목을 구분하세요: Identify bottlenecks by CPU core saturation, FPS limits, or use of other GPUs. Don't assume that a GPU has failed or needs to be replaced based on low GPU utilization alone.
바탕화면·작업 표시줄·탐색기가 다시 반응하는지 확인하세요. 곧바로 다시: Check if the desktop, taskbar, and explorer respond again. If it quits again immediately, investigate the app error and shell extension/user account scope at the same time.
검색창 무반응과 파일 누락을 나누기: Separate search box unresponsiveness and missing files
설정 → 개인 정보 및 보안 → Windows 검색, 인덱싱 옵션 → 고: Settings → Privacy and Security → Windows Search and Indexing Options → Advanced
시작 메뉴 검색창이 열리지 않는지, 검색창은 열리는데 특정 파일만 없는지: Check whether the Start menu search box does not open or whether the search box opens but only certain files are missing. Ctrl+Shift+Esc → Windows Explorer → Restart and compare the search box response.
파일만 누락되면 설정 → 개인 정보 및 보안 → Windows 검색에서: If only the file is missing, check the inclusion/exclusion locations and indexing status in Settings → Privacy and Security → Windows Search. For Windows 10, check Search → Windows Search.
포함된 로컬 폴더의 파일도 계속 누락되고 인덱싱이 멈췄다면 고급 인덱싱: If files in an included local folder remain missing and indexing is stalled, open Advanced indexing options → Advanced → Rebuild. Leave the PC powered on until rebuilding completes. For cloud-only files, also check the provider search and sync status.
색인 완료 후 같은 파일 이름으로 다시 검색하세요. 검색창 자체가 계속: After indexing is complete, search again with the same file name. If the search box itself keeps closing, don't repeat index rebuild and check the app error and user account scope at the same time.
실행 중인 Windows의 DISM·SFC 결과 확인하기: Check the DISM·SFC results of running Windows
시작 버튼 우클릭 → 터미널(관리자), Windows Logs → CBS: Right-click the Start button → Terminal (Administrator), Windows Logs → CBS·DISM
저장장치 이상음·읽기 실패가 있으면 검사를 멈추고 파일 확보를 우선하세요: If there is a storage device abnormal sound or read failure, stop the scan and prioritize securing files. Open an administrator terminal only when Windows is running normally. If not, search for cmd → select Run as administrator.
DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHeal: Run DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth, wait for the completion message, then run sfc /scannow. Record each result/code and restart.
복구 불가나 원본 오류가 남으면 %windir%\\Logs\\CBS\\C: If repair fails or a repair-source error remains, keep the entries at the failure time in %windir%\Logs\CBS\CBS.log and %windir%\Logs\DISM\dism.log. In WinRE, /Online targets the recovery environment, not the installed Windows system; do not reuse this command there.
복구 완료 후 원래 기능을 다시 확인하세요. 같은 파일 손상이 재발하면: After recovery is complete, check the original functionality again. If the same file damage recurs, check the storage device, memory, and recent program changes, and do not judge that there is no problem based on the success message.
Windows 에디션과 라이선스 상태 확인하기: Check your Windows edition and license status
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 정품 인증, Windows 10은 업: Windows+I → System → Activation, Windows 10 Update and Security → Activation
Windows 키+I로 설정을 열고 정품 인증에서 Windows Home: Open Settings with Windows+I and under Activation, note the Windows Home·Pro edition, activation status, and error code. Don't share your product key.
본인이 가진 라이선스가 현재 에디션과 일치하는지 확인하세요. 디지털 라이: Make sure your license matches your current edition. Sign in with the Microsoft account you linked your digital license to and run the Troubleshoot button when provided.
메인보드를 바꾼 뒤라면 문제 해결의 최근 하드웨어 변경 항목에서 본인 장: If you replaced the motherboard, use the recent hardware change option in the Activation troubleshooter and select your own device. For company or school volume activation, contact the administrator.
인증됨으로 바뀌면 종료하세요. 에디션 불일치·사용 제한·조직 서버 오류가: Stop when the status becomes Activated. If an edition mismatch, license restriction or organization activation error remains, contact the seller or Microsoft with the error code and proof of purchase. Do not use activation bypass tools.
초기화 실패 위치와 복구 진입 여부 확인하기: Check where Reset this PC fails and whether recovery is accessible
설정 → 시스템 → 복구 → 이 PC 초기화, WinRE → 문제 해결: Settings → System → Recovery → Reset this PC, WinRE → Troubleshooting → Reset this PC
개인 파일을 다른 드라이브에 백업하고 BitLocker 복구 키를 확보하: Back up your personal files to another drive and obtain your BitLocker recovery key. Keep My Files is not a backup and may remove apps and settings you have installed.
Windows가 열리면 Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 복구 → 이: When Windows opens, open Windows+I → System → Recovery → Reset this PC. If it doesn't open, enter WinRE by repairing your computer from the official installation USB. Record the selected target, failure code, and progress.
저장장치가 안정적이고 백업을 확인한 경우에만 로컬 재설치와 클라우드 다운: Only if your storage device is stable and you have verified backups, check the difference between local reinstallation and cloud download to compare different methods. Downloading requires internet and free space and does not mean deleting partitions.
같은 지점에서 다시 실패하면 반복 초기화를 멈추고 실패 코드로 복구 설치: If it fails again at the same point, stop repeated initialization and check the failure code to see if a recovery installation is possible. If there is a drive read error or recognition failure, prioritize securing files over reinstallation.
복원 지점과 영향을 받는 앱 확인하기: Check restore points and affected apps
작업과 개인 파일을 백업하고 복구 키를 확보하세요. 시스템 복원은 개인: Back up your work and personal files and obtain a recovery key. System Restore is not a substitute for a separate backup of your personal files.
Windows 키+R → rstrui.exe → Enter로 시스템 복원: Open System Restore with Windows+R → rstrui.exe → Enter. Select the point before the problem occurred and click Search for affected programs to see which apps and drivers will be removed and restored.
실패 코드·복원 지점 날짜를 적으세요. Windows가 열리지 않으면 공: Record the failure code and restore-point date. If Windows will not start, boot official installation media and choose Repair your computer → Troubleshoot → Advanced options → System Restore, then confirm the target Windows installation. Without a restore point, this method is unavailable.
완료 후 원래 증상과 필요한 앱을 확인하세요. 같은 코드로 실패하면 복원: After completion, check the original symptoms and required apps. If the same code fails, get recovery support tailored to your code rather than repeatedly applying restore points or disabling protection.
프로세스별 증가량과 종료 후 반환 확인하기: Check the increase in each process and the return after completion
Ctrl+Shift+Esc로 작업 관리자를 열고 프로세스의 메모리 열을: Press Ctrl+Shift+Esc to open Task Manager. On Processes, click Memory to sort descending. At the same time, record In use, Available and Committed under Performance → Memory.
같은 앱에서 같은 작업을 시작한 직후와 10분 뒤를 비교하세요. 파일을: Compare immediately after starting the same task in the same app and 10 minutes later. Save the file, close the app normally, and see if the available memory returns. Do not force-quit Windows core processes.
특정 앱의 점유가 계속 증가하면 앱 업데이트 후 확장 기능을 하나씩 제외: If the occupancy of a specific app continues to increase, after updating the app, exclude the extensions one by one and compare them. If the app total and overall usage shown in Task Manager are different, driver pool/shared memory may also be the cause, so please forward the records to support.
한 앱의 종료 후 점유가 줄면 그 앱부터 조사하세요. 캐시가 많다는 이유: If occupancy decreases after one app is terminated, investigate that app first. Don't assume it's a leak just because there's a lot of cache. Only perform separate RAM diagnostics when random crashes or memory errors occur together.
저장소 분류와 증가하는 파일 위치 확인하기: Categorize storage and check growing file locations
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 저장소 → 임시 파일·정리 권장 사항: Windows+I → System → Storage → Temporary files/cleanup recommendations
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 저장소에서 설치된 앱·임시 파일·기타: Windows+I → System → Storage, open the large category among installed apps, temporary files, and other and record the usage. Do not delete the Windows folder or WinSxS directly.
임시 파일을 열어 항목별 설명과 용량을 확인하세요. 다운로드·휴지통·이전: Open the temporary file to check the description and capacity of each item. For Downloads, Recycle Bin, and previous Windows installations, select them after checking the files you need or the possibility of reverting them. Remove only selected items.
정리 전후 C:의 여유 공간과 하루 뒤 수치를 비교하세요. 특정 폴더가: Compare the free space in C: before and after cleanup with the numbers a day later. If a specific folder grows again, separate app logs, dumps, and downloads by size/modification date in Explorer and use the app's organization/storage settings.
여유 공간이 유지되면 정리를 마치세요. 같은 앱의 파일이 계속 증가하면: Once you have some free space, finish decluttering. If the files in the same app continue to grow, update the app and investigate the cause of the log generation. Do not change the owner or delete system files.
지원 저장장치 규격과 BIOS 인식 확인하기: Check supported storage device specifications and BIOS recognition
모델별 BIOS → Storage·NVMe Configuration, 보: BIOS by model → Storage·NVMe Configuration, board slot support table
전원 직후 제조사 설명서의 F2·Delete 등 Setup 키로 BIOS: Immediately after powering on, open the BIOS using the Setup key, such as F2 or Delete in the manufacturer's manual, and find your SSD model in the Storage·NVMe list. There is a difference between not being in the boot list and not having the device itself.
메인보드 설명서에서 해당 슬롯이 SATA·NVMe 중 무엇을 지원하는지,: Check your motherboard manual to see whether the slot supports SATA or NVMe and whether it shares lanes with other slots or SATA ports in use.
전원을 끄고 플러그를 분리한 뒤 장착 가능한 모델만 SSD·SATA 전원: Turn off the power, disconnect the plug, and check the SSD/SATA power and data cables only for models that can be installed. Compare conditions one by one with other supported ports or normal compatible devices. Do not initialize your existing SSD.
BIOS에서도 계속 없으면 장치·슬롯·전원 경로 점검이 필요합니다. BI: If it is still missing in BIOS, you need to check the device/slot/power path. Only after your model appears in BIOS do you proceed to Windows Disk Management or boot issues.
Windows 키+R → diskmgmt.msc → Enter → 디스크: Windows+R → diskmgmt.msc → Enter → Disk number/capacity/partition/drive letter
대상 모델·용량·파티션·드라이브 문자를 확인하고 파일을 실제로 열어 보세: Check the target model, capacity, partition, and drive letter and actually open the file. Do not judge data disks based on whether they boot Windows. If it is 0 bytes, RAW, or unallocated, check whether the existing data is needed and stop initializing/formatting.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter로 장치 관리: Check the current device status and error code in Device Manager with Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter. Compare actual functions such as keyboard input, audio playback, and camera preview. Check disk recognition and file reading only when it is a storage device, and secure the necessary data first.
새 빈 디스크와 데이터가 사라진 디스크 구분하기: Distinguish a new blank disk from a disk whose existing data has disappeared
Windows 키+R → diskmgmt.msc → Enter로 디스크: Windows+R → diskmgmt.msc → Open Disk Management with Enter and check the target number, model, and total capacity. If the disk where the existing file was located suddenly becomes unallocated, stop writing and do not initialize/new volume/format.
본인이 확인한 새 빈 디스크이거나 데이터 삭제가 허용된 대상일 때만 진행: Proceed only if the disk is new and blank, or if data deletion is permitted. If it is not initialized, right-click the name on the left of the disk → Initialize disk and select the GPT that suits your environment. Check your destination number again.
검은색 할당되지 않음 영역을 우클릭 → 새 단순 볼륨 → 크기 → 드라이: Right-click the black unallocated area → select New Simple Volume → Size → Drive Letter → File System. For Windows only, select NTFS, or for sharing with other devices, check the compatibility conditions and select exFAT. Formatting makes it difficult to recover target data.
새 드라이브 문자가 탐색기에 보이고 작은 시험 파일을 저장·다시 열 수: Verify that the new drive letter is visible in Explorer and that you can save and reopen the small test file. If there is an I/O error or capacity error, stop additional writing.
CPU 지원 BIOS와 보조전원 확인하기: Check CPU support BIOS and auxiliary power source
메인보드 CPU 지원 목록·최소 BIOS 버전·CPU 전원 커넥터: Motherboard CPU support list·Minimum BIOS version·CPU power connector
메인보드의 정확한 모델·리비전과 새 CPU 모델을 적고 공식 CPU 지원: Please note the exact model/revision of your motherboard and the new CPU model and check the official CPU support list for the minimum BIOS version required.
전원을 분리하고 CPU 보조전원과 냉각팬 연결을 설명서와 비교하세요. 소: Disconnect the power source and compare the CPU auxiliary power and cooling fan connections with the manual. Do not touch the socket pins or contacts with your hands.
지원 BIOS가 필요한데 POST가 안 되면 해당 보드가 지원하는 전용: If you need a supported BIOS but POST does not work, use the dedicated BIOS Flashback procedure supported by your board or a repair shop. Don't try to run the Windows Update tool without a screen.
CPU가 지원되지 않거나 BIOS가 낮으면 호환 조건부터 해결하세요. 지: If your CPU is not supported or your BIOS is low, first resolve the compatibility conditions. If the CPU diagnostic light remains even if you meet the support conditions, request socket, power, and CPU inspection.
원래 RAM 구성과 지원 슬롯으로 비교하기: Compare by original RAM configuration and supported slots
메인보드 메모리 지원 목록·권장 슬롯·메모리 훈련 안내: Motherboard memory support list/recommended slots/memory training guide
설명서의 메모리 훈련 대기 시간 동안 기다린 뒤에도 POST가 안 되는지: Check if POST does not work even after waiting for the memory training wait time in the manual. Do not turn off the power repeatedly during normal training.
전원을 끄고 플러그를 분리한 뒤 원래 정상 작동하던 RAM 구성으로 되돌: Turn off the power, unplug it, and return it to its original, working RAM configuration. For single module testing, use the slot recommended in the manual.
원래 구성에서 BIOS가 열리면 현재 메모리 프로필을 기록하고 XMP·E: Once the BIOS opens in the original configuration, note the current memory profile and compare the new module to the default settings with XMP·EXPO turned off. Reset the CMOS in a non-bootable state only if you have obtained the recovery key and model-specific instructions.
기존 RAM만 정상이라면 새 키트의 지원 용량·세대·혼용 여부를 확인하세: If only the original RAM works, check the new kit capacity, generation and whether mixed modules are supported. If none of the modules passes POST, have the slots, seating and motherboard checked.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter로 장치 관리: Open Device Manager with Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter and expand Network Adapters·Bluetooth. Write down the device name and error code in Properties → General and distinguish the current device from the gray past history in View → Show hidden devices.
Only if the current device is disabled, right-click → select Enable Device. For unknown devices, check Properties → Details → Hardware ID to check the chipset and wireless drivers for that model from the PC manufacturer.
목록 자체에 없으면 비행기 모드·제조사 무선 스위치와 BIOS의 해당 무: If it is not in the list itself, check the airplane mode/manufacturer wireless switch and the corresponding wireless settings in BIOS according to the model instructions. Do not delete pairing, delete Wi-Fi profile, or reset IP until it is recognized.
현재 어댑터가 정상 표시된 뒤 네트워크·Bluetooth 목록을 확인하세: After the current adapter is displayed as normal, check the network/Bluetooth list. If it persists, checking the device/power/driver path takes priority over the connection profile.
같은 조건에서 무선과 유선 속도 비교하기: Compare wireless and wired speeds under the same conditions
설정 → 네트워크 및 인터넷 → Wi-Fi 속성, 동일한 속도 측정 서버: Settings → Network & Internet → Wi-Fi properties, same speed measurement server
대용량 다운로드·업로드를 멈추고 같은 PC·서버·시간대에서 속도와 지연을: Pause large downloads and uploads, then record speed and latency twice using the same PC, test server and time period. Compare VPN connected and disconnected only where your personal network permits it.
공유기 가까이에서 현재 Wi-Fi 대역·연결 속도를 확인하고 지원되는 5: Check the current Wi-Fi band/connection speed near your router and compare it to the supported 5GHz or 6GHz. Connection speed is not the same as actual internet speed.
같은 공유기에 유선으로 연결해 같은 서버에서 비교하세요. 무선만 느리면: Connect to the same router by wire and compare on the same server. If only the wireless is slow, check the distance, interference, and adapter. If both are slow, check other device traffic, lines, and target servers.
비교할 때 한 조건만 바꾸세요. DNS 캐시 삭제는 무선 대역폭이나 전파: When comparing, change just one condition. Clearing your DNS cache does not directly improve wireless bandwidth or interference.
양쪽 포트와 케이블의 링크 속도 확인하기: Check the link speed of both ports and cables
설정 → 네트워크 및 인터넷 → 이더넷, 장치 관리자 → 네트워크 어댑터: Settings → Network and Internet → Ethernet, Device Manager → Network adapter properties
Windows 키+I → 네트워크 및 인터넷 → 이더넷에서 링크 속도 송: Windows+I → Network and Internet → Record the link speed transmission and reception values in Ethernet and check whether both ports on the PC and router support 1Gbps or more.
정상 Cat5e 이상 케이블 하나로 직접 연결해 비교하세요. 중간 벽단자: Compare by directly connecting with a single normal Cat5e or higher cable. Bypass the middle wall terminal/hub and try switching to another gigabit port.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → 네트워크: Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → Network Adapter → Your device properties → Advanced, if the speed and duplex are provided, write down the current values and enable auto-negotiation. Don't force a speed that isn't supported.
1Gbps로 협상되면 같은 서버의 실제 전송을 확인하세요. 지원 포트·정: If the link negotiates at 1Gbps, check actual transfer to the same server. If it remains at 100Mbps despite supported ports and a known-good cable, inspect the connectors and adapter. Your internet plan alone does not change the local link rate.
게이트웨이와 실제 서비스 지연을 나눠 측정하기: Measuring gateway and actual service delays separately
Windows 키+R → cmd → Enter → ipconfig·pin: Windows+R → cmd → Enter → ipconfig·ping, network statistics of the service
다운로드·업로드를 멈추고 Windows 키+R → cmd → Enter에: Stop downloading/uploading and run ipconfig from Windows+R → cmd → Enter and write down the default gateway for the current connection.
ping 뒤에 실제 게이트웨이 주소를 입력하고 -n 20을 붙여 측정하세: Enter the actual gateway address after ping and add -n 20 to measure it. Record target regions and delay/loss statistics for gaming and calling apps at the same time. A response-blocking device cannot be said to be broken just because of a ping failure.
같은 PC를 유선으로 연결해 비교하고, 업로드가 없을 때와 있을 때를 나: Compare the same PC on Ethernet, both with uploads paused and active. If the gateway is stable but one service is poor, compare other destinations and an allowed alternative network, then report the time and server region to the service operator.
무선에서만 게이트웨이 지연이 높으면 로컬 무선부터 점검하세요. 중간 라우: If the gateway delay is high only on the wireless, check the local wireless first. Do not assume that actual service packet loss is caused by ICMP loss from an intermediate router or that changing DNS will solve everything.
공유 경로와 로그인 권한을 구분하기: Separate shared paths and login permissions
Windows 키+E → 주소 표시줄, 자격 증명 관리자 → Window: Windows+E → Address bar, Credential Manager → Windows Credentials
Windows 키+E로 탐색기를 열고 주소 표시줄에 서버에서 알려 준 정: Open Explorer with Windows+E and enter the exact \\server name\share name provided by the server in the address bar. Compare it to the IP path of the same trusted server and record the error text.
이름 경로만 실패하면 서버 이름 해석을, 두 경로 모두 실패하면 서버의: If only the name path fails, check the server name resolution. If both paths fail, check the server's On/Same Network/Shared Services. When the login window appears, log in with an account permitted by the server.
암호를 바꾼 뒤 실패한다면 시작에서 자격 증명 관리자를 열어 Window: If it fails after changing the password, open Credential Manager from Start and update only the server entry in your Windows credentials. Server administrators should check both the sharing permissions and file permissions on the Security tab.
다른 계정만 되면 권한·자격 증명 문제로 좁히세요. 신뢰하는 가정망에서만: If only another account works, investigate permissions and credentials. Use the Private network profile only on a trusted home network. Do not enable SMB1 or anonymous guest access, or disable the whole firewall, as a workaround.
USB 연결 규격과 파일 조건 비교하기: Comparing USB connection specifications and file conditions
USB 장치·케이블·포트·허브의 지원 규격, 탐색기 파일 복사: Supported standards for USB devices, cables, ports, and hubs, copy explorer files
PC 포트·외장 케이스·케이블의 지원 전송 규격을 각각 확인하세요. US: Check the supported transmission standards for PC ports, external cases, and cables. USB-C's appearance alone does not guarantee USB 3.x speeds.
중요 파일을 확보한 뒤 정상 호환 데이터 케이블로 PC에 직접 연결하세요: After securing your important files, connect them directly to your PC using a normal compatible data cable. Copy the same large file without the hub and record the time and speed.
작은 파일 여러 개와 큰 파일 하나, 읽기와 쓰기를 나눠 비교하세요. 발: Compare multiple small files and one large file, read and write separately. Check the heat, remaining space, and original drive speed, and stop the test if there is a connection loss or I/O error.
직결이나 케이블 변경 후만 개선되면 연결 경로를 점검하세요. 계속 느리면: If it improves only after connecting directly or changing the cable, check the connection path. If it continues to be slow, compare device specifications, heat generation, and file conditions. Do not apply the file copy test to non-storage USB devices.
같은 이동·클릭·스크롤을 정상 마우스와 비교하세요. 마우스 한 개에서만: Compare the same movement, clicking, and scrolling with a normal mouse. If it occurs on only one mouse, check Device/Surface/Receiver. If the same occurs on multiple pointing devices, check App/Windows settings.
터치패드의 켜짐 표시와 커서 이동·클릭을 확인하세요. 외장 마우스는 정상: Check that the touchpad is turned on and that the cursor moves/clicks. If the external mouse is normal but the touchpad does not respond, check the manufacturer's touchpad driver/hardware.
외장 마우스를 뺄 때만 터치패드가 살아나면 마우스 연결 시 끄기 설정을: If the touchpad works only after disconnecting an external mouse, check whether a setting disables the touchpad when a mouse is connected. If it still fails with the mouse disconnected, investigate touchpad detection and its driver.
터치패드 민감도와 외장 마우스 비교하기: Comparing touchpad sensitivity and external mouse
Windows 키+I → Bluetooth 및 장치 → 터치패드 → 탭: Windows+I → Bluetooth and devices → Touchpad → Tap
케이스 들뜸·배터리 팽창·비정상 열이 있으면 사용을 중단하고 터치패드를: If the case lifts, the battery swells, or there is abnormal heat, stop using the product and do not press the touchpad. Compare settings only when there are no red flags.
Windows 키+I → Bluetooth 및 장치 → 터치패드 → 탭에: Press Windows+I → Bluetooth & devices → Touchpad → Taps. If Touchpad sensitivity is offered, note its value and lower sensitivity one level. Also check palm rejection or typing-related touch suppression in the manufacturer utility.
같은 문장을 입력할 때 손바닥을 댄 조건과 뗀 조건을 비교하세요. 정상: When typing the same sentence, compare the condition in which you put your palm on and the condition in which you lift your palm. Check if the cursor jumps on a working external mouse and restore any settings that are ineffective.
타이핑 중 터치패드에서만 튀면 민감도·팜 리젝션을 점검하세요. 손을 떼도: If only the touchpad bounces while typing, check the sensitivity and palm rejection. If it moves on its own when you release it or the click physically lifts, have the part inspected.
마이크 수신 대기와 앱 모니터링 확인하기: Check microphone listening and app monitoring
Windows 키+R → mmsys.cpl → Enter → 녹음 → 실: Windows+R → mmsys.cpl → Enter → Record → Real Microphone Properties
통화 앱에서 입력 장치가 실제 마이크인지 확인하고 스테레오 믹스·가상 루: In the calling app, check whether the input device is a real microphone, and if Stereo Mix/Virtual Loopback is selected, replace it with the original microphone. Record the value before change.
Windows 키+R → mmsys.cpl → Enter → 녹음 → 실: Press Windows+R, enter mmsys.cpl and press Enter. Open Recording → your actual microphone → Properties → Listen, and check whether Listen to this device is already enabled. If you do not intend to monitor the microphone, clear it and apply. Do not enable it merely to test.
앱 자체 마이크 모니터링·다른 열린 통화도 하나씩 끄고 헤드폰으로 같은: Turn off app microphone monitoring and other active calls one at a time, then compare the same recording or call using headphones. Adjust volume and positioning to keep speaker audio from being picked up by the microphone.
헤드폰에서만 에코가 없어지면 음향 피드백을 줄이세요. 수신 대기 해제로만: If echo disappears only when using headphones, reduce acoustic feedback. If clearing Listen to this device alone fixes it, inspect duplicate monitoring paths. Also check feedback at the other participant device.
자체 테스트와 앱 문서 출력 범위 비교하기: Compare printer self-tests and app-specific document printing
프린터 속성 → 테스트 페이지 인쇄, 앱 → 인쇄 → 품질·배율·용지: Printer properties → Print test page, App → Print → Quality/Scale/Paper
설정 → Bluetooth 및 장치 → 프린터 및 스캐너 → 해당 프린터: Print a test page from Settings → Bluetooth and devices → Printers and scanners → Applicable printer → Printer properties. Compare the printer's own reports with small, generic documents as well.
테스트 페이지는 정상인데 특정 앱만 느리거나 실패하면 같은 내용을 다른: If the test page is normal but only a specific app is slow or fails, print the same content in another app or PDF and compare. Check the app's selected printer, paper size, quality, and scale, and consider processing time for high-resolution photos.
모든 앱과 테스트 페이지도 실패하거나 큐가 멈췄을 때만 해당 프린터의 대: Check the queue/connection/official driver for that printer only if all apps and test pages fail or the queue is stuck. Do not unnecessarily delete or re-register the printer when only one app fails.
자체 보고서도 느리면 기기·품질 설정을, PC 테스트 페이지만 느리면 연: If the self-report is also slow, check the device/quality settings, if only the PC test page is slow, check the connection/driver, and if only a specific app fails, check the app/document settings.
프린터 자체 품질 보고서와 문서 비교하기: Compare documents with the printer's own quality report
프린터 조작판 → 모델별 품질 진단·노즐 검사, 인쇄 설정 → 용지·품질: Printer operation panel → Quality diagnosis/nozzle inspection for each model, print settings → Paper/quality
프린터 조작판이나 제조사 앱의 지원 메뉴에서 자체 품질 보고서·노즐 검사: Print your own quality report/nozzle inspection page once from the printer operation panel or the support menu of the manufacturer app. Compare with the PC document to see if there are any streaks or missing colors.
잉크젯만 모델 안내의 헤드 청소·정렬을 허용 횟수 내에서 실행하고 재출력: For inkjet only, perform head cleaning/alignment in the model guide within the allowed number of times and reprint. For laser, check the condition of toner, drum, and paper according to the manual. Do not apply inkjet cleaning to the laser.
자체 보고서는 정상인데 한 문서만 이상하면 앱의 용지 크기·용지 종류·품: If the self-report is normal but only one document is abnormal, reprint the app's paper size, paper type, quality, and scale to match the actual paper.
자체 보고서도 불량이면 소모품·인쇄부 문제를, 보고서는 정상이고 앱 출력: If the self-report is also defective, check for problems with consumables or the printing unit. If the report is normal but only the app output is defective, check the document and driver settings. If repeated cleanings don't improve things, stop wasting supplies and get assistance.
설정 → Bluetooth 및 장치 → 프린터 및 스캐너, Windows: Settings → Bluetooth & devices → Printers & scanners, Windows scan/manufacturer scan app
스캐너 전원과 지원 USB·유선·Wi-Fi 연결을 확인하고 설정의 프린터: Check the scanner's power and supported USB, wired, or Wi-Fi connections, and make sure the correct model is visible under Printers and scanners in Settings. Showing only printer functions and recognizing scanners are different.
Windows 스캔 또는 모델의 공식 스캔 앱을 열고 해당 스캐너·평판: Open Windows Scan or your model's official scanning app and select your scanner, flatbed, or document feeder to preview it. Compare whether only one app fails.
어느 앱에서도 없으면 모델의 지원 Windows용 스캐너 드라이버를 설치: If it is not available in any app, install the supported scanner driver for Windows for your model. Only when the manufacturer requests WIA, check for errors/status of Windows Image Acquisition (WIA) at Windows+R → services.msc → Enter.
미리보기와 저장한 이미지가 열리면 완료입니다. 연결·드라이버가 맞아도 모: Once the preview and saved image opens, you're done. Even if the connection and driver are correct, if it is not recognized in all apps, report the model, connection method, and error to the manufacturer. Cleaning the print queue is not the default solution for scan recognition.
앱별 배터리 사용량과 전원 모드 비교하기: Compare battery usage and power modes by app
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 전원 및 배터리 → 배터리 사용량·전: Windows+I → System → Power and Battery → Battery usage/power mode
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 전원 및 배터리에서 같은 시간대의 배: Check the battery usage and consumption by app in the same time period in Windows+I → System → Power and Battery. Record screen brightness, background apps, and external device status.
같은 작업과 밝기에서 충전기 연결·배터리 상태를 나눠 비교하세요. 전원: Compare charger connection and battery status for the same task and brightness. If a power mode is offered, note the current values ​​and change just one item, such as Balanced. Also check the battery performance limits of the manufacturer's app.
작업을 저장하고 시작 버튼 우클릭 → 터미널에서 powercfg /bat: Save your work and right-click the Start button → run powercfg /batteryreport in the terminal. Open the printed report path to check trends in design capacity and full charge capacity. Don't decide to replace based on just one number.
특정 앱 소비나 배터리 모드에서만 성능 차이가 나면 설정·앱을 먼저 조정: If there is a performance difference only in specific app consumption or battery mode, adjust the settings and apps first. If the battery suddenly drops or turns off repeatedly, get the battery diagnosed by the manufacturer. If swelling or overheating occurs, discontinue use immediately.
연기·타는 냄새·매우 뜨거운 표면이 있으면 기기를 만지거나 옮기지 말고: If there is smoke, a burning odor, or a very hot surface, do not touch or move the device and keep your distance. If there is danger, evacuate and call for emergency help. Otherwise, if you see swelling, discontinue use.
뜨겁거나 연기가 나는 상태가 아니고 안전하게 가능할 때만 전원을 끄고 충: Turn off and disconnect charging power only when it is safe to do so and is not hot or smoky. Do not press or drop the battery, and request inspection by the manufacturer in a safe place away from flammable materials.
팽창 배터리의 사용을 중단하고 점검 요청하기: Stop using a swollen battery and arrange inspection
배터리 팽창·케이스 들뜸·비정상 열·연기 여부: Battery expansion, case lifting, abnormal heat, smoke
연기·타는 냄새·매우 뜨거운 표면이 있으면 기기를 만지거나 옮기지 말고: If there is smoke, a burning odor, or a very hot surface, do not touch or move the device and keep your distance. If there is danger, evacuate and call for emergency help.
뜨겁거나 연기가 나는 상태가 아니고 안전하게 가능할 때만 사용을 멈추고: Stop using and turn off the device only when it is not hot or smoky and when it is safe to do so. Disconnect the charging power source in a safe location and avoid crushing or contact with flammable materials.
직접 누르기·구멍 내기·충전·성능 시험을 하지 마세요. 제조사에 팽창 상: Do not press, puncture, charge, or perform performance tests directly. Notify the manufacturer of the swelling condition and receive instructions on how to replace or collect it. Do not remove the built-in battery arbitrarily.
사용 중단이 우선입니다. 파일 백업이나 잔량 확인 때문에 다시 켜지 마세: Discontinuation of use takes priority. Do not turn it on again to back up files or check remaining capacity. Determine data access after safe replacement and inspection.
뜨겁거나 연기가 나는 상태가 아니고 안전하게 가능할 때만 전원을 끄고 충: Turn off and disconnect charging power only when it is safe to do so and is not hot or smoky. Do not press or drop the battery, and request inspection by the manufacturer in a safe place away from flammable materials. If there is smoke, heat or fire, stop access or transport and call for emergency response. Do not puncture, charge, crush, or dispose of batteries as general waste.
팬이 멈춘 채 온도가 오르거나 보호 종료·냄새가 있으면 부하 시험과 사용: If a stopped fan is accompanied by rising temperature, protective shutdowns or an unusual smell, stop load testing and using the PC. Check whether zero RPM operation is normal for the model using manufacturer information and diagnostics.
팬 정지 상태에서 부하 시험 중단하기: Aborting load test with fan stopped
팬이 멈춘 채 온도가 오르거나 보호 종료·냄새가 있으면 게임·부하 시험을: If the fan remains stopped while temperature rises, or there is a protective shutdown or unusual smell, stop games and load tests and shut down. Do not turn the fan by hand while the device is powered.
기기가 식은 뒤 모델의 제로 RPM 지원 조건을 확인하세요. 일부 GPU: After the device cools down, check whether the model supports zero-RPM operation. Some GPUs and fans normally stop at low loads. Use the manufacturer’s fan self-test rather than creating an artificial high load.
데스크톱의 커넥터 확인은 전원을 분리한 뒤에만 설명서대로 하세요. 노트북: To check the desktop's connector, follow the manual only after disconnecting the power source. Please leave disassembly near the laptop's built-in fan and battery to a support representative.
정상 제로 RPM 조건이면 부하 시 자동 회전을 제조사 진단으로 확인하세: If the condition is normal zero RPM, check automatic rotation under load with the manufacturer's diagnosis. If the fan does not run during support diagnostics or a protection shutdown remains, stop using the product and have it inspected for cooling.
덮개 동작과 절전 지원 확인하기: Check lid operation and power saving support
Windows 키+R → control → Enter → 전원 옵션 →: Windows+R → control → Enter → Power Options → select what happens when the lid is closed
Windows 키+R → control → Enter → 전원 옵션에서: In Windows+R → control → Enter → Power Options, open Select what happens when you close the lid. Record each battery/power connection setting, select the desired power-saving action, and save it.
관리자 터미널에서 powercfg /a를 실행해 지원되는 절전 상태와 제: Run powercfg /a in an administrator terminal to check the supported sleep states and reasons for restrictions. Do not change your organization's policies or Modern Standby support terms with arbitrary registry modifications.
외부 모니터·독을 쓰는 조건과 분리한 조건에서 덮개를 닫고 진입 여부를: Compare lid-close sleep with and without the external monitor or dock. Keep the vents clear throughout the test and do not put the laptop in a bag while testing.
덮개 닫기만 실패하고 시작 메뉴의 절전은 되면 덮개 설정·센서·제조사 전: If closing the lid fails and the start menu turns on sleep, check the lid settings, sensors, and manufacturer power management. Unwanted auto-wake and failure to enter sleep are different issues.
최대 절전 지원과 메뉴 표시 확인하기: Check hibernation support and menu display
관리자 터미널 → powercfg /a, 제어판 → 전원 옵션 → 전원: Administrator Terminal → powercfg /a, Control Panel → Power Options → Set what the power buttons do.
시작 버튼을 우클릭해 터미널(관리자)을 여세요. 없으면 cmd를 검색해: Right-click the Start button and open Terminal (Administrator). If not, search for cmd and run it with administrator privileges. Enter powercfg /a to read about whether hibernation is available and why it is not.
본인 PC에서 최대 절전을 직접 껐고 정책 제한이 없다면 powercfg: If you previously disabled hibernation on your own PC and no policy blocks it, run powercfg /hibernate on. Use powercfg /hibernate /type full only when a reduced hibernation file prevents full hibernation. This requires free disk space.
Windows 키+R → control → Enter → 전원 옵션 →: In Windows+R → control → Enter → Power Options → Set what the power buttons do → Change settings that are currently unavailable, mark and save the Hibernate item if it is provided. If it's your organization's policy, ask your administrator.
powercfg /a에서 최대 절전이 가능하고 시작 → 전원에 표시되는지: Make sure hibernation is enabled on powercfg /a and appears in Start → Power. Modern Standby's non-S3 support and S4 hibernation are different. If it is still not supported, record the reason and do not force registry changes.
Windows가 열리면 Shift를 누른 채 시작 → 전원 → 다시 시작: When Windows opens, hold down Shift and select Start → Power → Restart. Troubleshoot → Advanced Options → Startup Settings → Restart → Enter Safe Mode with 4 or F4. If Windows doesn't open, prepare your recovery key and check the available recovery options under Official Installation USB → Recovery Your Computer.
안전 모드가 열리면 설정 → 앱 → 설치된 앱에서 증상 직전 추가한 보안: When safe mode opens, go to Settings → Apps → Installed apps and check the security products and driver tools added just before the symptom. Ask your administrator for company security products and use only the vendor's recovery/removal procedures.
Windows가 실제로 실행되는 상태에서 시작 버튼 우클릭 → 터미널(관: With Windows actually running, right-click the Start button → Open Terminal (Administrator). If not, search for cmd → select Run as administrator. After DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth is completed, run sfc /scannow and record each result/code. Do not run this /Online command as is in WinRE.
정상 로그인과 다음 재부팅을 확인하세요. 안전 모드도 실패하거나 디스크: Confirm normal login and next reboot. If safe mode also fails or disk reading is unstable, prioritize securing important files over repeating system commands.
파일을 저장한 뒤 Windows 키+R → mdsched.exe → En: After saving the file, select Windows+R → mdsched.exe → Enter → Restart now to check for problems. After completion, find the source MemoryDiagnostics-Results in Windows+R → eventvwr.msc → Enter → Windows Logs → System → Current Log Filtering and read the results. If it's an error, request a RAM check instead of a repeat load and determine that even a normal result doesn't rule out all faults.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → 원인으로: Press Windows+R, enter devmgmt.msc and press Enter. Open the implicated device Properties → Driver and note the provider, version and date. Use Roll Back Driver only for the recent relevant change. If unavailable, check the PC or device manufacturer for a supported previous package for your exact model and Windows version.
Windows 키+R → %SystemRoot%\\Minidump → E: Windows+R → %SystemRoot%\Minidump → Enter to check whether the dump has been created. If not, record it as none. Because dumps may contain personal information, do not post them publicly and only forward them to support personnel you trust.
오류 화면의 .sys 이름과 최근 변경한 드라이버·장치 사용 시점을 함께: Please also provide the .sys name in the error screen and the last driver/device usage changes. If it recurs even with default memory settings, have your support representative analyze the dump to decide what to do next.
중요 파일을 먼저 백업하고 저장장치 제조사의 공식 도구에서 SMART 경: Back up important files first and check SMART warning and diagnostic results using the storage device manufacturer's official tool. If the device disappears or there are read errors, stop further scanning.
Windows 키+R → eventvwr.msc → Enter → Win: Windows+R → eventvwr.msc → Enter → Windows Log → Open the WHEA-Logger event at the time of occurrence in the system. Record the general/detailed error source, processor APIC ID, PCIe device information, and event ID. Do not confirm component failure based on just one item.
직접 적용한 CPU·GPU 튜닝은 해당 제조사 앱에서 먼저 기본값으로 되: For CPU and GPU tuning that you applied yourself, first return it to the default value in the manufacturer's app and compare. When changing the BIOS memory profile, secure the recovery key/original settings and restore only the XMP/EXPO items according to the manual for each model.
기본 설정에서도 반복되면 이벤트 내용·모델·발생 부하를 지원 담당자에게: If it repeats in the default settings, convey the event content, model, and generated load to the support staff. Stop the load test if there is overheating, odor, fan stoppage, or storage device read failure.
외장 저장장치는 파일을 저장하고 Windows의 안전 제거가 완료된 뒤: Save files and complete Safely Remove Hardware for external storage before unplugging it. Exclude unnecessary USB devices one at a time and compare the same workload for recurrence.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter에서 저장장치: Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter to record the model/provider/driver version of the storage device/controller and check for recent changes.
SSD 펌웨어는 파일 백업과 안정적 인식을 확인하고 제조사 변경 내역에: Consider SSD firmware only after backing up files and confirming stable drive detection, and only if the manufacturer release notes address the symptom. Use the official model-specific tool. Do not flash an intermittently detected disk before resolving its instability.
Windows 화면이 보일 때 GPU 제조사 앱에서 직접 적용한 오버클럭: When the Windows screen is visible, restore only the overclock and undervolt applied directly from the GPU manufacturer app to the default values and compare the same scene. At the same time, don't change drivers either.
Windows가 열리지 않지만 복구 화면은 보이면 복구 키를 준비하고 시: If Windows doesn't open but you can see the recovery screen, have your recovery key ready and access Safe Mode in Startup Settings. If there is no video from BIOS, check the cable, output, and POST status first.
한 변경 뒤 같은 장면의 오류 파일명과 재발 여부를 기록하세요. 과열·팬: After each change, record the error filename and whether the same scene fails again. Stop gaming or load testing if overheating, a stopped fan or protective shutdowns persist.
복구 키를 확보하고 전원 직후 모델 설명서의 Setup 키로 BIOS를: Prepare the recovery key first. Immediately after power-on, press the model-specific Setup key to enter BIOS. Check whether Storage lists the original system drive model; a missing boot entry differs from an undetected drive.
SATA·RAID·AHCI 모드는 직접 변경한 이전 값이 확실할 때만 원: Restore SATA, RAID, and AHCI modes to their original settings only when you are sure of the previous values you changed manually. Note the current values ​​and do not switch modes or wipe partitions arbitrarily.
드라이브가 보이면 공식 Windows 설치 USB로 부팅해 설치 대신 컴: If you see the drive, boot from the official Windows installation USB and select Repair your computer → Troubleshoot → Advanced options → Startup Repair instead of Install. If you have a BitLocker lock, you will need your own recovery key.
실패 결과를 기록하세요. WinRE에서 설치된 Windows의 드라이브: Record the consequences of failure. Do not assume that the drive letter of your Windows installation is C: in WinRE or run the /Online recovery command. In case of recognition failure or reading error, securing data takes priority.
파일을 저장하고 외장 저장장치를 안전 제거하세요. 불필요한 주변 장치를: Save the file and safely remove the external storage device. After excluding unnecessary peripheral devices one by one, go to Start → Power → Sleep and wake up with the power button to compare.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter로 장치 관리: Open Device Manager with Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter and record the version and date in Properties → Driver of the recently added dock/USB/network device. Narrow down the device the problem is being traced to.
한 드라이버만 바꾼 뒤 같은 절전·복귀 조건으로 비교하세요. 모든 장치의: Change only one driver and compare under the same sleep/return conditions. Do not change the power save/wake permissions for all devices at once.
Windows가 열리고 드라이브가 안정적으로 읽히면 Windows 키+E: Once Windows opens and the drive is read reliably, copy the required files to a separate, healthy storage device with Windows+E and see if the copy opens. If reading fails, disappears, or makes abnormal noises, stop repeated reading and receive recovery support.
저장장치 제조사의 공식 도구에서 모델·SMART 경고·사용 가능한 비파괴: Record models, SMART warnings, and available non-destructive diagnostic results in the storage manufacturer's official tool. If Windows doesn't open, don't try to run an online system check.
재부팅 후 원래 작업을 비교하세요. 새 읽기 오류나 같은 중단이 남으면: After reboot, compare your original work. If new read errors or the same interruption remain, request a storage device/controller check with backup status and diagnostic records.
오류가 난 NTFS 볼륨의 실제 문자·용량과 관리자 터미널: Actual drive letter and capacity of the affected NTFS volume, and an administrator terminal
Windows 키+E → 내 PC에서 오류가 난 볼륨의 문자·용량을 확인: Press Windows+E → This PC, identify the affected volume by drive letter and capacity, and back up important files first. Distinguish the system C: volume from external or data volumes.
정상 Windows에서 실제 대상이 C:인 경우에만 관리자 터미널의 ch: In normal Windows, use chkdsk C: /scan in Administrator Terminal only if the actual destination is C:. Other volumes must use the actual letters you see. Do not apply this command verbatim because characters and lock states may be different in WinRE.
검사한 대상 문자가 실제 오류 볼륨과 일치하는지 먼저 확인하세요. 정상: First check that the target characters being checked match the actual error volume. Normal results do not rule out repeated recognition failures or hardware abnormalities.
검사 결과를 기록하고 수리·오프라인 검사가 요구되면 백업과 장치 상태부터: Record the inspection results, and if repairs or offline inspections are required, check backups and device status first. If there is a read failure, SMART warning, or repeat recognition failure, do not repeat long-term repairs such as /r first and undergo a recovery check.
블루스크린의 .sys 이름을 기록하고 Windows 키+R → devmg: Record the .sys name of the blue screen and compare the file name and provider in Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → Suspicious Device Properties → Driver → Driver Information. Don't get random drivers just by searching their name.
VPN·보안 필터가 지목되면 회사 PC는 관리자에게 요청하세요. 개인 P: If a VPN/security filter is pointed out, ask the administrator for your company PC. Also, use the vendor recovery procedures for your personal PC and check to see if the VPN reconnects/protects are restored. Do not continue normal use with protection turned off.
어느 작업에서 접근이 거부됐는지 나누세요. 파일 저장이면 같은 앱에서 본: Please indicate which tasks were denied access. If saving a file, save it with a new name in a document folder that you can write in the same app and compare. If installing or updating, record the error screen and path.
보안 → 보호 기록에서 같은 시각의 차단이 있는지 확인하세요. 파일 속성: Check Security → Protection History to see if there is a block at the same time. Check file properties → security with the allowed account/organization administrator and do not apply full disk ownership or full control to Everyone.
Only in case of an installation error, check the official package and manufacturer-supported installation path. If it is an update error, use Settings → System → Troubleshooting → Other troubleshooters → Windows Update or View Help using Update Diagnostics. Don't execute all actions from different tasks.
오류 창과 설치 로그에서 찾을 수 없다는 파일·경로를 적으세요. 앱 문제: Record the missing file and path from the error dialog and installer log. For an app issue, check Settings → Apps → Installed apps → that app → Modify or Advanced options for Repair. The app Reset option can erase app data; this is not a Windows factory reset.
Windows 업데이트 문제라면 설정 → Windows 업데이트 → 업데: If it's a Windows Update issue, go to Settings → Windows Update → Update history, write down the failed KB code, open Help from Start, and run Windows Update Diagnostics. For missing app files, use the repair installation of the official installation file.
발생 기능을 먼저 적으세요. 백업이면 선택 원본·대상 여유 공간과 정확한: Write down the occurrence function first. If it is a backup, check the source/destination free space and the exact path, if it is an installation, check the parameters/destination disk in the installation log, and if it is an update, check the failure KB. Don't change partitions just by looking at the code.
업데이트에서만 발생하면 설정 → 시스템 → 문제 해결 → 다른 문제 해결: If it only happens with updates, use Settings → System → Troubleshoot → Other troubleshooters → Diagnostics in Windows Update or Get Help. If there is an app/backup problem, follow the manufacturer's instructions with the support log and input values ​​for the function.
업데이트이면 설정 → Windows 업데이트 → 업데이트 기록의 KB·실: For an update error, note the failed KB and time under Settings → Windows Update → Update history. If only reading an app settings file fails, back up that file and use the app supported repair menu. Do not delete files arbitrarily.
업데이트 실패가 남으면 %windir%\\Logs\\CBS\\CBS.lo: If update failures remain, please forward the corresponding time and KB in %windir%\Logs\CBS\CBS.log to your support representative. If only one app fails, check the app log/official install recovery.
파일 읽기·복사 중이면 같은 파일과 원본·대상 경로를 기록하고 필요한 데: If you are reading or copying a file, record the same file and the source and destination paths and secure the necessary data first. If reading from the storage device is unstable, stop repeat testing or formatting.
Windows 설치 USB가 원인이 의심되고 데이터 백업이 끝난 경우에만: Only if you suspect a Windows installation USB is the cause and have backed up your data, select Create installation media → Language/Edition/Architecture → USB flash drive using Microsoft's official media creation tool. Recheck the model and capacity of the target USB. Existing data on the selected USB will be deleted.
Check if the same steps fail on official media created from another USB. If both media fail, collect RAM and storage device records and have them inspected.
Windows 키+R → winver → Enter에서 에디션·버전·빌드: Windows+R → winver → Enter to record the edition/version/build and check the architecture at System → Information. Keep the failure time in %windir%\Logs\DISM\dism.log and %windir%\Logs\CBS\CBS.log.
호환 복구 원본과 이미지 인덱스 확인하기: Checking compatible recovery sources and image indexes
회사·학교 PC는 복구 원본 정책을 관리자에게 요청하세요. 개인 PC도: For company/school PCs, please ask the administrator for the original recovery policy. Even on your personal PC, you should first check whether the language, edition, build, and architecture of the official ISO are compatible with the Windows installation.
설치 이미지의 install.wim·install.esd 위치와 에디션별: If the install.wim·install.esd location of the installation image and the index by edition are not confirmed, do not guess the /Source path·number. Please forward the logs and versions to your support staff so they can check the image list and point to the correct source.
Windows 키+R → optionalfeatures.exe → Ent: Open Windows+R → optionalfeatures.exe → Enter and check whether .NET Framework 3.5 is selected and the failure code. Check first whether your app requires .NET 3.5 and don't turn on any features arbitrarily.
설정 → 시스템 → 선택적 기능의 설치는 Windows 기능 창의 .NE: Settings → System → Install Optional Features is a different path than .NET 3.5 in the Windows Features window. Write down which function failed and check the connection/update policy. For issues with your organization's WSUS/source policies, please contact your administrator and do not circumvent security policies.
설정 → Windows 업데이트 → 업데이트 기록에서 실패한 KB·시각·: Note the failed KB, time and code under Settings → Windows Update → Update history. Press Windows+R, enter %windir%\Logs\CBS and press Enter. Open CBS.log in Notepad and inspect the entries at the failure time.
실패 로그와 설치 Windows 버전을 지원 담당자에게 전달하세요. 코드: Please forward the failure log and the Windows version you installed to your support representative. Do not assume that the reserved partition is insufficient based on the code alone, and do not change the partition size or delete EFI files. For VPNs, only compare before and after connections in a permissive environment.
Windows 키+R → services.msc → Enter → Win: Double-click Windows+R → services.msc → Enter → Windows Update and record the startup type, status, and errors. This is a check to see if it is disabled, and does not mean you should turn off the service.
본인이 튜닝 도구로 껐던 값이 확실하면 도구의 복원 기능이나 기록된 원래: If you can confirm that you disabled the service yourself with a tuning tool, use its restore option or restore the recorded original startup type and apply. If the service Start button is available, try it once, record the result and check for updates again.
조직 관리·보안 정책이거나 원래 값을 모르면 임의로 자동·수동 값을 일괄: If it is an organizational management/security policy or you do not know the original values, do not arbitrarily specify automatic/manual values in batches, but ask the administrator. If the change goes back, don't repeat the forced change.
파일을 저장하고 해당 파일을 쓰는 앱을 정상 종료한 뒤 한 번 다시 시도: Save the file, exit the app that uses the file normally, and try again. If the lockout is related to your company's PC or security product, ask your administrator.
클린 부팅 비교가 필요하면 원래 설정을 기록하고 Windows 키+R →: If you need a clean boot comparison, please note the original settings and select Windows+R → msconfig → Enter → Hide Microsoft services from Services first. Just exclude third-party services to compare. Do not disable security product protection without vendor support.
Ctrl+Shift+Esc → 시작 앱에서도 변경한 항목을 기록하고 재부: Ctrl+Shift+Esc → Record the changed items in the startup app and reboot to compare. Once you find the cause, restore any changes you made to their original settings. Don't disable Microsoft services in bulk.
Windows 키+I → 네트워크 및 인터넷 → VPN·프록시에서 연결과: Record the connection and automatic/manual proxy values in Windows+I → Network and Internet → VPN/Proxy. Compare before and after connection under conditions where only the VPN you set up on your personal PC is allowed.
같은 시각에 다른 사이트와 허용된 다른 회선에서 비교하세요. 여러 기기에: Compare at the same time on different sites and on different allowed lines. If the same server fails on multiple devices, retry once a while and if it continues, forward the address, time of failure, and code to the administrator. Please do not make repeated requests or disable the entire firewall.
현재 연결이 끊기거나 VPN이 다시 연결되는지 기록하고 다른 사이트도 같: Note whether your current connection drops or the VPN reconnects, and compare whether other sites fail at the same time. Test with only one condition changed on another allowed line.
조직 프록시·보안 필터가 있으면 실패 주소·시각·코드를 관리자에게 전달하: If you have an organization proxy/security filter, please forward the failure address, time, and code to your administrator. Individual users should only record and compare the original values ​​of VPNs and proxies that they directly manage, and do not bypass organizational policies or certificate checks.
Windows 키+I → 네트워크 및 인터넷 → 프록시에서 자동 검색·설: In Windows+I → Network and Internet → Proxy, record the automatic detection/setting script/manual proxy values. If there is an indication of company policy, ask your manager.
직접 입력한 잘못된 수동 프록시가 확인될 때만 원래 정상 값으로 복원하고: Only when you see incorrect manual proxies that you entered yourself, restore to the original good values and compare the same updates. If it doesn't work, revert the test change. Do not arbitrarily delete automatic or organizational settings.
Windows 키+R → winver → Enter로 Windows 버전: Windows+R → winver → Enter to check the Windows version/build and Settings → System → Information to check the system type. Please write down the exact KB that failed in the update history.
Microsoft Update Catalog에서 해당 KB를 검색하고 W: Search the corresponding KB in the Microsoft Update Catalog and select only the support packages that match your architecture: Windows Version·Product·x64·ARM64. After installation, restart and check whether the KB re-failed or not, such as whether the update history was successful or not.
설정 → Windows 업데이트 → 업데이트 기록에서 Windows KB: In Settings → Windows Update → Update History, determine whether it is a Windows KB·.NET update or an MSI error in the separate product installation window. Please write down KB, product version, and time of failure.
KB 문제는 해당 KB의 공식 알려진 문제와 도움말 보기 진단을 확인하세: For a failed KB, check its official known issues and Get Help diagnostics. For a .NET or separate product installation, use the vendor supported repair and installation logs. Share the failure-time entries from %windir%\Logs\CBS\CBS.log or the product log with support. Do not remove all .NET versions based only on this code.
오류 화면의 찾을 수 없는 경로와 실제 폴더 존재 여부를 확인하세요. W: Check the missing path on the error screen and whether the actual folder exists. Windows+R → %TEMP% → Enter to compare whether your temporary folder is opened. Don't guess and change system environment variables.
실패가 남으면 %windir%\\Logs\\CBS\\CBS.log의 같은: If the failure remains, record the same time and error path in %windir%\Logs\CBS\CBS.log. Please report any organization folder movement/policy issues to your administrator.
Record the entire code for the rollback screen and the extension code and installation steps that follow. Follow Microsoft's official SetupDiag instructions to keep the resulting files and rollback log of your Windows installation.
Windows 키+R → C:\\$WINDOWS.~BT\\Sources\: Windows+R → C:\$WINDOWS.~BT\Sources\Rollback → Enter to check if setupact.log·setuperr.log exists. If there is no hidden folder, write it down as not there and do not post the log publicly.
백업·복구 키를 확보한 뒤 SetupDiag 결과가 지목한 장치·드라이버: After securing the backup/recovery key, compare the device/driver indicated by SetupDiag results with the manufacturer-supported version. Safely remove external storage devices and retry only under conditions that exclude unnecessary peripheral devices. If the same steps fail again, get support with the extension code/log.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → 문제 장: Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → Problem Device Properties → General, record the device type/code. If it is an external USB device, safely remove it and connect it directly to a normal cable/main port to compare.
내장 GPU·무선·저장장치라면 USB 포트 변경을 적용하지 말고 모델·하: If it is a built-in GPU, wireless, or storage device, do not apply the USB port change, but check the model/hardware ID and recent driver changes.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → 문제 장: Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → Problem Device Properties → Record the provider/version in Driver. Install the recovery package for your PC manufacturer's model and restart.
네트워크 장치이고 VPN 설치 직후에만 시작됐으면 설치된 앱에서 그 제품: If it is a network device and only started immediately after installing the VPN, check its product/version in Installed Apps and use vendor-assisted recovery. Do not delete the registry filter arbitrarily; ask the administrator for your organization's PC to do so.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → 문제 장: Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → Problem Check the device type, name, and code in the device properties. Only for USB external devices, safely remove them and then change the cable/direct port to compare.
GPU·내장 장치는 USB 재연결 대신 최근 드라이버·전원·지원 모델 조: For GPU and built-in devices, check the latest driver, power, and supported model conditions instead of reconnecting the USB. Only check the desktop mounting after disconnecting the power source.
정상 지원 드라이버에서도 같은 장치가 코드를 보고하면 제조사 진단을 받으: If the same device reports the code even with normal supported drivers, seek manufacturer diagnostics. Do not confirm a device failure based on Code 43 alone.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → 해당 장: Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → Enter the name/code in the device properties and check the recently installed device app/driver. Start by comparing recovery and reinstallation of the manufacturer's support package.
시스템 복원은 문제 직전 복원 지점이 있고 백업이 확보된 경우의 후속 방: System Restore is a follow-up method if you have a restore point right before the problem and a backup is obtained. Select the point at Windows+R → rstrui.exe → Enter and check the apps and drivers to be changed by searching for affected programs. Do not randomly delete the registry if you do not have a restore point.
공식 장치 패키지 복구 후에도 같으면 코드·공급자·버전·복구 결과를 지원: If the problem persists after restoring the official device package, please forward the code/provider/version/recovery results to your support representative. Do not download driver files from random sites and overwrite System32.
게임의 그래픽·오버클럭·언더볼트에서 직접 바꾼 항목 하나만 기본값으로 복: Restore to default the only item you changed in the game's graphics, overclock, and undervolt and compare the same scene. Revert any ineffective changes to their original state and then take the next action.
Steam이면 라이브러리 → 해당 게임 우클릭 → 속성 → 설치된 파일: If it is Steam, select Library → Right-click the game → Properties → Installed files → Check game file integrity. For other launchers, use the game's official scan/repair menu. Back up your save files and MOD settings first.
게임 패치·기본 설정·지원 드라이버에서도 같은 장면만 실패하면 오류 전문: If the same scene fails even with the game patch, basic settings, or supported driver, please send the error message, GPU, driver, and reproduction scene to the developer. Do not assume GPU failure based on app command errors alone.
게임 오류 창·런처의 로그 보기·제작사의 로그 위치 안내에서 추가 오류: Please record the additional error code and occurrence time in the game error window, view the launcher's log, or the manufacturer's log location information. GetDeviceRemovedReason is usually developer analysis information and is not a recovery command directly executed by general users.
추가 사유가 안 보이면 오류 화면·GPU 모델·드라이버 버전·재현 장면을: If you do not see additional reasons, please provide the error screen, GPU model, driver version, and reproduction footage. If temperature or fan abnormalities occur, stop the load test.
게임 기본 설정과 파일 상태 비교하기: Compare game preferences and file status
게임 설정의 직접 변경한 그래픽 항목만 기본값으로 돌린 뒤 같은 장면을: Return only the graphic items you changed in the game settings to the default values and then compare the same scene.
게임 기본값과 파일 검사 결과, 드라이버 변경 전후의 같은 장면 결과를: Record the game defaults, file inspection results, and the results of the same scene before and after changing the driver. Don't change multiple items at once.
롤백이 불가능하면 PC·GPU 제조사에서 정확한 모델·Windows용 이: If rollback is not possible, check with the PC/GPU manufacturer for the exact model/previous support package for Windows and compare using the official installation procedure. Keep the current package and restore any ineffective changes. Record your results in the same scene.
Windows 키+R → dxdiag → Enter → 디스플레이 탭에서: Check your GPU name/driver/feature level in Windows+R → dxdiag → Enter → Display tab and compare it to the game's official minimum requirements. Don't judge whether your GPU supports all features based on the DirectX version number alone.
복수 GPU면 Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 디스플레이 → 그래픽에: If you have multiple GPUs, select or add a game from Windows+I → System → Display → Graphics, select Options → High-performance GPU and save. Restart the game completely. If the hardware function itself is not supported, it cannot be added through settings.
Windows 키+I → 네트워크 및 인터넷 → 현재 Wi-Fi 또는 이: Open Windows+I → Network and Internet → Current Wi-Fi or Ethernet properties → Edit DNS server assignment. Record the original values ​​of automatic/manual/server addresses.
본인이 잘못 지정한 개인 PC의 DNS만 원래 정상 값이나 공유기 DHC: Compare by restoring only the DNS on your personal PC that you specified incorrectly to the original normal value or the router's DHCP automatic assignment. Ask your administrator for company/static IP/VPN policies and change the items one by one.
Windows 키+R → cmd → Enter → ipconfig /al: Check that the DNS server of the actual connection is the intended value in Windows+R → cmd → Enter → ipconfig /all. If necessary, compare the same addresses after ipconfig /flushdns and restore ineffective changes.
다른 기기도 같은 네트워크에서 인터넷이 안 되는지 확인하세요. 공공 Wi: Check if other devices do not have Internet access on the same network. If it is public Wi-Fi, complete authentication on the normal login page provided by the operator and do not enter your password on the security warning page.
인증이 필요 없는 네트워크에서 한 PC만 실패하면 설정 → 네트워크 및: If only one PC fails on a network that does not require authentication, check the connection status in Settings → Network and Internet and record the IP, default gateway, and DNS with Windows+R → cmd → Enter → ipconfig /all. Do not reset the static IP/organizational network arbitrarily, but ask the administrator.
Chrome에서 Ctrl+Shift+N으로 시크릿 창을 열어 같은 정확한: Open an incognito window in Chrome as Ctrl+Shift+N to compare the same exact addresses. Also check your extension settings, as some may be allowed in Incognito.
허용된 다른 기기·회선에서 같은 주소를 비교하세요. 본인이 관리하는 VP: Compare the same address on other allowed devices and lines. Compare before and after connection to the VPN you manage, but do not disable the company's security or proxy policies. If only one site continues to fail, report the address, time, and error to the operator.
같은 주소를 다른 기기·허용된 다른 회선에서 열고 다른 정상 사이트도 비: Open the same address on another device/allowed line and compare other legitimate sites. Record the time of failure, exact address, and connection method.
다른 사이트는 되는데 여러 회선에서 해당 사이트만 실패하면 잠시 뒤 한: If other sites work but only that site fails on multiple lines, retry once a while and if it persists, report it to the administrator. If the failure occurs on only one PC, check the VPN, proxy, and security logs by recording the original values, and ask the administrator for the organization policy.
주소의 http·https·호스트·포트가 서비스 안내와 같은지 확인하세요: Check whether the http·https·host·port of the address is the same as the service information. Compare whether the same address is rejected on other devices. If it is someone else's site, please convey the address and time to the administrator.
본인 서버라면 서버 터미널에서 서비스 관리 방식에 따라 systemctl: On your own server, use the appropriate service manager: systemctl status SERVICE or docker compose ps. Replace SERVICE with the actual registered service name. Use ss -ltn to inspect listening ports and whether the service binds only to 127.0.0.1.
서버 내부 localhost 접속은 되는데 외부 도메인만 실패하면 리버스: If you can connect to localhost inside the server, but only the external domain fails, check the reverse proxy, port forwarding, and intended firewall rules. Do not blindly open all ports.
Windows 키+I → 네트워크 및 인터넷에서 비행기 모드는 끄고 Wi: Windows+I → In Network & Internet, turn off airplane mode and turn on Wi-Fi to connect to the intended network. If it is wired, check the cable/link markings on both sides.
Windows 키+R → ncpa.cpl → Enter에서 실제 사용 어: Press Windows+R, enter ncpa.cpl and press Enter. Only if the adapter you actually use is disabled, right-click it → Enable. If the device is absent, first inspect its error and model in Device Manager using Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter.
주소가 공식 주소인지 확인하고 Ctrl+Shift+N으로 시크릿 창에서: Make sure the address is official and open the same page in an incognito window with Ctrl+Shift+N. If normal, check the site's cookies and login status in the general window.
쿠키 삭제 전 작성 중인 내용을 보관하세요. Chrome 설정 → 개인정: Please keep what you are writing before deleting cookies. Go to Chrome Settings → Privacy & Security → Third-Party Cookies → View all site data and permissions, find the domain in question and delete only that site data. You will be logged out and any work data saved on the site may be erased.
여러 기기·시크릿에서도 같으면 사이트의 리디렉션·로그인 설정 문제일 수: If the same redirect loop occurs on multiple devices and in Incognito, the site may have a redirect or login configuration problem. Send the exact address and failure time to its operator.
공식 안내의 HTTPS 주소·포트를 확인하세요. HTTP 전용 포트에 h: Please check the HTTPS address and port in the official guide. Check whether https has been added to the HTTP-only port, and compare the same address on another device or allowed line.
모든 기기에서 같은 사이트만 실패하면 서버 TLS·프록시 설정을 운영자에: If the same site fails on all devices, communicate the server TLS/proxy settings to the administrator. If it is your server, check the certificate, domain, and listening port of the proxy that terminates TLS. Do not bypass security warnings or disable HTTPS entirely.
인증서 경고를 우회하지 말고 주소·발급자·유효 기간을 기록하세요. Chr: Do not bypass certificate warnings and note the address, issuer, and expiration date. Check the certificate view in the site information to the left of Chrome's address if it is provided, or save the warning screen if not.
Chrome 메뉴 → 도움말 → Chrome 정보에서 업데이트하고 Win: Update in Chrome menu → Help → About Chrome, and also check Windows Settings → Windows Update. Ask your administrator for the management policy for your organization's PCs.
다른 정상 기기·허용된 다른 회선에서 같은 사이트의 발급자와 경고를 비교: Compare the certificate issuer and warning for the same site on another known-good device and an allowed different network. If only this PC differs, check its clock, security software and organizational certificate configuration with the administrator. Do not install arbitrary root certificates.
앱 공식 업데이트·복구 메뉴를 확인하고 지원되는 확장·플러그인을 하나씩: Check the app's official update/recovery menu and compare the same operations by excluding supported extensions/plug-ins one by one. Back up your saves and settings first and do not turn off security products blindly.
Windows 키+R → eventvwr.msc → Enter → Win: Windows+R → eventvwr.msc → Enter → Windows Log → Open Application Error at the same time in the application and write down the failed app/module/exception code. Do not determine the cause based on just one module.
Record the DLL name, full path and app name shown in the Bad Image error. For a file in the app installation folder, use the app repair option under Settings → Apps, or the vendor official repair installer.
VCRUNTIME·MSVCP 등 런타임 파일이면 앱이 요구하는 공식 Vi: If it is a runtime file such as VCRUNTIME or MSVCP, check Modification → Recovery of the official Visual C++ package required by the app. Don't assume it's a regular Windows file just because it's a WinSxS path.
차단 파일과 계정의 실행 권한 확인하기: Check execution permissions for blocked files and accounts
오류가 난 실행 파일·계정·설치 경로를 기록하고 Windows 보안 →: Record the executable file/account/installation path in error and check for blocking at the same time in Windows Security → Protection History. Please ask your administrator for an organization PC.
파일 우클릭 → 속성 → 보안에서 본인 계정의 읽기 및 실행 권한을 관리: Right-click the file → Properties → Security and check your account's read and execution permissions with your administrator or product support. Please repair and install from the installation path supported by the manufacturer. Do not use Everyone full permission/change full disk ownership/remove protection as a general prescription.
앱의 공식 요구사항에서 Visual C++ 2010과 앱의 x86·x64: Check your app's official requirements for Visual C++ 2010 and your app's x86·x64 configuration. Even on 64-bit Windows, 32-bit apps may require the x86 runtime. Don't get one DLL randomly.
앱 제작사의 공식 설치 패키지에 포함된 전제 구성요소 또는 Microso: Use the prerequisite components included in the app manufacturer's official installation package or the corresponding Visual C++ 2010 package from Microsoft's official download. For the same package that is already installed, check whether Change/Recovery is available in Control Panel → Programs and Features.
구형 앱·런타임은 지원이 종료됐을 수 있습니다. 지원 OS가 아니거나 공: Support for older apps and runtimes may have ended. If your OS is not supported or you cannot obtain an official package, use maintained app version/vendor support instead of a random mirror.
제작사 지원 설치 로깅 옵션으로 실패 로그를 저장하세요. 공식 MSI 파: Save failure logs with vendor-supported installation logging options. As long as it is an official MSI file, you can run it from an administrator terminal with the actual file path, like msiexec /i "C:\path\product.msi" /L*v "%TEMP%\pcfix-install.log". Do not apply this MSI command to EXE files.
Windows 키+R → %TEMP% → Enter에서 생성된 pcfix: Open the pcfix-install.log generated by Windows+R → %TEMP% → Enter and check the tasks and errors immediately before Return value 3 at the time of failure. Don't determine the cause based solely on the last 1603. The logs may contain personal information, so please do not disclose them and provide the necessary information to the production company.
안전 모드도 실패하거나 디스크 읽기 오류가 있으면 복구 명령보다 파일 확: If Safe Mode also fails or disk read errors occur, securing important files takes priority over recovery commands.
실행 중인 Windows의 시스템 파일 복구하기: Recover system files in running Windows
기본 메모리 설정에서도 반복될 때만 메모리 진단 결과로 다음 점검을 정하: Determine the next check based on the memory diagnosis results only if it repeats even with the default memory settings.
메모리 진단 실행과 결과 확인하기: Running memory diagnostics and checking results
롤백 뒤 같은 장치 작업이 정상인지 비교하고, 남은 오류는 덤프 분석으로: Compare whether operation on the same device is normal after rollback, and narrow down remaining errors by analyzing dumps.
진단 오류면 RAM 점검을 우선하세요. 정상 결과도 모든 메모리·드라이버: If there is a diagnostic error, check RAM first. Even normal results do not rule out all memory/driver defects.
안전 모드의 드라이버와 저장장치 상태 확인하기: Check driver and storage status in safe mode
WHEA 기록과 직접 적용한 튜닝 확인하기: Check WHEA events and tuning settings you previously changed
원래 튜닝 항목만 복원한 뒤 기록을 비교하세요. 이벤트 한 개만으로 특정: Restore only the original tuning items and compare records. Do not confirm a specific component failure based on just one event.
기본 설정의 재발과 위험 신호 확인하기: Identify default settings and red flags
USB 분리 조건과 저장장치 드라이버 기록하기: Recording USB disconnection conditions and storage device drivers
어떤 장치 연결이나 디스크 작업에서 재발하는지 좁힌 뒤 필요한 업데이트만: Narrow down which device connections or disk operations are causing the recurrence, then review only the updates you need.
GPU 제조사 앱의 기본 설정, 복구 화면·POST 표시: Default settings of GPU manufacturer app, recovery screen/POST display
GPU 기본값과 화면 접근 가능 여부 확인하기: Check GPU defaults and screen accessibility
직접 변경한 GPU 값 복원만으로 안정되면 추가 변경을 멈추세요. BIO: If restoring only your changed GPU settings makes the system stable, stop further changes. If even the BIOS screen has no video, check video output and POST first.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → GPU: Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → GPU Properties → Driver
지원 드라이버 롤백 후 같은 장면 비교하기: Compare the same scene after rollback of supported drivers
BIOS 인식과 원래 저장장치 모드 확인하기: Check BIOS recognition and original storage mode
BIOS에서 드라이브가 없으면 Windows 복구를 반복하지 마세요. 원: If the drive is not found in BIOS, do not repeat Windows recovery. If you're not sure of the original mode, don't guess and change it.
복구 환경에서 시동 복구 결과 확인하기: Check startup repair results in the recovery environment
DISM·SFC로 시스템 파일 결과 확인하기: Check system file results with DISM·SFC
시스템 파일 복구 후 같은 작업을 비교하고, 반복되면 메모리 결과와 덤프: Compare the same operation after recovering system files, and if repeated, investigate additional causes with memory results and dumps.
메모리 진단 후 덤프 보관하기: Saving a dump after memory diagnosis
외장 장치 조건별 절전·복귀 비교하기: Comparing sleep/return by external device conditions
특정 장치를 뺐을 때만 정상이라면 그 장치의 모델·드라이버부터 점검하세요: If it only works when a specific device is removed, check the model and driver of that device first.
원인 장치의 지원 드라이버 비교하기: Compare supported drivers for the causal device
파일 확보 후 저장장치 상태 기록하기: Record storage device status after securing files
읽기 실패·인식 불안정·SMART 경고가 있으면 추가 쓰기·검사보다 데이: If there is a read failure, recognition instability, or SMART warning, prioritize securing data over additional writing/checking.
실행 가능한 Windows의 시스템 파일 검사하기: Check system files while Windows is running
