오류 볼륨 확인 후 비파괴 검사하기: Perform non-destructive testing after checking the error volume
검사한 대상 문자가 실제 오류 볼륨과 일치하는지 먼저 확인하세요. 정상: First confirm that the drive letter being checked identifies the affected volume. A clean scan does not rule out intermittent drive detection failures.
검사 결과에 따라 저장장치 점검받기: Get your storage device inspected according to the test results
오류 파일의 공급자와 드라이버 변경 확인하기: Check for provider and driver changes for error files
파일명과 공급자가 일치하는 실제 장치만 비교하고 무관한 드라이버를 제거하: Compare only actual devices with matching file names and providers and do not remove unrelated drivers.
VPN·보안 필터의 지원 복구와 덤프 보관하기: Support recovery and dump storage of VPN and security filters
저장·설치·업데이트의 접근 거부 구분하기: Distinguish between denying access to save, install, and update
본인 문서 폴더만 성공하면 대상 경로 권한을 조사하세요. 업데이트·설치: If only your document folder succeeds, check the destination path permissions. Judge update/installation errors as a result of the corresponding function.
해당 기능의 지원 복구만 선택하기: Select only supported recovery for that feature
처음 실패한 같은 기능·경로에서 다시 확인하세요. 저장만 성공하는 결과를: Check again with the same function/path that failed the first time. Do not judge a successful save result as a successful update/installation.
누락 경로와 앱 복구 메뉴 확인하기: Check missing paths and app recovery menu
Record the missing files/paths and occurring functions, then proceed only to that branch.
실패 KB 또는 공식 앱 패키지 확인하기: Check failure KB or official app package
발생 기능의 입력·대상·로그 확인하기: Check inputs, target and logs for the operation that failed
백업·설치·업데이트는 원인이 다릅니다. 확인한 기능과 실패 입력을 기준으: Backup, installation, and update have different causes. Select your next action based on the features you checked and the failure input.
업데이트 진단과 앱·백업 지원 구분하기: Distinguish between update diagnosis and app/backup support
앱 설정과 업데이트 실패 기록 구분하기: Distinguish between app settings and update failure records
앱 한 개의 설정 오류인지 Windows KB 오류인지 먼저 구분하고 해: First, determine whether it is a setting error in one app or a Windows KB error and save the corresponding files and times.
시스템 검사와 발생 기능의 로그 확인하기: Check system scan results and logs for the affected operation
DISM·SFC 결과와 같은 KB 또는 앱의 재실패 여부를 함께 기록하세: Record the DISM/SFC results and whether the same KB or app has failed again. If recovery is not possible, get support with logs from that time.
오류 파일의 원본·대상과 백업 저장장치: Source/destination of error file and backup storage device
읽기 오류 위치와 파일 확보 상태 확인하기: Check the location of read errors and file security status
읽기가 불안정한 드라이브는 반복 시험하지 마세요. 설치 USB 재작성은: Do not repeat testing on drives that are unstable in reading. Rewrite the installation USB only applies to USBs that allow data deletion.
Microsoft 공식 미디어 만들기 도구와 삭제가 허용된 USB: Microsoft Official Media Creation Tool and Erasable USB
대상 USB 삭제 영향을 확인한 뒤 미디어 재작성하기: Verify the impact of deleting the target USB and then rewrite the media
Windows 버전과 복구 실패 로그 확인하기: Check Windows version and recovery failure log
버전·에디션·언어·아키텍처와 원본 이미지를 맞추기 전에는 경로나 인덱스를: Don't guess the path or index before matching the version/edition/language/architecture with the original image.
공식 ISO의 설치 이미지와 에디션별 인덱스: Installation images of official ISOs and indices by edition
조직 PC는 복구 원본 정책을 관리자에게 요청하세요. 개인 PC도 공식: For organization PCs, please ask your administrator for the recovery source policy. You should also check that your personal PC is compatible with the language, edition, version, architecture, and update level of the official ISO as the recovery source for your Windows installation.
호환 ISO를 탑재한 뒤 탐색기에서 실제 드라이브 문자와 sources: After mounting the compatible ISO, check the actual drive letter and the presence of install.wim in the sources folder in Explorer. You can view the list of images with DISM /Get-ImageInfo /ImageFile:E:\sources\install.wim in your administrator terminal. Replace E: with the actual installed letter. If you don't have the file or just install.esd, don't run this WIM example as is.
목록에서 설치 에디션에 맞는 인덱스와 원본 호환성이 확인된 경우에만 DI: You can use the format DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth /Source:wim:E:\sources\install.wim:N /LimitAccess only if the list confirms the index and source compatibility for your installation edition. E: and N must be replaced with the actual characters/indexes you have verified. Do not enter them exactly as in the example. Use only on normal Windows, and if conditions are unclear, use logs for support.
설치하려는 Windows 기능과 코드 확인하기: Check the Windows features and code you want to install
.NET 3.5가 실제 필요한지 확인하고 Windows 기능 창과 선택적: Confirm whether .NET 3.5 is actually required. Distinguish the Windows Features dialog from the separate Optional features page.
기능 설치 경로와 원본 정책 구분하기: Distinguish between feature installation path and source policy
실패 KB와 CBS 로그의 시각 확인하기: Check time of failure KB and CBS logs
Do not assume that there is a lack of partitions until you check the failure entries in the log.
Windows 키+R → services.msc → Enter → Win: Windows+R → services.msc → Enter → Windows Update Properties
서비스의 현재 상태와 시작 유형 기록하기: Record the current state and startup type of a service
사용 안 함인 상태인지 확인하세요. 서비스를 비활성화하라는 지시가 아닙니: Check whether the service is disabled. This is a diagnostic check, not an instruction to disable it.
직접 변경한 시작 유형의 원래 기록·조직 정책: The original history/organization policy of the launch type you changed manually.
직접 끈 원래 설정 복원 또는 관리자 문의하기: Restore original settings or contact administrator
파일 점유 앱과 진행 중인 작업 확인하기: Check which apps are occupying files and which tasks are in progress

여러 기기에서도 같은 주소가 거부되면 서버 운영자에게 전달하고 본인 서버: If the same address is rejected on multiple devices, report it to the server operator and check the server only if it is your server.

시크릿에서만 정상일 때 해당 사이트 데이터 정리를 검토하세요. 삭제 전: When it's OK only in Incognito, review cleaning up that site's data. Please keep what you wrote before deleting it.

사용을 중단하세요. 기기가 뜨겁거나 연기가 나는 상태가 아니고 안전하게: Stop using the device. Only when it is not hot or smoking and it is safe to do so, switch it off and disconnect charging power safely. Keep it from being crushed or contacting flammable materials.

시작 → cmd 검색 → 관리자 권한으로 실행 → 명령 프롬프트: Start → search cmd → Run as administrator → Command Prompt

전원 입력 자체의 문제와 연결 장치 때문에 시작하지 못하는 상태를 구분합: Distinguish between problems with the power input itself and failure to start due to connected devices.

팬이나 키보드 불이 들어오면 완전 무전원과 구분해 화면·POST 문제를: If the fan or keyboard light comes on, check for screen/POST problems to distinguish it from a complete power failure. If still unresponsive, convey the LED pattern and charger ratings to the repair person.
POST가 멈추는 부품과 원래 구성을 비교하기: Compare the part where POST is stuck with the original configuration

메인보드 설명서의 진단등·경고음·RAM 권장 슬롯: Diagnostic lights, warning sounds, and RAM recommended slots in the motherboard manual
부팅 로고가 나타나기 전 계속 남는 CPU·DRAM·VGA·BOOT 표시: Write down the remaining CPU, DRAM, VGA, BOOT indications and beep patterns before the booting logo appears. Diagnostic lights that come on briefly during booting may differ from fault indications.
최근 RAM·그래픽카드 변경 직후라면 전원을 끄고 플러그를 뽑은 상태에서: If you have just recently changed the RAM or graphics card, restore the original normal configuration only when the power is turned off and the plug is unplugged. DRAM 표시가 사라지고 BIOS가 열리면 추가 RAM의 규격·장착을 확: When the DRAM indicator disappears and the BIOS opens, check the specifications and installation of additional RAM. If the CPU indication or immediate power off continues, request inspection with board model and indication history rather than arbitrarily disassembling the CPU socket.
POST가 완료되면 그다음 부팅장치 확인으로 진행하세요. 메모리 훈련 중: After POST completes, check the boot device. During memory training, wait for the time specified by the manufacturer and do not test by repeatedly cutting power.
직접 설정한 안전 부팅 옵션만 해제하기: Disable only the safe boot options you set yourself
일회성 시작 설정으로 들어간 안전 모드와 msconfig에 저장한 지속: Safe mode entered with one-time startup settings and persistent settings saved in msconfig have different unlocking methods.
로그인 가능한 안전 모드에서 Windows 키+R → msconfig →: In safe mode where you can log in, press Windows+R → msconfig → Enter and check the Safe Boot check status in the Boot tab. Only turn off the items you turned on if they are checked.
적용 후 열어 둔 파일을 저장하고 다시 시작하세요. 시작 설정 메뉴에서: After applying, save any open files and restart. If you entered it as a one-time operation in the startup settings menu and there is no check, do not change other boot items and check the result of a normal restart.
정상 부팅이 다시 실패해 자동으로 복구 환경에 들어가면 원래 장애가 남아: If a normal boot fails again and automatically enters the recovery environment, the original fault may remain. Record the error code and recently installed drivers/updates and restore from those changes. Your safe mode password may be different from your PIN.
정상 모드로 돌아오면 해결입니다. 계정 로그인이나 부팅이 불가능하면 임의: If Windows starts normally again, the issue is resolved. If you cannot sign in or boot, secure the recovery key and protect your files before changing or deleting boot configuration.
복구 키 ID에 맞는 48자리 키 찾기: Find the 48-digit key that matches your recovery key ID.
복구 키 ID는 입력할 암호가 아니라 보관된 여러 복구 키 중 올바른 키: The recovery key ID is not a password to enter, but rather an identifier to select the correct key from among several stored recovery keys.
다른 정상 기기의 Microsoft 계정 복구 키 페이지 또는 조직 IT: The Microsoft Account Recovery Key page on another healthy device or your organization's IT support
복구 화면의 키 ID 앞 8자리를 적으세요. 다른 정상 기기에서 브라우저: Record the first 8 characters of the recovery key ID shown on the recovery screen. On another working device, enter https://aka.ms/myrecoverykey in the browser address bar and sign in with the Microsoft account used when the device was first set up.
계정의 복구 키 목록에서 화면의 ID와 일치하는 항목을 찾아 연결된 48: In your account's list of recovery keys, find the one that matches the ID on your screen and enter the associated 48-digit recovery key into your locked device. If there is an account hint on the screen, check the account, but do not send the recovery key itself to the chat or bulletin board.
For work/school devices, contact your organization account or IT representative for the key ID. Check the printout and USB files you have saved, and if someone else set it up for the first time, check to see if they were saved in that account.
ID가 일치하는 키로 잠금이 풀리면 먼저 파일을 백업하세요. 키가 없으면: After unlocking with the key that matches the ID, back up your files. If you cannot find the key, do not try clearing the TPM or deleting partitions as a way to unlock the drive.
잠금 해제 후 반복 원인을 기록하기: Record the cause of repetition after unlocking
키를 한 번 입력해도 BIOS·TPM·부팅 구성 변경이 남으면 다시 복구: Changes to BIOS, TPM or boot configuration can cause the device to request the recovery key again after you have already entered it once.
Windows 잠금 해제 후 최근 BIOS·보안 부팅·부품 변경 기록: History of recent BIOS, secure boot, and component changes after unlocking Windows
잠금 해제 후 최근 BIOS 업데이트·메인보드 교체·부팅 순서 변경 여부: After unlocking, record recent BIOS updates, motherboard replacement or boot-order changes. Do not disable an organization’s security policy yourself; tell IT when the recovery prompt recurs.
복구 키를 찾지 못하면 Microsoft가 분실 키를 재생성해 줄 수 없: If you don't find your recovery key, please check your account/organization/backup path, considering that Microsoft cannot regenerate your lost key. Final reset does not recover encrypted files and may result in data deletion.
키와 백업을 확보한 뒤 제조사·조직 지원으로 반복 원인을 수정하세요. 키: After obtaining the key and backup, correct the cause of the repetition with support from the manufacturer or organization. If you cannot obtain the key, hold off on deleting data.
복구 환경에서 최근 변경과 부팅 복구를 분리하기: Separating recent changes and boot recovery in the recovery environment
부팅되지 않는 PC에서는 실행 중인 Windows용 명령이나 무작위 저장: On a PC that won't boot, you shouldn't apply running Windows commands or random storage mode changes.
Windows 복구 환경 → 문제 해결 → 고급 옵션: Windows Recovery Environment → Troubleshooting → Advanced Options
복구 화면이 열리면 문제 해결 → 고급 옵션 → 시동 복구를 먼저 확인하: When the recovery screen opens, first check Troubleshoot → Advanced options → Startup repair. If you need a BitLocker recovery key, obtain one stored in your account or organization.
업데이트 직후부터 반복되면 고급 옵션 → 업데이트 제거에서 해당되는 최근: If it recurs immediately after an update, review removing the applicable recent quality update in Advanced Options → Uninstall Updates. If you have a restore point, you can restore the system, but check the app/setting impact and backup status.
CPU·보드·저장장치 변경 직후라면 BIOS에서 시스템 드라이브가 보이는: If you have just changed the CPU, board, or storage device, check whether the system drive is visible in BIOS. Do not change AHCI, RAID, VMD mode or secure boot without knowing the original values, and use the record before change or manufacturer support.
부팅이 복구되면 파일 백업 후 오류 코드·변경 내역을 기록하세요. 드라이: When booting is restored, back up your files and record the error code and change history. If the drive disappears or has read errors, prioritize data protection and storage device inspection over repeated recovery.
작업 관리자에서 탐색기를 실행해 셸 문제 구분하기: Run Explorer from Task Manager to isolate shell issues
커서와 보안 화면이 보이면 영상 신호가 없는 상태와 구분해 로그인 셸을: If you see a cursor and a security screen, you can check the login shell to distinguish it from a state where there is no video signal.
Ctrl+Alt+Delete로 보안 화면이 열리는지 확인하고 작업 관리자: Make sure the security screen opens with Ctrl+Alt+Delete and select Task Manager. You can also use Ctrl+Shift+Esc. If you do not see the security screen, check the screen output/booting status instead of this path.
작업 관리자에서 새 작업 실행을 선택하고 explorer.exe를 입력해: Select Run new task in Task Manager and type explorer.exe to run it. When the desktop comes back, save it, then restart normally and check for recurrence.
다시 검게 되면 Windows 키+R → perfmon /rel → En: If it goes black again, open the reliability record with Windows+R → perfmon /rel → Enter to check the Explorer·Display errors at that time. If it works only on the new local account, check the existing profile/startup app and do not delete the original account file.
탐색기 실행으로 복구되면 셸·시작 앱 쪽을 점검하세요. 계정과 무관하게: When it is restored by running Explorer, check the shell and startup apps. If it repeats regardless of your account, check with the latest driver/update.
설치 날짜와 오류 발생 날짜를 맞춰 되돌리기: Revert to the correct installation date and error occurrence date
증상 직전의 변경 하나만 되돌려야 어떤 업데이트가 영향을 줬는지 판단할: You need to revert just one change from before the symptom to determine which update had the effect.
설정의 업데이트 기록·Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc →: Update record of settings: Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Display adapter
Windows에 로그인할 수 있으면 Windows 키+I → Window: If you can log in to Windows, enter the installation date and KB number in Windows+I → Windows Update → Update History. To change the driver, check the version in Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → Display Adapter → Properties → Driver tab.
드라이버 직후부터 발생하고 드라이버 롤백이 가능하면 그 항목 하나만 되돌: If it happens right after the driver and rollback of the driver is possible, just roll back that one item and compare the same operations. If rollback is disabled, check the stable version of the model provided by the manufacturer and do not use driver tools from unknown sources.
로그인 자체가 불가능하면 복구 환경 → 문제 해결 → 고급 옵션에서 최근: If you cannot sign in, use Recovery Environment → Troubleshoot → Advanced options to uninstall the relevant recent update or open Safe Mode through Startup Settings. Obtain the recovery key first if the drive is encrypted. Do not confuse these options with resetting the PC, which can erase personal files.
되돌린 뒤 정상화되면 변경한 버전·KB와 결과를 기록하세요. 변화가 없으: After reverting and returning to normal, record the changed version/KB and results. If there is no change, do not remove the same update repeatedly, but reclassify it by the scope of failure by screen output or app.
케이블·입력 소스·포트를 한 개씩 교차 비교하기: Cross-compare cables, input sources, and ports one by one
확장 설정으로 해결되지 않으면 모니터 입력과 실제 케이블 경로를 구분해야: If the extended setup doesn't work, you'll need to separate the monitor input from the actual cable path.
Windows 키+P, Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 디스플레이와: Windows+P, Windows+I → System → Display and Monitor OSD
Windows 키+P에서 확장을 선택하고 Windows 키+I → 시스템: Select the extension in Windows+P and check detection in Windows+I → System → Display → Multiple displays. If you see two screen squares, match the number with the actual screen by identifying them.
모니터 버튼으로 입력 소스를 연결한 HDMI·DisplayPort와 일치: Use the monitor button to match the input source to the connected HDMI/DisplayPort. Remove the hub/converter and connect the PC and monitor directly using a supported video cable.
같은 케이블에서 다른 모니터는 정상인지, 같은 모니터가 다른 출력 포트에: Change the conditions one by one to see if other monitors on the same cable are normal or if the same monitor is visible through different output ports. Please check the model specifications for video output support and maximum number of screens for USB-C ports and docking devices.
특정 케이블·변환기에서만 실패하면 그 경로를 점검하세요. 모니터가 설정에: If the failure occurs only in a specific cable/converter, check the route. If the monitor is visible in the settings but is black, lower the resolution and refresh rate to a supported resolution and compare.
절전 진입 여부와 깨우기 후 화면 복귀 분리하기: Separate whether to enter sleep mode and return to screen after waking up
절전이 되지 않는 상태와 잠에서 깼지만 영상만 안 나오는 상태는 다릅니다: The state of not being able to sleep and the state of waking up but no video are different.
관리자 명령 프롬프트·Windows 전원 옵션·모니터 입력 소스: Administrator Command Prompt·Windows Power Options·Monitor Input Source
시작에서 cmd를 검색해 명령 프롬프트를 관리자 권한으로 열고 power: Open Command Prompt as administrator by searching for cmd in Start and check the supported sleep status with powercfg /a. For cover symptoms, check the battery and power connection settings in Control Panel → Power Options → What happens when the cover is closed.
파일을 저장한 뒤 시작 메뉴의 절전으로 한 번 진입해 전원 버튼을 짧게: After saving the file, go to Sleep in the Start menu and briefly press the power button to wake it up. If the sound and keyboard response return but the screen is black, check the monitor input and cable/output path. Avoid holding down the power button as it will force a shutdown.
스스로 깨어나는 문제라면 깨운 직후 powercfg /lastwake와: If the problem is waking up on your own, write down the results powercfg /lastwake and powercfg /waketimers immediately after waking up. Do not apply Disable Wake to problems where the problem is unresponsive when the user wakes it.
메뉴 절전은 정상인데 덮개만 실패하면 덮개 설정·도킹 조건을, 정상적으로: If the menu sleep is normal but the lid fails, check the lid settings and docking conditions, and if it wakes up normally but there is no video, check the output/graphics driver path.
표시된 장치와 설치 패키지의 지원 모델 비교하기: Compare the supported models of the indicated device and installation package
Microsoft 기본 디스플레이 어댑터로 보이는 상태와 PCIe 장치: There is a difference between being visible as a Microsoft default display adapter and not seeing the PCIe device itself.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter로 장치 관리: Open Device Manager with Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter and check the names and error codes of the display adapter and other devices. Properties → Details → Hardware ID will help you find the exact device.
PC 제조사 또는 GPU 제조사의 공식 다운로드 페이지에서 GPU 모델·: Check the official download page of your PC manufacturer or GPU manufacturer to confirm that your GPU model, Windows version, and architecture are correct. For laptops, first follow the order of applying the hybrid graphics driver provided by the manufacturer.
기본 어댑터나 오류 장치가 있으면 호환 패키지 설치 결과·오류 문구를 기: If there is a default adapter or faulty device, record the compatibility package installation results and error message. If you do not have the device itself and can confirm that it is mounted on the desktop, completely turn it off and disconnect the power source, then check only the auxiliary power source and installation status according to the manual.
If a normal model appears and the error code disappears, check with the actual app output. If it is not recognized, check the hardware path rather than repeating driver reinstallation.
작업 관리자 GPU 엔진과 프레임 제한 비교하기: Task Manager Comparing GPU Engines and Frame Limits
GPU 사용률이 낮아도 프레임 제한·CPU 병목·다른 GPU 사용 때문에: Low GPU utilization may be normal due to frame throttling, CPU bottleneck, or other GPU usage.
Ctrl+Shift+Esc → 작업 관리자 → 프로세스·성능, 게임 그래: Ctrl+Shift+Esc → Task Manager → Process/Performance, Game Graphics Settings
게임을 실행한 상태에서 Ctrl+Shift+Esc로 작업 관리자를 열고: With the game running, open Task Manager with Ctrl+Shift+Esc and compare the GPU Engine column in the process with the GPU name in the Performance tab. Check whether the game uses the external GPU's 3D engine.
게임의 프레임 제한·수직 동기화와 모니터 주사율을 적고, 같은 장면에서: Write down the game's frame limit, vertical sync, and monitor refresh rate, and compare by changing only one limit setting in the same scene. For CPU, check the load per logical processor as well as the overall average.
내장 GPU로 실행된다면 Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 디스플레이: If it runs with the built-in GPU, check the GPU default settings of the game executable file in Windows+I → System → Display → Graphics. Compare laptops even when connected to the rated adapter.
Once you reach your target FPS, don't view low GPU usage as a malfunction in itself. If the FPS is low and only a specific CPU thread is high, check the CPU/game workload, and if the clock/temperature is abnormal, check the power/cooling.
검색창 자체 오류와 색인 누락을 나눠 확인하기: Check for errors in the search box itself and missing indexes.
검색 UI가 열리지 않는 문제와 특정 폴더만 결과에서 빠지는 문제는 조치: The actions for issues where the search UI does not open and issues where only specific folders are omitted from the results require different actions.
작업 표시줄 검색, Windows 키+I → 개인정보 및 보안 → Win: Taskbar search, Windows+I → Privacy and security → Windows search
Windows 키+S를 눌러 검색창이 열리는지 확인하세요. 앱 이름은 나: Press Windows+S to see if a search box opens. If the app name appears but only certain files are missing, do not assume that the entire search function is broken.
파일 누락은 Windows 키+I → 개인정보 및 보안 → Windows: For missing files, check the search scope, excluded folders, and index status in Windows+I → Privacy and Security → Windows Search. For Windows 10, check the Search → Windows Search menu.
검색창 자체가 멈추면 Ctrl+Shift+Esc → 작업 관리자에서 Wi: If the search bar itself freezes, select Ctrl+Shift+Esc → Windows Explorer in Task Manager to restart it and compare it to a normal restart. Select Re-index only when the path is included but missing and wait for it to complete.
제외 폴더를 바로잡은 뒤 파일이 검색되면 해결입니다. 모든 앱 검색도 실: The problem is resolved when the file is retrieved after correcting the excluded folder. If searching all apps fails, check Windows Update and system file check results.
DISM·SFC 메시지에 따라 재부팅·복구 판단하기: Determine reboot/recovery based on DISM/SFC messages
검사를 실행했다는 사실보다 복구 성공·복구 불가라는 결과가 다음 조치를: The results of successful or impossible recovery determine the next action rather than the fact that the scan was run.
실행 중인 Windows의 관리자 명령 프롬프트: Running an administrator command prompt in Windows
Windows가 정상 로그인되는 상태에서 시작에 cmd를 입력하고 명령: With Windows logged in normally, type cmd in Start and run Command Prompt with administrator privileges. Enter DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth and wait for the completion message.
DISM이 성공하면 sfc /scannow를 실행하고 종료 메시지를 기록: If DISM succeeds, run sfc /scannow and log the exit message. If you have recovered the damaged file, save and reboot to check again the app/task that originally failed.
복구 원본을 찾지 못하거나 일부 파일을 복구하지 못했다면 오류 코드·Wi: If you cannot find the recovery source or cannot recover some files, record the error code/Windows version and log path. Rather than repeating the /Online command in the recovery environment, check the official recovery installation path for your version.
복구 후 원래 증상이 사라지면 반복 검사를 멈추세요. 재부팅마다 손상이: If the original symptoms disappear after recovery, stop repeat testing. If the damage recurs every time you reboot, check for storage device read errors and update failures as well.
정품 인증 오류 코드와 구매 에디션 대조하기: Match activation error code with purchased edition
유효한 키도 설치 에디션과 다르거나 조직 인증용이면 개인 PC에서 정상: If the valid key is different from the installation edition or is for organizational authentication, it may not be authenticated properly on a personal PC.
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 정품 인증과 구매 내역: Windows+I → System → Product activation and purchase history
Windows 키+I로 설정을 열고 시스템 → 정품 인증에서 에디션·인증: Press Windows+I, open System → Activation, and note the edition, activation status and error code. On Windows 10, open Update & Security → Activation.
구매 내역의 Home·Pro와 설치 에디션이 같은지 비교하세요. 하드웨어: Compare Home·Pro in your purchase history to see if the installation edition is the same. If you've just changed your hardware, sign in with the Microsoft account associated with your digital license and select Troubleshoot activation issues.
회사·학교가 제공한 라이선스면 조직 네트워크·VPN 필요 여부와 기기 할: If the license is provided by your company or school, check with your administrator whether an organization network or VPN is required and device allocation. Don't run authentication bypass tools or cheap keys from unknown sources.
에디션 불일치는 해당 라이선스의 지원 경로로 수정하세요. 에디션이 맞아도: If there is an edition mismatch, please correct it through the support path for the corresponding license. If the correct edition fails, contact Microsoft or your place of purchase with the error code and proof of purchase.
복구 종류와 실패 코드에 맞춰 다음 경로 선택하기: Select the following path based on recovery type and failure code:
시스템 복원과 PC 초기화는 영향 범위가 다르므로 실패했다고 다른 복구를: System Restore and Reset PC have different impact areas, so you should not immediately run another recovery if it fails.
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 복구 또는 Windows 복구 환경: Windows+I → System → Recovery or Windows Recovery Environment → Troubleshooting
실패 화면의 오류 코드·백분율·선택했던 복구 옵션을 적으세요. Windo: On the failure screen, write down the error code, percentage, and recovery option you selected. If you can log in to Windows, copy important files to a separate storage device and obtain the BitLocker recovery key first.
복원 지점이 있으면 Windows 키+R → rstrui.exe → En: If you have a restore point, select a date before the error in Windows+R → rstrui.exe → Enter and check the search for affected programs. If you don't have a restore point, you won't be able to restore the past state from a newly created point.
초기화가 실패한 경우에는 시스템 → 복구에서 사용 가능한 복구 옵션과 공: If initialization fails, check System → Recovery for available recovery options and official installation media. Keeping my files does not mean preserving apps and settings, and choosing to delete or reinstall files only after backing up and checking the scope of impact.
Windows가 열리면 실패 기록을 확인한 뒤 한 가지 복구만 선택하세요: When Windows opens, check the failure history and select only one recovery. If there is a storage device read error or backup is not secured, prioritize data protection over repeated initialization.
메모리 증가와 정상 종료 후 반환을 기록하기: Record memory growth and return after normal shutdown
높은 사용률만으로 RAM 고장을 판단하지 않고, 어떤 프로세스가 계속 메: Rather than judging RAM failure based on high usage alone, check which processes are still holding memory.
Ctrl+Shift+Esc로 작업 관리자를 열고 세부 정보의 열 머리글을: Open Task Manager with Ctrl+Shift+Esc, right-click on the column header in Details, and select Column to display Commit Size. Performance → Also write down the In Use, Available, and Committed values ​​for memory.
같은 앱에서 같은 작업을 한 번 수행한 전후와 잠시 대기한 후의 값을 비: Compare the values before and after performing the same action once in the same app and after waiting for a while. Check if usage decreases when you normally close the saved app. Do not forcefully terminate system processes.
특정 앱을 다시 실행할 때마다 커밋이 계속 늘면 앱 업데이트 후 확장 기: If the number of commits continues to increase every time you run a specific app again, after updating the app, exclude extensions and plugins one by one and compare them. If it increases even after closing all apps, forward the memory tab record of Windows+R → resmon → Enter to your support person.
정상 종료 뒤 반환되면 앱의 작업량·캐시일 수 있습니다. 동일 작업에서: If memory is released after the app exits normally, the usage may be related to its workload or cache. If memory keeps growing during the same task, send the app version, reproduction steps and measurements to its support team. Do not buy more RAM as the first response.
커지는 항목을 분류하고 안전한 정리만 선택하기: Sort through growing items and choose only safe cleanup.
임시 파일처럼 보여도 다운로드·휴지통에는 보관할 개인 파일이 있을 수 있: Even if they look like temporary files, there may be personal files in the Downloads or Recycle Bin that you want to keep.
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 저장소 → 임시 파일·설치된 앱: Windows+I → System → Storage → Temporary files/installed apps
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 저장소에서 임시 파일·앱·기타 항목의: Windows+I → System → Storage, write down the size of temporary files, apps, and other items. Do not select the Download/Trash bin items in the temporary file list until you check the actual files.
불필요한 임시 항목만 정리한 뒤 여유 공간을 기록하고 같은 작업 후 다시: After clearing out only unnecessary temporary items, note the free space and check again after doing the same. If the cache/log of a specific app continues to grow, use the app's storage management function or support instructions to organize it.
Windows 폴더·WinSxS·페이지 파일·복구 파티션을 탐색기에서 임: Do not arbitrarily delete the Windows folder, WinSxS, Page File, or Recovery Partition from Explorer. Copy large personal files to an external storage device and see if the copy opens before deciding whether to delete the original.
한 번 정리한 뒤에도 같은 항목이 빠르게 증가하면 해당 앱·업데이트의 반: If the same items increase rapidly even after organizing once, check the history of repeated failures of the app or update. Once you have free space, stop further deletion.
M.2 규격과 공유 포트·장착 상태 확인하기: Check M.2 specifications and shared port/installation status
M.2 모양이 같아도 SATA·NVMe 지원과 레인 공유 조건이 다를 수: Even if the M.2 shape is the same, SATA·NVMe support and lane sharing conditions may be different.
메인보드 저장장치 지원 표·BIOS 저장장치 정보: Motherboard storage device support table/BIOS storage device information
SSD 라벨의 모델과 보드 모델을 적고 해당 M.2 슬롯이 SATA·NV: Write down the model and board model on the SSD label and check in the manual whether the M.2 slot supports SATA or NVMe. Also check the sharing conditions that are disabled when using other SATA ports.
장착 확인은 완전 종료·전원 분리 후에만 하세요. 직접 작업 가능한 기기: Check installation only after complete shutdown/disconnection of power. In a device that you can work with, check that the SSD is fully inserted and secured according to the manual, and if there are restrictions on the laptop warranty or disassembly, request inspection.
호환되는 다른 슬롯이나 다른 PC에서의 인식 여부는 장비가 있을 때만 비: Compare whether the device is recognized in other compatible slots or on another PC only when the device is available. If the SSD model is visible in the BIOS but fails to boot, change the path to boot item issue instead of poor recognition.
중요 데이터가 있는 SSD가 간헐적으로 사라지면 쓰기·설치·초기화를 멈추: If the SSD containing important data disappears intermittently, stop writing, installing, or initializing. If the model is not visible in the compatible slot, request storage device/board inspection.
기존 데이터 여부를 확인한 뒤 볼륨 생성 판단하기: Determine volume creation after checking for existing data
할당되지 않음은 새 빈 디스크일 수도 있지만 파티션 정보가 사라진 상태일: Unallocated may mean a new, blank disk, but it may also mean that the partition information has disappeared.
Windows 키+X → 디스크 관리 → 디스크 번호·용량·할당 상태: Windows+X → Disk Management → Disk number/capacity/allocation status
Windows 키+X → 디스크 관리를 열고 해당 디스크의 번호·전체 용: Windows+X → Open Disk Management and match the disk number, total capacity, and connection type with the label. Don't choose another disk just based on capacity.
전에 파일이 있던 디스크라면 초기화·새 단순 볼륨·포맷을 선택하지 말고: If there were files on the disk before, do not select Initialize/New Simple Volume/Format and stop writing. Make sure you have backups, and if you have any important files, report their status to the recovery person.
정말 새 빈 디스크이며 기존 데이터가 필요 없다는 것이 확실할 때만 대상: Only when you are sure that it is truly a new blank disk and that you do not need any existing data, double-check the target disk and create a new simple volume. Make sure it is not confused with the Windows installation disk/backup disk.
예상 용량이 0이거나 연결이 반복 해제되면 파티션 작업보다 케이블·장치: If the estimated capacity is 0 or the connection is repeatedly disconnected, check cables and devices before partitioning. Do not create a new volume on a disk from which files have disappeared.
손실 위험을 구분하고 복구 상담 준비하기: Identify risk of loss and prepare for recovery consultation
반복 클릭과 읽기 실패가 함께 있으면 반복 검사보다 추가 손상 방지가 우: A combination of repeated clicks and read failures takes precedence over repeated testing to prevent further damage.
HDD 소리·인식 해제·파일 읽기 실패 기록: HDD sound/recognition release/file read failure record
새로운 반복 클릭과 파일 읽기 실패가 함께 나타나면 전원을 끄고 사용을: If you see a combination of new repeated clicks and file read failures, turn it off and stop using it. Do not turn on a disk that has already been turned off multiple times to check.
디스크 모델·언제부터 소리가 났는지·떨어뜨린 적이 있는지·필요한 파일과: Please write down the disk model, when the sound started, whether it has ever been dropped, the files needed and whether there is a backup. Do not shake the disk or attempt to freeze, shock, disassemble, or repeat CHKDSK.
중요 파일이 유일한 원본이면 복구 업체에 상태와 우선 복구할 파일을 알리: If an important file is the only original, inform the recovery company of its status and the files to be recovered first, and check the cost and method of preserving the original before inspection. Please note that disk warranty exchange is separate from data recovery.
추가 전원 투입을 멈추고 데이터 복구·교체 경로를 결정하세요. 물리 고장: Stop applying additional power and decide on a data recovery/replacement path. Do not continue to apply regular Windows repair procedures to disks that may have physical failures.
백업 존재와 교체 후 복원을 확인하기: Verify backup existence and restore after replacement
Before replacing a disk, you should make sure you have a truly readable backup.
다른 정상 기기의 백업 파일·클라우드·외장 백업: Backup files/cloud/external backup of other normal devices
고장 의심 HDD를 켜지 않고 다른 기기에서 클라우드·외장 백업에 필요한: Without turning on the suspected HDD, check whether there are files needed for cloud or external backup on another device. Don't just look at the file name, see if a legitimate copy opens.
복구가 필요 없고 백업이 충분하면 고장 의심 디스크를 계속 사용하는 대신: If recovery is not necessary and you have sufficient backups, arrange for a replacement rather than continuing to use the suspect disk. If recovery is necessary, consult with recovery first before initializing, formatting, or returning the original disk for warranty.
정상 백업이 확보되면 새 저장장치에 복원하세요. 백업이 불완전하면 추가: Once you have a good backup, restore it to a new storage device. If the backup is incomplete, first determine the possibility of preserving and recovering the original without additional writing.
CPU 지원 버전과 화면 출력 경로 대조하기: Contrast CPU support version with screen output path
소켓이 맞아도 BIOS 지원 버전이나 CPU 내장 그래픽 유무가 다르면: Even if the socket matches, the screen may not appear if the BIOS support version or the presence or absence of CPU built-in graphics is different.
보드에 인쇄된 모델·리비전 → 제조사 CPU 지원 목록과 후면 영상 포트: Model/revision printed on the board → Manufacturer CPU support list and rear video port
보드 모델·리비전과 CPU의 정확한 모델명을 적고 제조사 CPU 지원 목: Enter your board model/revision and the exact model name of your CPU and find the minimum BIOS version required from the manufacturer's CPU support list. Compare your existing BIOS version to the BIOS screen opened by your existing CPU or the information you have archived.
CPU에 내장 그래픽이 없는 모델이면 메인보드 영상 포트 대신 정상 장착: If the CPU does not have built-in graphics, connect the monitor to the port of the properly installed graphics card instead of the motherboard video port. Try matching the screen input source to the actual cable.
BIOS가 너무 오래됐다면 해당 보드가 지원하는 CPU 없는 BIOS 업: If the BIOS is too old, use the board’s supported CPU-less BIOS update feature, a compatible older CPU, or manufacturer service. Do not attempt a BIOS update with an unverified file or while power is unstable.
지원 BIOS와 정상 출력 경로에서도 CPU 진단등이 남으면 소켓·전원·: If the CPU diagnostic light remains even in the supported BIOS and normal output path, request a socket, power, and CPU compatibility check. Reinstalling Windows is not a workaround for POST failures.
한 개 모듈의 권장 슬롯과 호환 규격 확인하기: Check recommended slots and compatibility specifications for one module
새 RAM 한 개와 기존 구성을 비교하면 슬롯·모듈·호환성 중 어느 조건: Comparing a piece of new RAM to an existing configuration can help you narrow down whether it's failing due to slots, modules, or compatibility.
메인보드 설명서의 메모리 장착 표와 호환 목록: Memory placement table and compatibility list in the motherboard manual
After disconnecting the power source, restore only the RAM that was working properly to the original slot. Once the BIOS opens, verify that the existing capacity is correct and isolate it from a new module issue.
설명서의 한 개 장착 권장 슬롯에 호환 RAM 한 개만 장착해 비교하세요: Compare by installing only one compatible RAM into the slot recommended in the manual. Check whether the DDR generation/module type and recommended combination are correct, and compare XMP/EXPO in the default settings.
DDR5 첫 부팅은 훈련 시간이 길 수 있으므로 제조사가 안내한 시간을: The DDR5 first boot may require a long training time, so wait for the time indicated by the manufacturer. Note whether only one module or a specific slot fails and avoid repeating the same failure.
기존 RAM은 정상인데 새 RAM만 실패하면 규격·BIOS 지원·모듈 불: If the existing RAM is normal but the new RAM fails, check for specifications, BIOS support, and module defects. If the existing configuration fails, proceed with installation and board inspection.
장치 관리자 상태와 제조사 드라이버 확인하기: Check device manager status and manufacturer drivers
Distinguish between a state in which the network list is empty and a state in which the adapter itself is missing.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → 네트워크 어댑터·Blu: Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Network adapter, Bluetooth, other devices
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter로 장치 관리: Open Device Manager with Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter and write down the corresponding adapter name and error code. If you see the arrow below, check if it is in the disabled state and change it to use only the devices you turned off.
기타 장치에 미설치 장치가 있으면 PC 제조사의 정확한 모델용 무선·Bl: If there are any other devices that are not installed, obtain the wireless/Bluetooth/LAN drivers for the exact model from your PC manufacturer. If you don't have internet access, get the official file from another PC and transfer it to USB and avoid random driver download tools.
어댑터가 목록에 전혀 없으면 비행기 모드·기기의 물리 무선 스위치·BIO: If your adapter isn't listed at all, compare Airplane mode, your device's physical wireless switch, and BIOS support settings to your model's documentation. Please prepare a reinstallation file before deleting the driver, and for warranty devices, request inspection instead of disassembling the internal module.
장치가 정상으로 나타나면 실제 연결 목록·페어링으로 확인하세요. 오류 코: If the device appears normal, check the actual connection list/pairing. If an error code remains or the device continues to disappear, have the manufacturer inspected by code, model, and occurrence condition.
같은 서버에서 링크 속도와 실제 전송을 비교하기: Compare link speed and actual transfer on the same server
Link negotiation speed, Internet line speed, and file transfer speed are different values.
Windows 네트워크 연결 속성·공유기 LAN 포트 사양: Windows network connection properties/router LAN port specifications
Windows 키+I → 네트워크 및 인터넷에서 연결 속성의 링크 속도를: Windows+I → In Network and Internet, write down the link speed in the connection properties. For wired, check whether both the PC and router ports support Gigabit, and for wireless, check the connection band and signal strength.
유선이 100Mbps로 잡히면 정상으로 확인된 Cat5e 이상 케이블과: If the wired speed is set to 100Mbps, compare once with a Cat5e or higher cable that has been confirmed to be normal and a gigabit port. Keep the default auto-negotiation for speed and duplex settings and don't try to fix it with an arbitrary 1Gbps fix.
Wi-Fi는 공유기 가까운 위치와 평소 위치에서 같은 속도 측정 서버로: Compare Wi-Fi using the same speed measurement server at a location close to the router and at your usual location. Stop any other downloads and, if possible, distinguish between wireless and Internet lines by comparing them with wired results from the same PC.
가까이서만 빨라지면 무선 간섭·거리 문제를, 유선도 느리면 회선·공유기·: If it's only fast up close, check for wireless interference and distance issues, and if it's slow on a wired connection, check for the line, router, and background traffic. Just because the link is normal doesn't mean the actual service speed is normal.
기본 게이트웨이와 외부 응답을 같은 조건에서 측정하기: Measuring the default gateway and external response under the same conditions
내부 무선 구간의 지연과 인터넷·서비스 경로 지연을 나누면 불필요한 Wi: By dividing the delay of the internal wireless section and the delay of the Internet/service path, you can avoid unnecessary Windows initialization.
시작 → cmd → 명령 프롬프트, ipconfig와 ping 출력: Start → cmd → command prompt, ipconfig and ping output
시작에서 cmd를 검색해 명령 프롬프트를 열고 ipconfig를 입력하세: Open Command Prompt by searching for cmd in Start and type ipconfig. Check the default gateway address for the connection you are currently using and do not confuse it with the address for an adapter you are not connected to.
ping 뒤에 확인한 게이트웨이 주소를 넣고 -n 20을 붙여 20회 측: Enter the confirmed gateway address after ping and add -n 20 to measure 20 times. Do not use the example address as is, but replace it with your own router address. Stop other downloads at the same time and compare wired and wireless.
그다음 응답을 허용하는 외부 대상이나 서비스가 제공하는 진단 도구로 비교: Then compare with diagnostic tools provided by external entities or services that allow responses. Since ICMP responses from specific targets may be blocked or have priority restrictions, do not confirm a line failure based solely on ping loss.
게이트웨이부터 불안정하면 케이블·무선·공유기를, 내부는 안정적인데 실제: If the gateway is unstable, check the cable, wireless, or router. If the internal service is stable but the actual service is bad, check the relevant service or external route. Please record the time zone and measurement conditions.
접속 계정과 공유·폴더 권한을 각각 확인하기: Check each access account and sharing/folder permissions
Being connected to the server and having permission to read or write the file are two different things.
Windows 키+R → 공유 경로 입력, 자격 증명 관리자와 공유 PC: Windows+R → Enter shared path, folder properties on shared PC with Credential Manager
Windows 키+R을 누르고 관리자에게 받은 정확한 공유 경로를 입력하: Press Windows+R and enter the exact sharing path you received from your administrator. The example path is in the form \server name/share name and must be replaced with the actual server/share name. Write down whether the error text is No Path or Access Denied.
암호를 바꾼 뒤부터 실패하면 시작에서 자격 증명 관리자를 검색해 Wind: If it fails after changing your password, search for Credential Manager in Start to check just the corresponding server entry in Windows Credentials. Only clear old entries and reconnect to the correct shared account if you know your account.
공유 PC 관리자에게 폴더 속성의 공유 권한과 보안 탭 권한을 함께 확인: Ask the administrator of the PC hosting the share to check both share permissions and the Security tab permissions for the folder. Do not enable SMB1, passwordless guest access, or turn off the firewall to make the connection work.
서버 이름으로만 실패하면 이름 해석을, 경로는 열리지만 쓰기만 거부되면: If only the server name fails, check name resolution, and if the path is opened but only writes are denied, check permissions. For organizational sharing, convey errors and paths to administrators without arbitrarily expanding permissions.
연결 규격과 작은 파일·큰 파일 조건 나누기: Divide connection specifications and small file/large file conditions
작은 파일 다수와 큰 파일 한 개는 같은 장치에서도 전송 속도가 크게 다: Multiple small files and one large file can have very different transfer speeds, even on the same device.
USB 장치·케이블 규격과 파일 탐색기의 전송 상태: USB device/cable specifications and file explorer transfer status
장치·외장 케이스·케이블·포트가 모두 USB 3.x 전송을 지원하는지 모: Check the model specifications to see if the device, external case, cable, and port all support USB 3.x transmission. Charge-only or USB 2.0 cables may look the same but have different speeds. Remove the hub and connect it directly to the main body port.
정상 원본의 큰 파일 한 개를 복사해 속도를 보고, 작은 파일 여러 개를: Copy one large file from a healthy source to see the speed, and compare it to copying multiple small files. Use copy instead of move, and don't erase the original until you're sure the copy will open.
정상 호환 케이블·포트에서만 속도가 나아지면 연결 경로를 점검하세요. 전: If the speed improves only with a properly compatible cable/port, check the connection path. If interruption, reading error, or abnormal heat occurs during transmission, stop the repeat speed test and prioritize data protection.
처음만 빠르고 이후 느려지는 것은 저장장치 캐시·발열·여유 공간 영향도: The reason it is fast at first and then slow down is due to storage cache, heat generation, and free space. If the error repeats even with a stable connection, check the device/case.
입력 중 오작동과 충전기 연결 영향을 비교하기: Compare the impact of malfunctions during input and charger connection
손바닥 접촉·터치패드 설정과 외부 전원·주변 장치 영향을 나눠 확인합니다: Check the palm contact/touchpad settings and the influence of external power/peripheral devices.
Windows 키+I → Bluetooth 및 장치 → 터치패드에서 현재: Windows+I → Bluetooth & Devices → Note the current sensitivity and tap settings in Touchpad. Decrease the sensitivity by one level and compare whether the cursor moves only while typing. If there is no menu, check the manufacturer's touchpad settings.
외장 마우스가 준비된 경우에만 터치패드를 잠시 꺼 비교하세요. 외장 마우: Only compare by temporarily turning off the touchpad if you have an external mouse ready. If the external mouse is normal and only the touchpad is bouncing, narrow the scope to sensors, settings, and drivers.
배터리로 사용할 때와 제조사 정격 충전기를 연결했을 때를 같은 조건에서: Compare battery operation with operation using the manufacturer-approved charger under the same conditions. If the cursor jumps only with a particular charger or USB device connected, disconnect it and contact support. Stop using the device if you feel electrical tingling or notice a swollen battery.
설정 하나를 바꾼 뒤 효과가 없으면 원래 값으로 복원하세요. 표면을 닦아: If you change one setting and it doesn't work, restore it to its original value. If a particular area continues to malfunction even after cleaning the surface, request that the model-specific driver and touchpad be inspected.
수신 대기와 통화 앱 모니터링을 하나씩 끄기: Turn off listening and calling app monitoring one by one
같은 마이크 소리를 Windows와 앱이 동시에 재생하면 지연된 자기 목: If Windows and an app play the same microphone sound at the same time, the delayed own voice may overlap.
Windows 키+R → mmsys.cpl → 녹음 → 마이크 속성 →: Windows+R → mmsys.cpl → Recording → Microphone properties → Listening
Windows 키+R → mmsys.cpl → Enter → 녹음 탭에서: Windows+R → mmsys.cpl → Enter → Open the properties of the microphone used in the recording tab. If Listen to this device is turned on, turn it off, apply it, and see if the duplication of your own voice is reduced.
통화·녹음 앱의 마이크 모니터링·사이드톤 설정도 확인하고 한 번에 하나만: Also check the microphone monitoring and sidetone settings in the calling/recording app and turn off one at a time. The function name varies depending on the app/headset manufacturer.
스피커 소리가 마이크로 다시 들어오는지 헤드폰을 사용해 비교하세요. 상대: Use headphones to compare the speaker sound to see if it comes back to the microphone. If only the other person can hear the sound, check your output volume and microphone position, and if only you can hear it, check the reception/monitoring path first.
중복 재생이 사라지면 원인이었던 모니터링 하나만 꺼 두세요. 특정 앱만: If the duplicate playback goes away, just turn off the monitoring that was causing it. If only a specific app remains, check its input/output devices and echo cancellation settings.
프린터 테스트 페이지와 단순 문서로 범위 좁히기: Narrow it down to printer test pages and simple documents
자체 출력·Windows 테스트·특정 앱 문서를 분리하면 어디서 대기하는: Compare the printer’s built-in test, the Windows test page and an application document separately to identify where printing slows down.
프린터 조작 패널·Windows 프린터 속성·앱 인쇄 미리보기: Printer operation panel/Windows printer properties/App print preview
기기 조작 패널에서 자체 보고서를 출력한 뒤 Windows 키+I → B: After printing the self-report from the device's operation panel, check the printer's properties/test page at Windows+I → Bluetooth and devices → Printers and scanners. Start by recording your own report to see if it's slow.
테스트 페이지는 정상이라면 메모장에 한 줄을 입력해 출력하세요. 특정 P: If the test page is normal, enter one line in notepad and print it. If only a specific PDF/app is slow or fails, select the same printer for other files and other apps to compare.
Check whether any erroneous tasks are blocking your queue and cancel only your own tasks. Make sure the address/online status of the network printer matches the printer model selected by the app, and do not arbitrarily delete other people's shared jobs.
자체 출력도 실패하면 기기·소모품을, Windows 테스트부터 실패하면: If self-printing fails, check the device/consumables, if the Windows test fails, check the connection/driver, and if only a specific document fails, check the app/document settings.
자체 품질 보고서와 잉크·토너 점검하기: Check your own quality report and ink and toner
프린터 자체 보고서도 나쁘면 Windows 앱 설정보다 소모품·인쇄 엔진: If the printer's own report is also bad, you should check supplies/print engine before Windows app settings.
프린터 조작 패널 → 유지 관리·인쇄 품질 보고서, 용지·소모품 표시: Printer operation panel → Maintenance/print quality report, paper/consumables display
프린터 조작 패널에서 모델이 제공하는 인쇄 품질 보고서나 노즐 검사 패턴: Print the print quality report or nozzle check pattern provided by your model from the printer control panel. Compare it with a PC document on the same paper and record the locations of lines, missing colors, and bleeding.
잉크젯은 노즐 패턴에 빠진 선이 있을 때만 설명서의 헤드 청소 횟수를 따: For inkjet, follow the head cleaning frequency in the manual only if there are missing lines in the nozzle pattern. For lasers, check the toner/drum life and paper type and do not apply the nozzle cleaning instructions for inkjet.
자체 보고서는 정상이라면 앱에서 용지 종류·품질·배율을 맞추고 다른 문서: If the self-report is normal, adjust the paper type, quality, and scale in the app and compare it with another document. Ink will be consumed as you repeat cleaning, so do not repeat if there is no improvement.
자체 보고서도 같은 결함이면 소모품·기기 점검으로, 특정 앱·문서만 나쁘: If the self-report shows the same defect, narrow the scope to inspection of consumables and devices. If only a specific app or document is bad, narrow the scope to the app, file, and driver settings.
스캔 앱과 연결 방식별로 실제 인식 비교하기: Compare actual recognition by scanning app and connection method
Just because it prints doesn't mean that the scanner driver and scanning app are normal.
Windows 스캔 앱·제조사 스캔 앱과 프린터 및 스캐너 설정: Windows scan app/manufacturer scan app and printer and scanner settings
Windows 키+I → Bluetooth 및 장치 → 프린터 및 스캐너: Check the all-in-one model at Windows+I → Bluetooth and devices → Printers and scanners. Open your manufacturer scan app or your installed Windows scan app and see if the same model is in the device selection list.
USB는 허브를 빼고 본체에 직접 연결해 비교하세요. 네트워크 스캔은 스: For USB, remove the hub and connect it directly to the main unit to compare. For network scanning, check whether the scanner and PC are on the same accessible network, and compare the address on the device screen with the address registered in the app.
앱에서 스캐너는 보이는데 스캔만 실패하면 한 장으로 미리보기를 시험하세요: If you can see the scanner in the app but the scan fails, try previewing with one page. If only the manufacturer's app is normal, use that app and check other apps for device selection, permissions, and scan driver support.
어떤 앱에서도 장치가 없으면 모델별 스캔 드라이버·연결을 점검하세요. 자: If the device is not found in any app, check the scan driver/connection for each model. If self-scanning/copying fails, request device inspection first rather than reinstalling the PC.
앱 사용량과 배터리 용량을 별도로 확인하기: Check app usage and battery capacity separately
A distinction must be made between power limitations in battery mode and reduced capacity of the battery itself.
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 전원 및 배터리와 관리자 명령 프롬프: Windows+I → System → Power and Battery and Administrator Command Prompt
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 전원 및 배터리에서 배터리 사용량의: Check battery usage by app and power mode in Windows+I → System → Power & Battery. Set the screen brightness and running apps to the same conditions and compare the performance before and after connecting the rated adapter.
시작에서 cmd를 검색해 명령 프롬프트를 관리자 권한으로 열고 power: Open Command Prompt as administrator by searching for cmd in Start and run powercfg /batteryreport. Open the report path indicated in the completion text to compare design capacity, fully charged capacity, and recent usage history.
용량 수치 한 번만으로 불량을 확정하지 말고 제조사 배터리 진단과 사용: Rather than confirming a defect based on the capacity value alone, check the manufacturer's battery diagnosis and usage time together. Gaming/rendering may be slow due to power limitations on the battery. Discontinue use if swelling, odor, or abnormal heat occurs.
특정 앱 소비가 높으면 그 앱의 백그라운드 동작부터 조정하세요. 용량 감: If consumption of a specific app is high, start by adjusting the background behavior of that app. If the decrease in capacity and actual usage time are both significant, ask the manufacturer to inspect the battery.
다시 켜지 않고 교체·수거 안내 받기: Receive replacement and collection instructions without turning it on again
팽창한 기기의 잔량 확인이나 백업을 위해 다시 충전하면 위험을 늘릴 수: Recharging a swollen device to check its remaining capacity or for backup can increase your risk.
안전하게 떨어진 상태에서 제조사에 모델명·팽창으로 들뜬 위치·발열이나 연: While safely away, explain to the manufacturer the model name, the location of the inflated product, whether there is heat or smoke, and ask whether it is possible to visit or collect the product. Do not press or disassemble the device because of the photos.
배송·운반은 제조사가 상태를 확인하고 안내한 방법만 따르세요. 뜨겁거나: Transport or ship the device only as instructed by the manufacturer after they have assessed its condition. Do not touch or move a hot or smoking device. Keep your distance and seek emergency help.
데이터는 안전한 교체·점검 후 접근 가능한지 상담하세요. 배터리를 일반: Please consult whether the data can be accessed after safe replacement and inspection. Do not dispose of batteries as general waste or send them in unauthorized packaging.
Once the device is no longer in use and the situation is safe, arrange professional service. Do not turn it on again to test whether it has recovered.
정상 팬 정지 조건과 제조사 진단 비교하기: Comparing normal fan stop conditions to manufacturer diagnosis
저온에서 정상 정지하는 모델과 냉각이 필요한데도 회전하지 않는 고장을 구: A distinction must be made between models that stop normally at low temperatures and failures that do not rotate even when cooling is required.
기기 모델의 팬 제어 안내·제조사 부팅 전 진단: Fan control information/manufacturer pre-boot diagnosis for device model
팬 종류가 CPU·케이스·GPU·노트북 중 무엇인지 먼저 구분하세요. 해: First identify whether this is a CPU, case, GPU or laptop fan. Check the exact model manual for zero-RPM or quiet-mode support and the conditions under which the fan should spin. A GPU that normally stops its fans does not mean that a stopped CPU fan is normal.
온도가 비정상적으로 오르거나 냄새·보호 종료가 있으면 진단을 시도하지 말: If temperatures rise abnormally, there is an unusual smell, or the device shuts down for protection, stop using it and do not run diagnostics. Use the manufacturer’s fan self-test only when the device can start safely. Supported Dell models offer F12 at the startup logo → Diagnostics; follow the model-specific instructions for other manufacturers.
진단에 팬 오류가 나오면 오류 코드·검증 코드를 적고 제조사에 전달하세요: If a fan error appears in the diagnosis, write down the error code/verification code and send it to the manufacturer. Even if it spins during diagnosis, if it continues to stop under normal rotation conditions, it is necessary to check the fan control settings and firmware.
If the model supports stopping behavior and the diagnostics are normal, it may be in normal control. If there is a fan error, overheating, or protection shutdown, do not reproduce it by increasing the load and request repair.
전원 분리 후 연결과 외부 막힘만 확인하기: After disconnecting the power, check only the connections and external blockages.
팬 전원 연결 문제를 확인하되 작동 중 접촉이나 무리한 분해는 피해야 합: Check the fan’s power connection without touching moving parts or attempting disassembly beyond your experience.
데스크톱 CPU_FAN·SYS_FAN 표기와 노트북 외부 통풍구: Desktop CPU_FAN·SYS_FAN markings and laptop external vents
데스크톱을 직접 점검할 수 있을 때만 완전 종료하고 콘센트·전원을 분리하: Only inspect desktop internals if you can do so safely. Shut it down completely and unplug it first. Compare the CPU_FAN and SYS_FAN headers with the board manual and check for loose connectors. Never open the power supply enclosure.
손·케이블·이물질이 날개에 걸린 흔적은 전원이 분리된 상태에서만 살펴보세: Check for anything obstructing the fan blades, such as cables or debris, only with the power disconnected. Do not push a powered fan by hand or spin it rapidly with compressed air.
노트북은 외부 통풍구가 이불·먼지로 막혔는지 확인하고 단단한 바닥에 두세: Make sure the external vents of the laptop are blocked with blankets or dust, and place it on a hard floor. If disassembly of the built-in battery or fan is necessary or is under warranty, receive a service inspection instead of disassembling it yourself.
명확한 외부 막힘·연결 문제를 안전하게 바로잡은 뒤 제조사 진단으로 확인: After safely correcting any obvious external blockage or connection problems, check with the manufacturer's diagnosis. If rotation failure remains, inspection of the fan motor/control circuit is required.
지원 결과와 종료 메뉴 표시를 나눠 확인하기: Check application results and end menu display separately
최대 절전을 지원하는 것과 시작 메뉴에 항목이 표시되는 것은 서로 다른: Supporting hibernation and having an item appear in the Start menu are two different settings.
관리자 명령 프롬프트와 제어판 → 전원 옵션 → 전원 단추 작동 설정: Administrator Command Prompt and Control Panel → Power Options → Set what the power buttons do
시작에서 cmd를 검색해 명령 프롬프트를 관리자 권한으로 실행하고 pow: Run Command Prompt as administrator by searching for cmd in Start and type powercfg /a. If hibernate is not available, read the printed reason first.
최대 절전 파일이 비활성화됐다는 경우에만 powercfg /hiberna: Run powercfg /hibernate on only if the hibernate file is disabled. If it says it is not possible due to a reduced file and there is enough storage space, run powercfg /hibernate /type full and check again with powercfg /a.
지원은 되는데 메뉴만 없으면 제어판 → 전원 옵션 → 전원 단추 작동 설: If it is supported but there is no menu, select and save the hibernate option in Control Panel → Power Options → Power button behavior settings → Change currently unavailable settings. If you are locked out by organization policy, ask your administrator.
지원 목록과 메뉴가 모두 정상일 때 저장 후 한 번 시험하세요. 펌웨어·: When the support list and menu are all normal, save and test once. Do not bypass a status that is not possible due to firmware/policy by modifying the registry.
Windows 키+R을 누르고 관리자에게 받은 정확한 공유 경로를 입력하: Press Windows+R and enter the exact share path supplied by your administrator. The server name needs two leading backslashes and one backslash between the server name and share name. Note whether the error says the path was not found or access was denied.
앱 설치 대상뿐 아니라 Windows 시스템 드라이브의 임시 작업 공간도: In addition to the app installation destination, you may also need temporary workspace on your Windows system drive.
Windows 키+I → 시스템 → 저장소 → 임시 파일에서 삭제 목록의: Check the size and contents of the deletion list in Windows+I → System → Storage → Temporary files. If there are files you need in the Downloads or Recycle Bin, do not select them.
정리 전후 C 드라이브와 설치 대상의 여유 공간을 기록하고 설치 프로그램: Note the free space on your C drive and installation target before and after the cleanup and compare it to the requirement indicated by the installer.
개인 파일은 복사본이 정상인지 확인한 뒤 원본 삭제 여부를 판단해야 합니: For personal files, you must check whether the copy is normal before deciding whether to delete the original.
파일 탐색기에서 큰 개인 파일을 외장 드라이브에 복사하고 복사본을 열어: Copy large personal files to your external drive in File Explorer and open the copy to view it. After that, decide if you can delete the original and reinstall it.
Windows·WinSxS·복구 파티션을 임의 삭제하지 마세요. 공간이: Do not randomly delete the Windows·WinSxS·Recovery partition. If the space decreases again, check the update/app logs for repeated failures.
드라이버를 찾지 못한 장치를 정확히 식별해야 다른 모델용 패키지를 설치하: Accurately identifying the device for which drivers are not found can help reduce the risk of installing packages for other models.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter로 장치 관리: Open Device Manager with Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter and note the first entry in Properties → Details → Hardware ID of the error device.
PC 제조사 지원 페이지에서 정확한 모델과 Windows 버전의 드라이버: Get drivers for your exact model and Windows version from your PC manufacturer's support page. After installation, save and reboot and check if the device name and code 28 change.
하드웨어 ID와 공식 지원 모델을 함께 확인하면 알 수 없는 장치의 공급: Checking the hardware ID along with officially supported models can help you narrow down the vendor for your unknown device.
장치 제조사에 기록한 ID·PC 모델·Windows 버전을 전달해 지원: Please provide the ID, PC model, and Windows version recorded to the device manufacturer to check the support package. Don't use random driver sites or automated installation tools.
인터넷 연결이 안 되면 다른 정상 PC에서 공식 설치 파일을 받아 USB: If you cannot connect to the Internet, download the official installation file from another normal PC and transfer it to USB. Do not erase the network drivers before obtaining the reinstallation files.
코드 45는 연결되지 않은 이전 장치 기록에도 표시되므로 실제 연결 상태: Code 45 also appears in records of previous unconnected devices, so check the actual connection status first.
사용하려는 장치의 전원을 확인하고 허브를 빼고 본체의 지원 포트에 직접: Check the power of the device you want to use, remove the hub, and connect it directly to the supported port on the console. Compare once with normal cables and ports of the same standard.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter로 장치 관리: Open Device Manager with Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter and check if a new current entry is created when you connect the device. Check internal component connections only after complete shutdown/disconnection of power.
회색 숨김 항목만 보고 현재 사용 중인 장치가 고장이라고 판단하면 안 됩: Don't just look at the grayed-out items and assume that the device you're using is broken.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → 보기 →: Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → View → Show hidden devices, distinguish between gray old items and now connected items.
현재 장치가 정상으로 표시되고 실제 기능도 작동하면 이전 기록만으로 수리: If the current device appears healthy and actually functions well, there is no need to repair it based on previous records alone. If the current item does not appear, proceed to connection/power/device self-check.
서명 오류는 Windows가 드라이버를 신뢰·검증하지 못한 상태로, 서명: A signature error is a condition in which Windows cannot trust or verify the driver, and turning off signature checking is not a solution.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter로 장치 관리: Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Open Device Manager with Enter, and in Properties → Driver, write down the Provider/Version/Digital Signer and Code 52.
Windows 버전과 장치 모델에 맞는 제조사 공식 서명 패키지를 받아: Obtain and install the official manufacturer-signed package for your Windows version and device model, then save/reboot and check whether the code has disappeared.
지원되지 않는 오래된 드라이버는 정식 호환 버전이나 장치 대안이 필요합니: Older, unsupported drivers require a fully compatible version or device alternative.
제조사에 장치 모델·Windows 버전·기존 드라이버 버전과 오류 코드를: Please contact the manufacturer with your device model, Windows version, existing driver version, and error code to check for current support.
드라이버 서명 적용·보안 부팅·메모리 무결성을 끄도록 유도하는 임의 가이: Do not apply random guides that tell you to turn off Driver Signature Enforcement, Secure Boot, or Memory Integrity. For organization devices, follow the admin approval path.
사용자가 꺼 둔 장치와 조직 정책으로 비활성화된 장치는 처리 권한이 다릅: Devices turned off by users and devices disabled by organization policy have different processing rights.
Windows 키+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter로 장치 관리: Open Device Manager with Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter and check if it is code 22 in the properties of that device.
본인이 사용 안 함으로 바꾼 개인 장치라면 우클릭 → 장치 사용을 선택한: If it is a personal device that you have disabled, right-click → select Enable Device and check the actual connection/output. Don't arbitrarily turn on devices that are restricted by your organization.
If the policy turns off the device again, confirmation of permission to use takes precedence over repeated changes.
장치를 켠 뒤 곧바로 꺼지거나 권한 오류가 나면 PC 모델·장치 이름·오: If the device turns off immediately after turning it on or a permission error occurs, write down the PC model, device name, and error code and forward them to the administrator.
다른 오류 코드로 바뀌었다면 그 코드의 원인을 확인하고, 코드 22였다는: If it changes to a different error code, check the cause of the code and do not repeatedly delete the driver just because it was code 22.
실제 날짜·시간대가 틀리면 정상 인증서도 만료되거나 아직 유효하지 않은: If the actual date and time zone are incorrect, the normal certificate may expire or appear to be not yet valid.
Windows 키+I → 시간 및 언어 → 날짜 및 시간에서 날짜·시간대: In Windows+I → Time and Language → Date and Time, check whether the date and time zone matches your actual location and use automatic time setting and synchronize now.
정확한 시간이 표시된 뒤 브라우저에서 주소를 다시 입력해 확인하세요. 전: After the correct time is displayed, re-enter the address in your browser to confirm. If the time is wrong every time you turn off the power, check separately for time maintenance and synchronization issues.
시간이 정확한 여러 장치에서 같은 사이트만 실패하면 운영자가 인증서를 확: If only the same site fails on multiple time-correct devices, the operator may need to verify the certificate.
다른 정상 장치·네트워크에서 정확히 같은 HTTPS 주소를 열어 비교하세: Compare by opening the exact same HTTPS address on another legitimate device or network. If it only occurs on a specific company network, contact your administrator for security check path.
모든 환경에서 같은 경고면 주소·발생 시각·인증서 만료 표시를 사이트 운: If the warning is the same in all environments, inform the site administrator of the address, time of occurrence, and certificate expiration mark. Ignore the warning and do not log in or enter payment information.
앱과 다른 아키텍처의 DLL이나 손상된 라이브러리를 개별 복사로 덧씌우면: The error may increase if you individually copy DLLs or damaged libraries of a different architecture from the app.
오류 창의 앱 이름·DLL 경로를 적고 게임 런처의 파일 검사 또는 앱: Write down the app name/DLL path in the error window and run file check in the game launcher or repair in the app's official installer.
예전에 외부에서 복사한 DLL이 있으면 무작정 시스템 폴더를 지우지 말고: If there are DLLs copied from an external source in the past, do not blindly delete the system folder but restore the original file structure through official recovery/reinstallation.
64비트 Windows에서도 32비트 앱은 x86 런타임이 필요하므로 운: Even on 64-bit Windows, 32-bit apps require the x86 runtime, so you shouldn't choose a package based solely on the operating system.
앱 제작사의 요구사항에서 앱이 32비트인지 64비트인지와 필요한 Visu: Check the app publisher's requirements to determine whether your app is 32-bit or 64-bit and which version of Visual C++ is required. Select x86·x64 according to the app architecture.
Microsoft 공식 패키지를 설치·복구한 뒤 같은 실행 파일로 시험하: After installing and repairing the official Microsoft package, test it with the same executable file. If the app version/error DLL path remains the same, contact the manufacturer with the corresponding records.
