키 ID와 48자리 복구 키는 다릅니다. 조직 PC는 관리자에게 요청하세: The key ID is not the 48-digit recovery key. For a work or school PC, ask the administrator for help. If you cannot find the recovery key, do not reset the TPM or format the drive.
Windows 로그인 이후 화면이 검게 되거나 멈췄고 PC 전원은 켜진: After logging into Windows, the screen goes black or freezes, and with the PC turned on, press Windows+Ctrl+Shift+B once at the same time. This does not apply to POST issues where the manufacturer logo is not displayed.
짧은 비프음·화면 깜빡임 뒤 바탕화면이 돌아오는지 기다리세요. 반응이 없: After a short beep sound and screen flashing, wait for the desktop to return. Do not keep pressing the shortcut keys if there is no response or turn off the power during a normal update.
복구되면 파일을 저장하고 발생 앱·시각을 적으세요. Windows 키+R: Once recovered, save the file and write down the app and time of occurrence. Check the version in Windows+R → devmgmt.msc → Enter → Display Adapter → GPU Properties → Driver and check it against recent changes.
Windows가 켜져 있으나 화면·입력만 멈췄는지 구분할 때: When determining whether Windows is turned on but only the screen/input has stopped
화면만 멈춤·전체 멈춤 구분: Distinguish between screen only freeze and entire freeze
강제 종료는 저장하지 않은 작업을 잃을 수 있습니다. 업데이트 적용 중에: Force quitting may result in loss of unsaved work. Do not turn off the power repeatedly while applying updates.
Windows에 로그인한 뒤 외부 화면만 안 보이거나 화면이 다른 출력으: After logging in to Windows, if you cannot see the external screen or the screen seems to have moved to another output, press Windows+P. If you can't even see the manufacturer's logo, check the cable and POST first.
표시되는 패널에서 방향키로 PC 화면만·복제·확장 중 필요한 모드를 선택: In the panel that appears, use the arrow keys to select the required mode among PC screen only, duplicate, or extension, and press Enter. If you do not see the panel at all, do not change the settings by randomly pressing the arrow keys several times.
몇 초 뒤 노트북 패널과 외부 모니터를 각각 확인하세요. 연결된 화면이: After a few seconds, check the laptop panel and external monitor respectively. When the connected screen returns, adjust the screen layout and resolution in Settings → System → Display.
열린 문서·게임 진행·복사 작업을 저장하고 종료하세요. 설치·업데이트 적: Save and exit any open documents, game progress, or copy work. If installation/update application is in progress, wait until it is completed first.
Windows 키를 누르거나 시작 버튼을 클릭하고 전원 → 다시 시작을: Press the Windows key or click the Start button and select Power → Restart. Use Restart in this comparison to distinguish it from Shutdown with Fast Startup turned on.
로그인 뒤 이전과 같은 앱·파일·연결 조건으로 비교하세요. 재발 시각과: After logging in, compare the same app, file, and connection conditions as before. Write down the recurrence time and error message, and do not assume that the cause of the failure has been resolved just because it temporarily disappeared.
화면이 안 나오거나 특정 케이블·입력·모니터에서만 문제가 생길 때: When the screen does not appear or problems occur only with certain cables, inputs, or monitors
정상 케이블·다른 화면과 비교: Comparison with normal cable and other screens
PC에 외장 GPU가 있으면 연결한 출력 위치를 확인하세요. 메인보드 영: If your PC has an external GPU, check the output location it is connected to. The motherboard video terminal may not work depending on CPU built-in graphics support and settings.
PC와 모니터를 끄고 HDMI·DisplayPort 케이블을 양쪽에서 분: Turn off the PC and monitor, and disconnect the HDMI·DisplayPort cable from both sides. For DP cables with a locking device, press the release button to remove them and check if the terminal is damaged or bent.
같은 입력에서 지원 해상도·주사율에 맞는 정상 케이블을 양쪽 끝까지 연결: Connect a normal cable that matches the supported resolution/refresh rate to both ends of the same input. First, connect the PC and monitor directly, excluding the gender, hub, and dock.
모니터 버튼의 Input·Source를 실제 연결한 HDMI·DP 입력으: Set the Input/Source on the monitor button to the actually connected HDMI/DP input and turn it on. If the screen returns after changing just one cable, check the cable/intermediate device path.
현재 출력·케이블·모니터 입력을 적고 PC를 끄세요. 같은 GPU의 다른: Write down the current output, cable, and monitor input and turn off the PC. Connect the support cable to another normal output port on the same GPU and match the monitor OSD input as well.
가능하면 정상 모니터·TV를 같은 PC 출력에 직접 연결하세요. 한 번에: If possible, connect a normal monitor/TV directly to the same PC output. Rather than changing all cables and monitors at once, change them one by one and record under what conditions the screen returns.
메인보드 단자로 비교하려면 CPU 내장그래픽 지원과 BIOS 출력 설정을: To compare by motherboard terminal, check CPU built-in graphics support and BIOS output settings. Do not judge the monitor to be broken just because it does not come out from an unsupported motherboard output.
PC를 종료하고 AC 전원선을 분리하세요. 노트북·일체형은 내장 배터리: Shut down your PC and disconnect the AC power cord. Laptops and all-in-one devices may require removal of the built-in battery and warranty conditions, so do not touch the internal components without the manufacturer's instructions.
분해에 익숙한 경우에만 메인보드 설명서의 권장 RAM 슬롯·잠금쇠와 GP: Only if you are comfortable with disassembly, check your motherboard manual for recommended RAM slots/latches and GPU slot securing. Take a photo of the original configuration and do not apply force to the terminals or rub the contacts.
GPU 보조전원은 해당 GPU·파워의 정품 호환 케이블로 끝까지 결합됐는: Make sure that the GPU auxiliary power supply is connected all the way to the end with a genuine compatible cable for the corresponding GPU/power. Do not turn on the product if there is discoloration, rusting, or damage. After reassembly, record changes to the diagnostic lights and screen.
PC 출력·모니터 입력·케이블·젠더의 정확한 모델을 적으세요. HDMI·: Please write down the exact model of PC output, monitor input, cable, and gender. Do not judge target resolution/refresh rate support based on the appearance of the HDMI/DP terminal.
모니터 설명서에서 해당 입력의 지원 해상도·주사율을 찾고, 그 전송량을: Find the supported resolution and refresh rate for the input in the monitor manual, and connect directly without a hub or dock using a certified cable that supports that data rate.
낮은 지원 주사율에서는 정상이고 목표 주사율에서만 문제가 생기는지 비교하: Compare whether this is normal at lower supported refresh rates and the issue only occurs at target refresh rates. If the problem is improved only with a different cable, check the cable/intermediate device specifications and restore ineffective settings.
Windows는 작동하며 특정 게임·장면·패치 이후에만 오류가 생길 때: Windows works and the error only occurs after certain games/scenes/patches.
같은 장면에서 변경 하나씩 비교: Compare changes one by one in the same scene
저장 데이터·모드 설정을 먼저 보관하세요. 실행 파일과 런처를 구분하고: Back up game saves and mod settings first. Distinguish the game executable from its launcher. Do not delete working save files.
PC와 모니터를 끄고 현재 케이블·포트·입력 설정을 기록하세요. 정상 케: Turn off your PC and monitor and write down your current cable, port, and input settings. Change only the normal cable first and compare at the same resolution and refresh rate.
이후 같은 PC에 정상 모니터를, 기존 모니터에는 다른 정상 영상 기기를: Afterwards, connect a normal monitor to the same PC and another normal video device to the existing monitor and set the input source for each. Use motherboard video output only when you have confirmed support for built-in graphics.
여러 기기에서 기존 모니터만 실패하면 모니터·입력 단자를, 같은 PC 출: If only the existing monitor fails on multiple devices, check the monitor/input terminal, and if all screens on the same PC output fail, check the PC output/GPU/POST. Do not confirm component failure due to a single inaction.
직접 적용한 GPU·CPU 튜닝 직후부터 오류가 시작됐을 때: When errors start immediately after directly applied GPU/CPU tuning
기본 프로필만 복원해 같은 작업 비교: Compare the same task by restoring only the default profile
전압·클럭 값을 임의로 입력하지 마세요. 제조사 기본값에서도 오류·과열이: Do not enter voltage/clock values arbitrarily. If errors or overheating remain even at the manufacturer's default values, stop the repetitive load test.
PC와 모니터를 끄고 정상 영상 케이블·다른 GPU 출력·모니터 입력을: Turn off the PC and monitor and compare the normal video cable, different GPU output, and monitor input one by one. If your PC has an external GPU, check whether the cable is connected to the motherboard incorrectly.
내부 점검은 종료·AC 분리 뒤에만 진행하세요. 분해에 익숙하면 제조사: Perform internal inspection only after shutting down and disconnecting the AC. If you are familiar with disassembly, follow the manufacturer's instructions to ensure that the GPU slot is fixed and the supported auxiliary power source is fully connected. Do not mix modular cables of different powers.
단자 변색·녹음·손상·타는 냄새가 있으면 켜지 말고 점검을 맡기세요. 재: If the terminal is discolored, recorded, damaged, or has a burning smell, do not turn it on and have it inspected. After reconnecting, note whether the screen and diagnostic lights change, and if they remain the same, do not repeat cable replacement.
바탕화면에 진입하며 아래에 적힌 명령의 대상과 실행 조건을 확인했을 때: When entering the desktop and checking the target and execution conditions of the command below
필요한 경우에만 관리자 권한 실행: Run administrator privileges only when necessary
명령 한 줄씩 실행·최종 메시지 기록: Execute commands line by line and record final message
UAC에서 게시자와 작업을 확인하세요. 실행 중인 Windows의 /On: Check the program publisher and requested action in the UAC prompt. Do not reuse a running-Windows /Online command unchanged in a recovery USB command prompt. If it fails, record the error instead of adding unrelated commands.
블루스크린의 중지 코드와 What failed의 .sys 파일명이 보이면: If you see the blue screen stop code and the .sys file name of What failed, take a picture. If the screen disappears quickly and you are unable to record it, do not guess and enter the code.
부팅·게임·파일 복사·절전 복귀 중 언제 발생했는지, 직전에 바꾼 드라이: Please write down when it happened during booting, playing games, copying files, or returning from sleep, and what drivers, parts, and updates were just recently changed. When repeating, distinguish whether the code or file name is the same.
Windows가 열리면 Windows 키+R → eventvwr.msc: When Windows opens, keep related records such as Windows+R → eventvwr.msc → Enter → Windows Log → System, such as BugCheck·WHEA at the same time. Dumps may contain personal information, so please do not post them publicly.
노트북은 이불·소파·무릎 대신 평평하고 단단한 바닥에 두세요. 바닥 흡기: Place your laptop on a flat, hard floor instead of a blanket, sofa, or lap. Check that the floor intake vent is not covered and that the exhaust vents behind and above the desktop are close to the wall.
외부 통풍구에서 먼지 막힘·물건·천이 있는지 보세요. 제조사 설치 안내의: Check the external vents for dust blockages, objects, or cloth. Ensure the ventilation space specified in the manufacturer's installation instructions and do not insert tools or hands into the fan while it is rotating.
위험한 발열·냄새·팬 정지가 없다면 같은 가벼운 작업에서 온도와 팬 소리: If there is no dangerous heat generation, odor, or fan stoppage, compare the temperature and fan sound for changes in the same light work. If it still overheats, perform a cleaning/cooling check instead of a high load test.
팬 정지·마찰음·통풍 막힘이 관찰되고 정상 정지 조건인지 확인할 때: When fan stoppage, friction noise, or ventilation blockage is observed and confirmation of normal stop conditions is observed.
팬 위치·외부 막힘·진단 결과 확인: Check fan location, external blockage, and diagnosis results
정상 정지와 고장 징후 구분: Distinguish between normal stoppage and signs of failure
CPU 팬이 멈추거나 과열·마찰음이 있으면 시험을 멈추세요. 회전 중 팬: Stop the test if the CPU fan stops, overheats, or makes a rubbing noise. Do not touch the fan with your hand while it is spinning or apply a high load to it when it is stopped.
저장 가능한 진행을 저장하고 게임·런처를 정상 종료하세요. 설치·패치가: Save any storable progress and exit the game/launcher normally. If installation/patch is in progress, complete it and then select Windows Start → Power → Restart.
같은 게임 버전·저장 지점·그래픽 설정으로 실행해 어느 장면에서 종료되는: Try running it with the same game version, save point, and graphics settings to see which scene it ends at. Do not change multiple settings at the same time.
오류 창의 코드·파일명·발생 시각을 기록하세요. 특정 저장 지점만 실패하: Record the code, file name, and occurrence time of the error window. If only a specific save point fails, keep the save data/mod and compare it with an official file check, and if it is the same across multiple games, check the common drivers/temperature as well.
Windows의 소리 테스트와 특정 앱의 소리·마이크 동작을 비교할 때: When comparing the sound test of Windows and the sound and microphone operation of a specific app
테스트 결과와 원래 앱 비교: Compare test results with original app
Windows 10은 출력·입력 메뉴 구성이 다를 수 있습니다. 장치 이: Windows 10 may have different output/input menu configuration. Match the device name and test starting at a low volume.
USB·주변기기가 인식되지 않거나 포트·케이블에 따라 증상이 달라질 때: When USB/peripheral devices are not recognized or symptoms vary depending on the port/cable
허브 제외 → 본체 포트에 직결: Excluding hub → directly connected to main body port
정상 케이블·다른 PC와 비교: Comparison with normal cable and other PCs
충전 전용 케이블과 데이터 케이블을 구분하세요. 저장장치는 복사를 마치고: Distinguish between charging-only cables and data cables. After copying, safely remove the storage device. Do not connect to a damaged or overheated port.
Bluetooth 장치가 검색·연결되지 않거나 거리·배터리에 따라 끊길: When a Bluetooth device is not discovered or connected or is disconnected due to distance or battery
정확한 장치 선택 → 실제 기능 시험: Select the correct device → test its actual functionality
Windows 10은 장치 → Bluetooth 및 기타 디바이스를 사용: Windows 10 uses Devices → Bluetooth & other devices. Prepare an alternative input method before removing your only keyboard/mouse.
인터넷·공유·게임 연결이 특정 PC·사이트·연결에서만 실패하는지 나눌 때: When determining whether Internet, sharing, or game connections fail only on specific PCs, sites, or connections
같은 주소·서버를 다른 기기와 비교: Compare the same address/server with other devices
한 PC·한 사이트·전체 회선 구분: Distinguish between one PC, one site, and all lines
회사 VPN·프록시·고정 IP는 원래 값을 기록하고 관리자에게 확인하세요: For company VPN, proxy, and static IP, record the original values and check with the administrator. Do not use router RESET or full firewall release instead of connection check.
같은 공유기의 여러 기기가 함께 끊기거나 유선·무선을 교차 비교할 때: When multiple devices on the same router are disconnected together or when cross-comparing wired and wireless
PC·휴대폰 → 같은 사이트 비교: PC/Mobile phone → Comparison of the same site
모뎀 → 공유기 순으로 정상 복귀 확인: Confirm return to normal in the following order: Modem → Router
재시작하면 다른 이용자의 연결도 끊깁니다. 진행 중인 작업을 마친 뒤 전: If you restart, other users will also lose their connections. Use the power switch after finishing any work in progress. Do not press the RESET hole as it is a factory reset.
업데이트·기능 설치가 실패해 KB 번호와 Windows 버전을 대조할 때: When installing an update/feature fails and comparing the KB number with the Windows version
winver의 버전과 공식 대상 비교: Compare versions of winver and their official targets
Windows 10은 업데이트 및 보안 → Windows 업데이트를 사용: Windows 10 uses Update & Security → Windows Update. Do not turn off the power during installation, and do not install unrelated KB or other architecture packages.
로그인 화면 오른쪽 아래 전원 → 다시 시작을 선택하세요. 진행 중인 업: Select Power → Restart at the bottom right of the login screen. Wait for the ongoing update to finish, reboot and see if it fails on the same account.
오른쪽 아래 네트워크 아이콘에서 연결 상태를 확인하세요. 처음 로그인하거: Check the connection status on the network icon in the bottom right. If you're logging in for the first time or need to recover your account, use an Internet connection you trust. For company-only login, follow your organization's instructions.
로그인 옵션에서 본인이 등록한 PIN·암호 중 다른 수단을 선택하고 Ca: In the login options, select another method among the PIN/password you registered and check Caps Lock/input language. If you don't know the password itself, use official account recovery instead of guessing again.
로그인 화면은 보이나 PIN·계정 암호·프로필에서 막힐 때: When you see the login screen but are blocked at the PIN, account password, or profile
Caps Lock·입력 언어·네트워크 확인: Check Caps Lock, input language, and network
본인 계정의 공식 복구 경로 사용: Use the official recovery path for your account
PIN과 Microsoft 계정 암호는 다릅니다. TPM 초기화·암호 우: Your PIN and Microsoft account password are different. Do not use TPM reset, password bypass, or authentication file deletion as workarounds.
특정 앱에서만 실패하고 공식 설치 프로그램이나 Windows 앱 설정을: When it only fails with certain apps and you can use the official installer or Windows app settings.
복구 먼저 → 같은 동작 재시도: Recovery first → Retry the same operation
Windows 10은 앱 및 기능을 확인하세요. 초기화·제거는 앱 데이터: On Windows 10, use Apps & features. Repair is different from Reset or Uninstall: the latter can remove app data and sign-in state. Back up what you need first.
일반 모드에서만 실패하고 최근 설치 앱·서비스 충돌을 분리할 때: It only fails in normal mode and when isolating recently installed app/service conflicts.
본인이 설치한 서비스·시작 앱만 비교: Compare only the services and startup apps you have installed
변경한 목록을 보관하고 시험 뒤 복원하세요. 조직 보안·로그인 서비스는: Keep the list of changes you have made and restore them after the test. Do not turn off organizational security/login services. Safe boot and clean boot in the Boot tab are different.
Windows 검색창 자체가 반응하지 않는지 특정 파일만 누락되는지 나눌: When deciding whether the Windows search box itself is not responding or only specific files are missing
전체 검색 실패·색인 범위 누락 구분: Distinguish between overall search failure and missing index range
네트워크·외장·클라우드 파일은 색인 범위와 내려받기 상태가 다릅니다. 검: Network, external, and cloud files have different index ranges and download status. Do not delete files or perform recovery initialization just because they do not appear in the search.
읽기 오류·인식 해제·SMART 경고·데이터 손실이 있어 파일 보호가 먼: When file protection comes first due to read errors, recognition cancellation, SMART warnings, and data loss
필요한 파일과 기존 백업 확인: Check required files and existing backups
다른 정상 저장장치로 복사: Copy to another normal storage device
같은 디스크의 다른 파티션은 별도 백업이 아닙니다. 이상음·반복 해제·0: Another partition on the same drive is not an independent backup. If the drive makes unusual noises, repeatedly disconnects, or reports 0GB, seek recovery advice before repeating tests or power cycles.
날짜·시간대가 틀리거나 HTTPS·시간 동기화 오류가 함께 발생할 때: When the date and time zone are incorrect or HTTPS and time synchronization errors occur together
날짜 및 시간 → 시간대·자동 설정: Date and time → Time zone/automatic setting
조직 시간 서버는 관리자에게 확인하세요. 인증서 경고를 무시하고 로그인하: Ask your administrator about corporate time servers. Do not bypass a certificate warning to sign in.
종료 후 전원 연결을 끊었다 다시 켤 때마다 BIOS의 날짜·시간도 초기: After shutdown, record whether the date and time of the BIOS are also reset each time you disconnect the power and then turn it back on. If the Windows time zone is wrong, check the time setting first rather than the RTC battery.
데스크톱은 메인보드 모델 설명서에서 RTC/CMOS 배터리 규격·교체 절: For desktops, check the RTC/CMOS battery specifications and replacement procedures in the motherboard model manual. Before replacement, obtain the settings, boot sequence, and BitLocker recovery key, and leave it to disassembly if you are not familiar with it.
노트북은 내장 배터리·RTC 배터리 구조가 다르므로 임의로 분리하지 마세: Laptops have different built-in batteries and RTC batteries, so do not separate them arbitrarily. If the time is reset even after correct replacement, request to check the motherboard and time synchronization status.
Windows 정품 인증이 실패하거나 설치 에디션과 구매 권한이 다른지: Windows activation fails or when checking to see if the installation edition and purchase rights are different.
Windows 10은 업데이트 및 보안 → 정품 인증을 사용합니다. 제품: Windows 10 uses Update & Security → Activation. Don't reveal your product key or use unofficial authentication tools.
최근 변경 전 복원 지점이 있고 파일·복구 키를 보관한 뒤 되돌리기를 검: When there is a restore point before the most recent change and you are considering reverting after saving the files and recovery key.
복원 지점 → 영향 받는 프로그램 검색: Restore points → Search for affected programs
변경될 앱·드라이버 확인 후 판단: Make a decision after checking the apps and drivers to be changed
시스템 복원은 개인 파일 백업을 대신하지 않습니다. 부팅이 안 되면 복구: System Restore is not a substitute for backing up your personal files. If it does not boot, check Advanced Options → System Restore in the recovery environment.
외장 장치는 복사를 마치고 안전하게 제거한 뒤 허브 없이 정상 데이터 케: After copying, safely remove the external device and connect it directly to the main unit's USB port using a normal data cable without a hub. Change the cable/port one by one and see the change in connection sound and perception.
내장 SATA 점검은 종료·AC 분리 뒤 진행하세요. 설명서의 SATA: Perform internal SATA inspection after shutting down and disconnecting the AC. Make sure that the SATA data port in the manual and the original compatible power connector of the corresponding power source are fully connected, and if you are not familiar with it, leave it to us.
M.2는 크기뿐 아니라 SATA·NVMe 지원과 다른 포트 공유 조건을: For M.2, please check not only the size but also SATA/NVMe support and other port sharing conditions with the motherboard manual. Before reinstalling, check the data preservation and power disconnection procedures and do not initialize the existing disk.
디스크·USB·SD 카드의 용량·파티션·문자 인식을 확인할 때: When checking the capacity, partition, and character recognition of disk, USB, and SD card
모델·전체 용량으로 대상 확인: Check target by model and total capacity
정상 파티션·RAW·미할당 구분: Classification of normal partition, RAW, and unallocated partition
기존 파일이 있는 디스크의 초기화·포맷 요청은 취소하세요. RAW·미할당: Cancel the request to initialize or format the disk that contains existing files. RAW, unallocated, and 0GB do not mean that the disk is empty.
이전에 사진·문서가 있던 디스크인지, 새로 산 빈 디스크인지 먼저 구분하: First, determine whether it is a disk that previously contained photos or documents or a newly purchased blank disk. If you have existing data, cancel Windows' disk initialization/format/new volume request.
표시된 모델·전체 용량·RAW·미할당·오류 문구만 기록하세요. 0GB·연: Please record only the displayed model, total capacity, RAW, unallocated, and error phrases. If 0GB/disconnection/click/read error repeats, do not format or perform full scan.
정상적으로 읽히는 파일만 다른 정상 저장장치에 복사하고 복사본이 열리는지: Copy only files that can be read normally to another normal storage device and check whether the copy can be opened. If you cannot read essential files, request recovery consultation rather than repeatedly reconnecting the power.
작업과 저장장치 복사를 마치고 USB 저장장치를 안전하게 제거하세요. W: After completing the task and copying the storage device, safely remove the USB storage device. Select Windows Start → Power → Shut down.
데스크톱은 종료 후 AC 전원선을 30초~1분 분리하세요. 노트북은 충전: After shutting down the desktop, disconnect the AC power cord for 30 seconds to 1 minute. For laptops, disconnect the charger and peripheral devices, but do not remove the built-in battery arbitrarily and check the power reset instructions for each model.
Reconnect the power and connect only one problem device directly to the console port. If recognized, add hubs and other devices one by one and compare them. If the failure continues, check the status of ports, cables, and devices separately.
파일을 읽을 수 있으면 먼저 다른 정상 디스크에 백업하세요. 딸깍 소리·: If the file is readable, back it up to another healthy disk first. If there is a clicking sound, severe heat, repeated de-recognition, or 0GB, do not repeat the cable test and first determine whether recovery is necessary.
USB 외장은 안전하게 제거한 뒤 정상 데이터 케이블로 허브 없이 직결하: Safely eject the external USB drive, then connect it directly with a known-good data cable and no hub. For a separately powered model, check the manufacturer-rated adapter. An experienced person may replace a SATA cable only after shutting down the PC AND disconnecting AC power.
같은 드라이브가 특정 케이블·포트에서만 끊기는지 기록하세요. 어떤 정상: Note whether the same drive disconnects only from a specific cable/port. If a read error occurs in any normal path, request inspection of the storage device or external case and do not perform file system repair first.
휴대폰의 모바일 데이터를 잠시 끄고 PC와 같은 Wi-Fi에 연결해 정확: Turn off mobile data on your phone for a moment, then connect to the same Wi-Fi as your PC and open the exact same site. Do not confuse this with results in your phone bypassing mobile data.
휴대폰도 여러 사이트에 실패하면 공유기·모뎀 표시등과 회선 장애를 확인하: If your phone also fails to access multiple sites, check the router/modem lights and line failure. If only one site fails, check the service failure and address first.
다른 기기는 정상이고 이 PC만 여러 사이트에 실패하면 PC의 어댑터·I: If other devices are normal and only this PC fails on several sites, check the PC's adapter, IP, DNS, and approved VPN settings. Once the comparison is complete, restore your phone's mobile data settings to their original settings.
다른 이용자의 통화·원격 작업·다운로드를 확인하고 중요한 작업을 마치세요: Check other users' calls, remote tasks, and downloads and complete important tasks. Restarting the router may disconnect all users on the same network.
Turn off the modem/router using the power switch or power line, and then turn it on after about 30 seconds. If you have a separate modem, turn on the router after the modem line lights are normalized. Do not press the RESET hole.
인터넷 표시등이 정상화되면 같은 Wi-Fi의 PC·휴대폰에서 같은 사이트: When the Internet indicator light returns to normal, compare the same site with other normal sites on your PC or mobile phone using the same Wi-Fi. If all devices continue to fail, record the indicator lights and time of failure and contact your line company.
PC 이더넷 단자와 공유기의 LAN 단자에 케이블이 끝까지 꽂혀 잠금쇠가: Check that the cable is fully inserted into the PC Ethernet terminal and the router's LAN terminal and the latch is engaged. Separate the router's WAN/Internet port from the PC's LAN port.
정상 Cat5e 이상 케이블 한 개로 다른 LAN 포트에 연결해 링크 표: Connect to another LAN port with a normal Cat5e or higher cable and check if the link indicator and connection status of Windows Settings → Network and Internet → Ethernet change.
특정 케이블·포트에서만 연결이 끊기면 그 경로를 교체·점검하세요. 링크는: If the connection is lost only in a specific cable/port, replace/check the route. If the link is connected but the Internet does not work, check the IP, gateway, and line rather than repeatedly replacing the cable.
같은 공유기의 같은 LAN 포트·케이블을 정상 PC 또는 지원되는 USB: Connect the same LAN port/cable of the same router to a normal PC or a supported USB-Ethernet adapter. Check if your other devices also have the necessary drivers and connection settings.
연결 상태와 같은 사이트 접속을 비교하세요. 휴대폰 Wi-Fi만 정상이라: Compare your connection status and access to the same site. Don't assume that just because your phone's Wi-Fi is fine, your wired cable is fine.
다른 유선 기기는 정상인데 원래 PC만 실패하면 PC 어댑터·드라이버·I: If other wired devices are normal but the original PC fails, check the PC adapter, driver, and IP settings. If all wired devices fail, check the router LAN port, cable, and network settings.
주소창에 정확한 HTTPS 주소를 직접 입력하고, 다른 정상 사이트 두: Enter the correct HTTPS address directly in the address bar and try opening two other normal sites. Distinguish whether only old paths in favorites or search results are failing.
같은 네트워크의 다른 기기와 다른 브라우저에서 같은 주소를 여세요. 휴대: Open the same address in a different browser and on another device on the same network. Make sure your phone bypasses mobile data and only use approved connections to your company network.
한 브라우저만 실패하면 프로필·확장을, 모든 기기의 한 사이트만 실패하면: If only one browser fails, check the profile/extension, and if only one site on all devices fails, check site failure/DNS/certificate. Do not connect by ignoring the certificate warning.
브라우저는 실행되며 한 사이트·프로필·확장 프로그램 문제를 비교할 때: The browser launches and compares issues with one site, profile, or extension.
정확한 주소 → 새 탭에서 열기: Exact address → Open in new tab
시크릿 창은 새 세션이므로 로그인이 필요할 수 있습니다. 허용된 확장 프: Since an incognito window is a new session, you may need to log in. Allowed extensions can also run incognito. Check the processing history before repeating payment, order, and submission.
Bluetooth 장치 배터리·충전 표시를 확인하고 PC 가까이에서 같은: Check the battery/charging indicator on your Bluetooth device and test the same function close to your PC. Also check whether the device is automatically connected to another mobile phone or PC.
USB 3.x 허브·외장 SSD·2.4GHz 무선 수신기와 Bluetoo: Compare by increasing the distance between the USB 3. Do not change multiple device and distance conditions at the same time.
가까운 거리에서도 끊기면 Windows 키+I → Bluetooth 및: If the connection is disconnected even at close range, check the connection status in Windows+I → Bluetooth and the device, and pair again only if there is an input method for reconnection and a manufacturer pairing method.
서비스 오류가 실제 기록되고 직접 바꾼 시작 설정과 대조할 때: When service errors are actually logged and compared against startup settings you manually change.
직접 바꾼 값만 복원·오류 기록: Restore only directly changed values and record errors
수동·트리거 시작은 정상일 수 있습니다. 모든 서비스를 자동으로 바꾸지: Manual or trigger-start services can be normal. Do not change every service to Automatic. Ask the administrator about organization policies or dependency errors.
유선 키보드는 허브·독을 제외하고 PC 본체의 정상 USB 포트에 직접: Connect the wired keyboard directly to a normal USB port on the PC, excluding the hub or dock. If your keyboard uses a detachable cable, check whether it is a data-capable cable.
무선 키보드는 배터리·전원 스위치와 해당 제품의 수신기가 꽂혀 있는지 보: For wireless keyboards, check that the battery/power switch and the product's receiver are plugged in. For Bluetooth models, check Settings → Bluetooth and device connection status.
메모장을 열어 같은 키를 누르고 다른 포트·정상 키보드와 비교하세요. 로: Open Notepad, press the same key, and compare it to another port/normal keyboard. Before disabling the keyboard for logging in, secure another input method, and if it does not work for a specific app, check the app input settings.
키보드·마우스가 일부 앱·키·표면에서만 다르게 반응하는지 비교할 때: When comparing whether a keyboard and mouse react differently to some apps, keys, or surfaces
정상 입력 장치 → 본체 포트 연결: Normal input device → main body port connection
메모장·탐색기에서 같은 입력 비교: Compare the same input in Notepad and Explorer
한 장치·한 앱·전체 입력 구분: Distinguish between one device, one app, and all inputs
사용 중인 입력 장치를 해제하기 전 다른 조작 수단을 준비하세요. 액체: Prepare another means of operation before disabling the input device you are using. If the device has leaked liquid or is damaged, disconnect the power source and have it inspected.
키보드 전원을 끄거나 USB를 분리하고 눌린 채 돌아오지 않는 키·이물질: Turn off the keyboard or disconnect the USB, and check externally for signs of foreign substances or liquids or keys that do not return after being pressed. Laptop keycaps have different fixation methods, so do not pull them out arbitrarily.
제조사 청소 지침에 따라 표면만 청소하세요. 액체 유입·부식·타는 냄새가: Clean only surfaces according to manufacturer cleaning instructions. If there is liquid leakage, corrosion, or a burning smell, do not reconnect but have it inspected.
안전한 장치를 다른 PC에 연결해 메모장에서 같은 키를 비교하세요. 같은: Connect your secure device to another PC and compare the same keys in Notepad. If the same physical key fails on multiple PCs, check key/switch repair. If it fails only on the original PC, check arrangement/filter key/app settings.
마우스를 무광 패드·종이처럼 센서가 읽기 쉬운 평평한 표면에 놓고 외부: Place the mouse on a flat surface where the sensor is easy to read, such as a matte pad or paper, and check for dust on the external sensor. Compare to glass/reflective surfaces.
유선은 허브 없이 다른 본체 USB 포트에, 무선은 충전·배터리 확인 뒤: For wired use, connect the receiver to another USB port without a hub. For wireless use, connect the receiver to a nearby location after charging and checking the battery. For Bluetooth models, also check if it is connected to another device.
같은 거리 이동·클릭을 반복해 포트·표면 하나씩 바꿨을 때 개선되는지 기: Repeat moving and clicking the same distance and record whether there is an improvement when you change each port or surface. If the normal mouse only disconnects from this PC, check the PC load, USB, and wireless interference.
정상 마우스를 같은 PC의 본체 포트에 연결해 같은 패드·앱에서 이동·한: Connect a normal mouse to the main port of the same PC and compare movement, single click, and wheel in the same pad/app. Leave your settings the same and just change your device.
문제 마우스도 다른 정상 PC에서 같은 입력을 시험하세요. 무선 제품은: Test the same input from the problem mouse on another normal PC. For wireless products, use the same battery/charging status and receiver, and check if the other PC supports Bluetooth.
문제가 원래 마우스를 따라가면 센서·스위치·케이블·수신기 점검을, 여러: If the problem originally traces to the mouse, check the sensors, switches, cables, and receivers. If multiple mice fail only on one PC, check the USB, load, and input settings.
무선 수신기를 PC 뒤의 USB 3.x 저장장치·허브에서 떨어진 앞쪽 포: Place the wireless receiver on the front port away from the USB 3.x storage device/hub on the back of the PC or on a normal extension cable and move it at the same distance.
배터리·충전 상태를 유지한 채 수신기 위치만 바꿔 끊김이 줄어드는지 확인: While maintaining the battery/charge status, simply change the receiver location to see if interruptions are reduced. If you need to disconnect the storage device, finish copying and remove it safely.
Bluetooth 모델은 다른 조작 수단을 준비한 뒤 설정 → Bluet: For Bluetooth models, prepare other means of operation, then re-pair in Settings → Bluetooth & Devices and compare the same operations. If the problem is the same with a wired connection, do not assume that wireless interference is the only cause.
노트북 터치패드만 작동하지 않거나 입력 중 커서가 움직일 때: When only the laptop touchpad does not work or the cursor moves while typing
정상 USB 마우스 등 조작 수단 준비: Prepare means of operation, such as a normal USB mouse
기능 키·민감도·마우스 연결 조건 비교: Comparison of function key/sensitivity/mouse connection conditions
Windows 10은 장치 → 터치패드를 확인하세요. 케이스 들뜸·배터리: For Windows 10, check Devices → Touchpad. If the case is lifted or the battery swells, do not press and discontinue use.
카드 쓰기·복사를 마치고 안전하게 제거하세요. 큰 SD 어댑터 측면 LO: After writing/copying the card, remove it safely. Make sure the LOCK switch on the side of the large SD adapter is on the lock side. The microSD itself may not have this switch.
읽기는 되는데 쓰기만 막힐 때 스위치가 원인 후보입니다. 제조사 표시의: When reading is possible but writing is blocked, a switch is a likely cause. Align with the unlock side marked by the manufacturer and insert it all the way into the supported reader. Distinguish it from problems that cannot be recognized.
접점 손상·심한 오염·파손이 있으면 억지로 넣지 마세요. 정상 리더기에서: If the contact point is damaged, severely contaminated, or damaged, do not force it in. Even with a normal reader, if the file disappears or requires formatting, stop writing and determine data preservation first.
Read the same card with a normal card reader that meets the supported capacity and SD standards. Connect to any port on the PC, excluding the hub.
Compare whether it is recognized on a normal PC/camera and whether existing photos are actually opened. Cancel the suggestion to initialize or format the camera. If you have sensitive data, do not use the test file.
다른 리더기에서는 정상이라면 원래 리더기·포트를, 모든 기기에서 실패하면: If it is normal on other readers, check the original reader/port, and if it fails on all devices, check the card/adapter status. If there is a repeat disconnect/0GB/read error, stop the reconnection test.
필요한 사진·문서가 남아 있다면 촬영·다운로드·포맷·새 볼륨 생성 등 새: If you still have photos or documents you need, stop new writing operations such as shooting, downloading, formatting, or creating a new volume. Do not install the recovery program on the same card or drive.
정상적으로 읽히는 파일만 다른 정상 저장장치로 복사하고 복사본이 열리는지: Copy only files that can be read normally to another normal storage device and check whether the copy can be opened. Do not use moving or cutting the original.
0GB·연결 해제·읽기 오류가 반복되거나 유일한 중요 파일을 읽지 못하면: If the 0GB/disconnect/read error repeats or the only important file is not read, prioritize professional recovery consultation over full scan/write recovery. Just record the model, capacity, and error message.
물리 셔터·Windows 권한·특정 앱 점유 중 어디에서 카메라가 막히는: When checking where the camera is blocked due to physical shutter, Windows permissions, or specific app occupation
Windows 10은 개인정보 → 카메라를 확인하세요. 사용할 앱만 허용: On Windows 10, use Settings → Privacy → Camera. Allow only the apps you need. Ask the administrator about permissions restricted by organization policy.
카메라를 쓰는 통화·녹화 앱을 정상 종료하세요. 외장 카메라의 USB 케: Normally close any call/recording apps that use the camera. Remove the external camera's USB cable from the hub/dock and connect it directly to a normal port on the PC.
다른 포트 또는 지원되는 정상 데이터 케이블 하나만 바꾸고 시작 → 카메: Change to a different port or a supported normal data cable and start → see if the video comes out in the camera app. Also check that the physical shutter/lens cover is closed.
다른 정상 PC에서 권한을 허용한 카메라 앱으로 비교하세요. 여러 PC에: Compare with a camera app that has permissions on another normal PC. If the same camera fails on multiple PCs, check the cables and cameras, and if it fails only on this PC, check the permissions, occupied apps, and drivers.

한 사이트만 모든 기기에서 실패하면 사이트·DNS 문제를 운영자에게 알리: If only one site fails on all devices, report the site/DNS issue to the administrator. If this PC alone fails with multiple addresses, check your DNS cache and current DNS settings in the next step.

고장 팬을 돌려 보려고 고부하 작업을 실행하지 마세요. GPU·일부 케이: Do not perform high load tasks to try to spin a faulty fan. Distinguish between the normal Zero RPM function of GPU/some case fans and the CPU cooling fan stopping.

GPU 보조전원은 해당 GPU·파워의 정품 호환 케이블로 끝까지 결합됐는: Check that the GPU power connector is fully seated using a genuine cable compatible with both the GPU and PSU. Do not turn it on if you see discoloration, melted areas, or damage. After reassembly, record any change in diagnostic LEDs and display output.

출력 장치가 다시 표시되는지, Windows 테스트 소리와 원래 앱 모두: Check if the output device appears again and you can hear sound in both the Windows test sound and the original app.
같은 출력 장치와 같은 파일로 소리·잡음을 비교하세요. 특정 설정에서만: Compare sound and noise using the same output device and the same file. If it's only OK in certain settings, note the changes you made. If there is no improvement, restore the original format and enhancement settings.
장치가 다시 등록된 뒤 버튼·스틱 또는 원래 장치 기능을 실제 사용해 확: After the device is re-registered, check by actually using the buttons/sticks or the original device functions. If it registers but does not work, check the app's input device selection. Do not remove your only keyboard/mouse without another means of input.
컨트롤러의 버튼·스틱 입력과 원래 게임의 인식을 각각 시험하세요. 한 게: Test the recognition of the controller's button/stick input and the original game. If only one game fails, check the game's input device settings.
어댑터 인식, 네트워크 연결, 실제 웹 접속을 차례로 확인하세요. 연결: Check adapter recognition, network connection, and actual web access in order. Don't judge a solution based on the connection icon alone.
암호 등 다른 허용된 방식으로 로그인되면 계정 자체 접근과 PIN·생체인: If you are logged in using a password or other permitted method, distinguish between access to the account itself and PIN/biometrics issues. If all else fails, check the account recovery procedure and do not delete existing user folders.
디스크 사용이 높은 프로세스와 실제 파일 복사·업데이트 진행을 대조하세요: Contrast high disk usage processes with actual file copy/update progress. If the active time remains at 100% and the freeze persists even after the task is finished, check the transfer speed, read errors, and storage device status.
재부팅과 기존 파일 읽기가 정상인지 확인하세요. 읽기 오류·드라이브 사라: Check if rebooting and reading existing files are normal. If read errors/drive disappearances persist, prioritize securing important files and stop repeat installation.
장치 관리자 오류뿐 아니라 USB 장치의 원래 기능과 재연결을 확인하세요: Check for original functionality and reconnection of the USB device as well as device manager errors. If it fails only on a specific port/hub, check the connection path separately.
Wi-Fi 버튼과 네트워크 목록이 다시 나타났는지 확인한 뒤 실제 접속까: Make sure the Wi-Fi button and network list reappear, then test the actual connection. If you see the list but cannot access the Internet after connecting, check the IP, line, and login authentication rather than turning on the wireless function.
같은 네트워크에 다시 연결되고 웹사이트가 열리는지 확인하세요. 암호 오류: Reconnect to the same network and see if the website opens. If the password error repeats, check the password/organization authentication, and if the Internet does not work after connecting, check the status of the router, line, and IP. Don't repeat deleting your profile.
같은 위치에서 연결 유지와 절전 복귀 후 재연결을 비교하세요. 전원 관리: Compare maintaining a connection at the same location and reconnecting after returning from sleep. If you see a difference after changing your power management settings, note the results, and if it doesn't work, restore the original settings.
After checking the status of the wired adapter and link connection, test actual web access. If other devices using the same cable also fail, check the line/router port.
Bluetooth 버튼이 켜지고 목표 장치가 검색되는지 확인하세요. 버튼: Make sure the Bluetooth button lights up and the target device is discovered. If the button itself is missing, categorize it as an adapter recognition issue. If there is a button but there is no specific device, categorize it as a pairing mode/existing connection issue.
새로 연결한 뒤 소리·키 입력 등 목표 기능을 확인하고 장치 전원을 껐다: After making a new connection, check the target functions, such as sound and key input, and see if the device reconnects when you turn it off and on. If it automatically connects to another device, disconnect it and then compare.
Bluetooth 버튼과 장치 검색이 돌아왔는지 확인하고 실제 페어링·기: Verify that the Bluetooth button and device search have returned and test actual pairing, functionality, and reconnection.
메모장에서 한 번 누르기와 길게 누르기를 비교하세요. 배열 변경으로 입력: Compare single press and long press in Notepad. Check separately whether only the input characters have been corrected by changing the arrangement, or whether missing or repeated input has changed by changing the filter key. If you change settings without effect, restore them to their original values.
메모장에서 문제 키를 한 번 누르고 길게 눌러 비교하세요. 앱 하나에서만: In Notepad, press the question key once and hold it to compare. If only one app fails, check the shortcut/input settings for that app.
If the same physical keys fail on other PCs, suspect a keyboard problem. If it is normal on another PC, check the input language, accessibility, and app settings on the original PC. Discontinue comparison connection if liquid ingress or corrosion occurs.
포인터 이동·한 번 클릭·더블클릭·스크롤을 각각 비교하세요. 특정 앱에서: Compare pointer movement, single click, double click, and scrolling. If it only fails in a specific app, check the app settings.
포인터 이동·클릭·두 손가락 스크롤을 비교하세요. 외장 마우스 연결 시: Compare pointer movement, clicking, and two-finger scrolling. Also check the setting to turn off the touchpad when connecting an external mouse.
카드 인식과 기존 파일 읽기를 확인하세요. 인식 후 포맷 요청이 나와도: Check card recognition and reading existing files. Even if a format request appears after recognition, if there is existing data, cancel it and check how to preserve the data first.
Windows 카메라 앱과 원래 화상회의 앱을 각각 확인하세요. 한 앱만: Check out the Windows Camera app and the original video conferencing app respectively. If only one app fails, check permissions, camera selection, and occupancy by other apps.
앱에서 선택한 마이크와 입력 표시를 확인하고 짧게 녹음해 재생하세요. W: Check the microphone and input indicator selected in the app and record briefly to play. If Windows input is normal but only one app fails, check the permissions, input device, and mute of that app.
Check the microphone operation by checking the Windows input level and playing a short recording. Do not judge that the microphone input is normal just because sound is output.
대기열에서 본인 작업이 사라졌는지 확인한 뒤 테스트 페이지를 한 장만 보: After making sure your work has disappeared from the queue, send just one test page. If it stops at the same task again, check the document/app problem, and if no task is printed, check the connection/printer status.
정확한 모델의 대기열에서 테스트 페이지를 출력하세요. 스캔 기능 문제라면: Print a test page from the queue for the correct model. If there is a problem with the scan function, please also check the scan separately and do not judge full recovery based on printing success alone.
장치 모델·Windows 버전, 실패한 단계, 바꾼 설정, 조치 전후 결: Write down your device model/Windows version, steps that failed, settings you changed, and results before and after your actions. Do not write down your password and recovery key. This history is not transmitted or stored on our servers and disappears when you refresh.

노트북에 전원·충전 반응이 없어요: The laptop does not respond to power or charging.
